quests.title: Rite of Descension
quests.description: In the land of Liyue by the sea, a city sits atop the solid bedrock. That city is Liyue Harbor, and it has flourished under the protection of its guardian Morax — also known as "Rex Lapis," the Geo Archon you have been looking for. You could not have arrived at a more fortuitous time, as the annual "Rite of Descension" has just begun. Every year on this day, Rex Lapis graces this land with his prophecy, giving guidance on the economic path Liyue should follow in the coming year.
quests.description_chs: 在璃月之地的海边，有一座伫立于坚岩的城市，「璃月港」。庇护着这座城市与璃月全境的，是你所要寻找的岩之神摩拉克斯，又名「岩王帝君」。你抵达璃月港时，恰逢一年一度的「七星请仙典仪」。每年的这一日里，岩王帝君都会赐下神谕，指引这一年璃月经营的方向。

quests.title: Alan Smithee, Author of Fischl
quests.title_chs: 艾伦·史密西，菲谢尔的作者
quests.description: You only stopped by the Adventurers' Guild to check for new commissions — it has nothing to do with the witch or her assignment. But it seems you stumble upon an unexpected surprise...
quests.description_chs: 和魔女的课题完全没有关系，你只是去冒险家协会看看工作委托而已。结果好像有意外收获？

quests.title: A Dry Well Doth Not Reflect the Stars
quests.description: Following the hints in the dictionary, you and Paimon decide to deliver the assignment to Mona. It should be a simple task... or so it seems.
quests.description_chs: 根据辞典的引导，你们准备把课题带给莫娜。看起来应该是再简单不过的事情了。

quests.title: Old Friends and New Knowledge
quests.description: Guided by the witch's dictionary, you head to Dragonspine to bring Albedo a brand-new assignment...
quests.description_chs: 根据魔女所赠予的辞典的引导，你们需要前往雪山，为阿贝多带去…新的课业？

quests.title: A Child Wandering the World
quests.description: Inside the witch's dictionary, you discover an unusual message that must be delivered to Durin...
quests.description_chs: 在魔女的辞典里，你们发现了一条非比寻常的「口信」，要将它带给杜林…

quests.title: Tales of Time and Wind
quests.description: The witch's dictionary doesn't mention any specific task related to Venti, but you still follow its guidance and search for him around Mondstadt...
quests.description_chs: 在魔女的辞典上，你们并未看见与温迪有关的具体课题…但你们依然按照辞典上的引导，前往蒙德城周围寻找温迪…

quests.title: With Lupical...
quests.description: According to the witch's dictionary, this assignment takes place in Wolvendom. Go there and see what awaits you this time...
quests.description_chs: 根据魔女所赠予的辞典的引导，这次的「课题」似乎需要在奔狼领进行，去奔狼领看看这次的「课题」是什么样的吧…

quests.title: The Law of Boundaries
quests.description: Sucrose is working on a new alchemical potion, but no matter how she tweaks the formula, it never comes out right...
quests.description_chs: 砂糖在炼制新的炼金药剂，不过，似乎炼制的药剂始终无法达到预期…

quests.title: Absolute Territorial Domination
quests.description: Absolute Territorial Domination
quests.description_chs: 绝对领域控制$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Great Mage's Journey of Trials
quests.description: The witch's dictionary also includes an assignment that Alice left for Klee. Why not drop by the Knights of Favonius headquarters and ask Klee about it?
quests.description_chs: 魔女的辞典里，也有艾莉丝为可莉留下的「课题」，如果有空的话，就去西风骑士团找可莉问问看吧？

quests.title: A Knight's Merit
quests.description: The Knights are busy preparing for an award ceremony in front of the Favonius Cathedral plaza...
quests.description_chs: 西风大教堂的广场之前，骑士们正为了即将到来的授勋仪式而忙碌着…

quests.title: A Knight's Pursuit
quests.description: What price must one pay in pursuit of power that surpasses mortal ken...?
quests.description_chs: 为了追寻超越凡众的力量，需要付出怎样的代价…

quests.title: A Knight's Resolve
quests.description: What decision will Lohen make in the face of irrevocable fate? And where will that lead him...?
quests.description_chs: 面对无可挽回的命运，洛恩最终下定的决意，会将他引向何方…

quests.title: An Impromptu Change of Plan
quests.description: During the rite, the appointed moment arrived. Yet when the clouds parted, a divine carcass crashed down to earth, knocking all the offerings over. Amid the chaos and confusion, the Qixing ordered that the assassin be arrested. Unable to prove your innocence, you were forced to accept the help of Childe of the Fatui, and as suggested by him, you are now headed for Jueyun Karst, a hidden abode where the adepti dwell...
quests.description_chs: 典仪吉时，仙驾如约而至。然而当云散霞收，落在香案上打翻了供品的，却是毫无生气的神躯。全场陷入迷茫与混乱，七星下令搜捕刺客。你难以洗清嫌疑，不得不在逃离过程中接受了愚人众执行官「公子」的帮助，按照他的指引，前往仙人隐居的「绝云间」…

quests.title: Wangshu
quests.description: You came across an adeptus, "Moon Carver." Seeing the keepsake you bore, he lent you his aid and protected you from the Millelith soldiers pursuing you. Upon learning of Rex Lapis' passing and the unjust accusations laid against you, Moon Carver expressed disdain for the Qixing's actions and began to suspect that they were behind what happened. He has sent you to find several other adepti and deliver a message to them.
quests.description_chs: 你在绝云间遇仙，仙人「削月筑阳真君」见信物出手，从千岩军手中保护了你。当「削月筑阳真君」得知神明死讯，又了解到你的冤情之后，它认为七星的表现令人失望，甚至推断七星可能正是幕后黑手，暗害了神明，以图执掌璃月大局。在它的授意下，你前去寻访各位隐居的仙人，转达口信。

quests.title: Moulder of Mountains
quests.description: Following the instructions of Moon Carver, you arrive at Mt. Hulao in order to meet with Mountain Shaper.
quests.description_chs: 遵循着「削月筑阳真君」的指点，你们来到了「琥牢山」，想要面见「理水叠山真君」。

quests.title: Custodian of Clouds
quests.description: Following Moon Carver's instructions, you arrive at Mt. Aocang in order to seek out Cloud Retainer.
quests.description_chs: 遵循着「削月筑阳真君」的指点，你们来到了「奥藏山」，想要面见「留云借风真君」。

quests.title: An Organization Known as Wangsheng
quests.description: Upon your return from visiting the Adepti, you discover that the Qixing have hidden the Geo Archon's vessel away. Childe promised he'd find someone to break the stalemate, so you pay another visit to Northland Bank.
quests.description_chs: 访仙归来之后，你得知岩神的仙体被「璃月七星」藏匿。「公子」答应为你寻找破局之人，为此，你再次前往「北国银行」…

quests.title: Troublesome Work
quests.description: Librarian Lisa seems annoyed about her work...
quests.description_chs: 图书馆的管理员丽莎，似乎正在对工作上的一些事情感到恼火…

quests.title: Lost Book
quests.description: Many people forget to return the library books they've borrowed, leaving Lisa no choice but to chase them and retrieve the books. Marjorie and Sara have agreed to return the books they borrowed as soon as possible, but Donna's seems to have been stolen. You decide to track the missing book down by following the trail left by an elemental marking Lisa made on it.
quests.description_chs: 有不少人借了图书馆的书却忘记归还，丽莎不得不去催讨。玛乔丽和莎拉都答应尽快还书，只有唐娜借的书似乎被偷走了。你们决定以丽莎留在书本上的元素标记为线索，追回丢失的书本。

quests.title: Moonfinger
quests.description: Childe introduced you to Zhongli, a consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. You agree to help Zhongli organize the Rite of Parting in the hope of seeing the Geo Archon again.
quests.description_chs: 「公子」为你介绍的人是「往生堂」的客卿，钟离。为了达成重见岩神的目标，你答应与他一起筹办「送仙典仪」。

quests.title: A Child's Secret
quests.description: At the feet of the Anemo Archon Statue in the plaza in front of Mondstadt Cathedral, you and Paimon discover a little girl playing with her imaginary friend...
quests.description_chs: 在蒙德教堂前、巨大神像脚下的广场，你和派蒙发现了一位小女孩，正在与「幻想朋友」一起玩…

quests.title: The South Wind Brings Adventure
quests.description: While investigating imaginary friends with Venti, Ellin asked you to search for the adventurer Jack within the Temple of the Lion. It seems he is traveling together with the legendary adventurer, Stanley.
quests.description_chs: 与温迪一同调查「幻想朋友」时，你受艾琳之托，前往南风之狮的庙宇，寻找冒险家杰克。据说他正与传奇大冒险家斯坦利结伴同行。

quests.title: Lionfang's Legacy
quests.description: Jack wants to search for Stanley's old weapons in secret, as they are the sword and shield passed down from the Lion of the South, and thus fascinate Jack greatly.
quests.description_chs: 杰克想要偷偷寻找斯坦利当年冒险所用的武器，那是继承自「南风之狮」的剑与盾，令他无比向往。

quests.title: Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land
quests.description: Jack returns home satisfied after a round of adventure. But Venti finds Stanley's behavior odd, and decides to investigate further...
quests.description_chs: 一段冒险经历后，杰克满意而归。但温迪却发现了斯坦利的异样，决定继续探究此事…
(test)控制温迪的空闲对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Three Poignant Perfumes
quests.description: Zhongli isn't concerned with the deicide itself, but with upholding Liyue's sacred traditions by giving a proper farewell to an archaic lord. Having selected a suitable batch of Noctilucous Jade, your next task is to prepare some perfumes as an offering to the Geo Archon.
quests.description_chs: 钟离不关心谋杀神明的奇案，只关心璃月的传统：辞行久远之躯。挑完仪式所用的夜泊石后，你们又开始准备祭神用的香膏。

quests.title: Shadow of the Past
quests.description: Master Jean has a special task for you. Head to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to find out more.
quests.description_chs: 西风骑士团的琴好像有一件特别的事想要拜托你，去骑士团总部看看吧。

quests.title: Speech and Etiquette
quests.description: You successfully locate Eula, who agrees to teach you the customs of the Lawrence Clan. To fulfill the task given to you by Master Jean, it seems you will need to undergo quite the rigorous training program...
quests.description_chs: 顺利找到优菈，她愿意传授给你劳伦斯家族的礼仪。为了顺利完成琴的请求，你需要接受一系列的训练…

quests.title: Through the Motions, to the Heart
quests.description: You get through the aristocratic conduct training, albeit with some hiccups along the way. During the training, you believe you may have discovered what shapes Eula's personality. You say goodbye to Eula and decide to act — first, you will procure a greeting gift, then you will meet with Schubert once more.
quests.description_chs: 礼仪相关的训练虽不算顺利，但你总算是完成了。训练过程中，你隐约了解到优菈性格的成因。在告别优菈之后，你决定动身，带上见面礼再一次面见舒伯特。

quests.title: Downtown
quests.description: Who would have guessed — Madame Ping is an adeptus! After leaving her household, which turned out to be a realm within a teapot, you proceed to Chihu Rock to continue preparations.
quests.description_chs: 未曾想到的是，萍姥姥竟是一位仙人。离开她隐居的「壶中洞天」之后，你们前往吃虎岩的市井，继续办事。

quests.title: The Realm Within
quests.description: After identifying Rex Lapis' preferred scent, Zhongli sends you to Yujing Terrace to seek out an old friend of his, Madame Ping, and borrow a certain Cleansing Bell. Strange... Zhongli seems to be avoiding his old friend...
quests.description_chs: 挑选出岩王帝君最中意的香膏之后，钟离拜托你去玉京台找一位朋友，萍姥姥，向她借取「涤尘铃」。奇怪的是，钟离似乎想对那位朋友避而不见…

quests.title: Guizhong
quests.description: You came to renowned purveyor of Liyue herbal medicine, Bubu Pharmacy, to procure some Everlasting Incense. But what started out as a straightforward trip to the pharmacy has turned into a far more complicated affair...
quests.description_chs: 为取「永生香」，你来到了璃月港最有名的药庐「不卜庐」。但这一次的行程，似乎也没有那么简单…

quests.title: Zhongli's Treat
quests.description: That Bubu Pharmacy trip turned into quite an exhilarating ride. (Okay, maybe not that exhilarating.) In yet another remarkable twist, Zhongli has offered to treat you to dinner!
quests.description_chs: 「不卜庐」的事件错综复杂，令人感慨（或者也没有那么感慨）。解决之后，钟离为表感谢，决定请客…？！
NPC调查对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Dust to Dust
quests.description: Having sought out the adepti and completed the task Moon Carver entrusted to you, you return again to Liyue Harbor to look for Childe. He tells you that the Liyue Qixing's response to the archon's passing has given him some food for thought...
quests.description_chs: 寻访完诸位仙人、完成了削月筑阳真君的嘱托之后，你重新回到璃月港内，寻找「公子」。而从后者那里，你听说了一个消息：对于神祇之死，「璃月七星」的反应十分耐人寻味…

quests.title: The Unexpected Guest
quests.description: Concerned about the situation down in The Chasm, you and Paimon decide to go investigate the area, only to run into someone altogether unexpected there...
quests.description_chs: 因在意层岩巨渊最下方的情况而与派蒙一同前去调查，谁知，竟在那里遇见了意料之外的人…

quests.title: The Floating Palace
quests.description: The mysterious emissary Ganyu appeared before you at Third-Round Knockout. Claiming to have come at Ningguang's behest, she invited you to the skyfaring palace known as the Jade Chamber. To that end, you and Paimon have come to Mt. Tianheng, from where you can see the Jade Chamber in the distance.
quests.description_chs: 在港口老窖「三碗不过港」，神秘使者甘雨现身，自称受凝光之托，请你前往天上的宫殿「群玉阁」一叙。为此，你与派蒙来到了能够遥望群玉阁的天衡山间。

quests.title: Who Is Mondstadt's Strongest Fighter?
quests.description: Customers at the Angel's Share have started debating the hottest topic on Mondstadt's streets: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"
quests.description_chs: 「天使的馈赠」的酒客们，议论起了蒙德街头巷尾的热门话题…

quests.title: The Mystery of the Girl in Red's Treasure
quests.description: You have heard people from various corners weigh in on who the strongest fighter in Mondstadt is, but have yet to get a definite answer. Outside the Knights headquarters, you have an unexpected meeting with one of the candidates for the title — Klee, who is in dire need of help to recover her stolen treasure.
quests.description_chs: 你们从各处听说了有关「蒙德最强战力」的各种情报，但仍然无法肯定这个问题的答案。在骑士团总部，你们意外遇到了「强者候选人」——可莉，而她正面临宝物失窃的危机，亟待帮助。

quests.title: A Very Volatile Treasure
quests.description: Klee's highly explosive "treasure" proved to be a remarkably swift solution to the Abyss Mage problem. However, she fled the scene after the explosion. Confused, you decide to return to the Knights headquarters and report the matter to Jean...
quests.description_chs: 可莉的宝物——「炸弹」，意外而又轻松解决了窃取宝物的黑手。然而爆炸过后，可莉却匆忙逃走，疑惑的你们决定先回到骑士团，向琴汇报情况…
自由对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Equilibrium
quests.description: After arriving at the Guizhong Ballista on Mt. Tianheng, you are surprised to meet another member of the Qixing there. Her name is Keqing, and she gives you detailed instructions on how to ascend to the Jade Chamber. Paimon, however, is preoccupied with another detail that Keqing mentioned: the custom of bringing a greeting gift.
quests.description_chs: 未曾想到，你在天衡山归终机附近，遇到了同为七星之一的刻晴。她指点了你登上群玉阁的真正方法。从刻晴的话里，派蒙捕捉到了「见面礼」这个关键词…

quests.title: Solitary Fragrance
quests.description: You finally ascended to the Jade Chamber, where Ningguang was waiting for you. She graciously accepted Paimon's gift, and offered one in return. You spoke at length about many things: deities, archons... and the Fatui...
quests.description_chs: 终于登上群玉阁时，凝光正在那里等待你。她收下了派蒙的礼物，并以另一件礼物回报。你与凝光聊了许多，话题有神灵，有「魔神」，还有愚人众…

quests.title: Heart of Glaze
quests.description: At Ningguang's advice, you verified the Fatui's schemes regarding the Sigil of Permission before continuing to help Zhongli prepare for the rite. You met Ganyu once again at Dihua Marsh before returning to Liyue Harbor — only to find that things in the city seem to be spiraling out of control.
quests.description_chs: 随凝光所指，确认了愚人众关于「百无禁忌箓」的阴谋之后，你继续与钟离一起筹办典仪，在荻花洲再次遇见了甘雨。在那之后，你们返回璃月港，却发现似乎有大事发生。

quests.title: Turning Point
quests.description: The adepti faced off against the Qixing outside the city. Just as things were coming to a head, you went to the Golden House to intercept Childe as he attempted to seize the Gnosis, only to find yet another twist: The Gnosis was never at the Golden House to begin with. Childe swiftly switched to his backup plan, attempting to force the Geo Archon to make an appearance by summoning an ancient god with Fatui-forged Sigils of Permission...
quests.description_chs: 仙人与七星在城外对峙，山雨欲来之际，你前往黄金屋阻止「公子」夺取神之心，却又发生了变故。神之心似乎并不在黄金屋，而「公子」为逼岩神现身，用「百无禁忌箓」召唤出了远古的魔神。

quests.title: The Fond Farewell
quests.description: The ancient god was subdued once again following a fierce battle and much sacrifice. The dust settles, and your journey in Liyue is reaching its conclusion with the Rite of Parting. But before that, there are still some mysteries regarding the Geo Archon that need unraveling.
quests.description_chs: 一番激战与牺牲，魔神重被镇压。尘埃落定之后，你在璃月的旅途也将随着「送仙典仪」的召开而接近终结了。但在这之前，还有一些与岩神有关的谜团等待你去揭开。
寻人启事$HIDDEN
活动开启间隔内NPC闲置对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Chasmic Maze
quests.description: The ground at the bottom of The Chasm suddenly collapsed, causing everyone to fall in. As it turns out, there is an unknown space further below, and everyone works together to investigate...
quests.description_chs: 层岩巨渊底层的地面突然崩裂，在场众人无一例外跌入其中。地底下竟有一处不知名的空间，为了离开此地，众人齐心协力展开调查…

quests.title: Danger All Around
quests.description: In order to escape from underground, the party keeps searching for a way out after getting some rest...
quests.description_chs: 为了逃离地底，众人养精蓄锐，休息过后试图再探出路…

quests.title: End of the Line
quests.description: After rendezvousing with Xiao, you and the others go over the curious and unsettling things you have seen underground...
quests.description_chs: 与魈成功会合后，众人怀着担忧，就地下种种怪事展开讨论…

quests.title: （test）芭芭拉线玩法白盒
quests.description: （test）现在是芭芭拉线的玩法白盒，白盒完成后会转为芭芭拉线。
quests.description_chs: (test)现在是芭芭拉线的玩法白盒，白盒完成后会转为芭芭拉线。$UNRELEASED

quests.title: At Tunnel's End, Light
quests.description: You and the others make a valiant joint effort and finally manage to escape from the underground at the very last minute...
quests.description_chs: 所有人齐心协力，终于在千钧一发之际逃离地底，重见天日…
活动开启间隔内NPC闲置对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Astrology and the 50-Year Pact
quests.description: You and Paimon went outside Liyue, intending to set off on an adventure...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙来到了璃月港外，打算出发去冒险…

quests.title: To Mondstadt
quests.description: The astrologist Mona, who you met by chance outside Liyue Harbor, has promised that if you go with her to Mondstadt to fulfill her appointment, she will help you read the truth behind the gods and your sibling. Leaving Liyue Harbor, you head towards Mondstadt.
quests.description_chs: 在璃月港外偶遇的占星术士莫娜答应你，只要跟着她去蒙德赴约，她就会为你占卜神明与血亲的真实。在告别璃月港后，你们向蒙德出发。

quests.title: A Bewildering Fate
quests.description: On your journey, you witness Mona's strength as an astrologist, as well as her constraints. At last, you arrive at your destination — Mondstadt.
quests.description_chs: 旅途之中，你见识到了莫娜作为占星术士的实力，以及她的矜持。终于，你们来到了旅途的终点——蒙德城。
派蒙有点担心莫娜的生活状况…$HIDDEN
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title: Little Chef on a Hunt
quests.description: On a clear and sunny day, you go for a walk to Springvale with Paimon.
quests.description_chs: 在一个风清日朗的日子，你和派蒙散步到了清泉镇附近…

quests.title: Cooking Appointment
quests.description: While out on a stroll, you bumped into a strange girl. This girl, a chef from Liyue by the name of Xiangling, is on a journey to seek out exotic ingredients. She enlists your help in a hunt, but your private hunting expedition appears to have earned the ire of Draff, the leader of the hunters. You head off to apologize to him...
quests.description_chs: 散步途中，你们偶然遇到了一位奇妙的少女。名叫香菱的少女来自璃月，是一位厨师，为了搜寻珍奇食材，她邀你们一道打猎。但你们私自狩猎野猪的行为似乎惹恼了猎户们的领头人杜拉夫，你们不得不去向他道歉。

quests.title: Secret Ingredient
quests.description: To your surprise, Draff did not intend to reprimand Xiangling, but instead wanted her to help promote Springvale's meat products instead. Sticking to her principles, Xiangling refused to cook for advertising, and would have left if she was not attracted to the smell of Brook's cooking. What began as a chat devolved into disagreement about how to prepare food, and ended in the declaration of a cook-off between the head chef of Springvale and the chef from Liyue.
quests.description_chs: 然而杜拉夫却没有责备香菱，而是请她推广清泉镇的肉产品。坚守原则的香菱拒绝为了宣传而烹饪，正打算离开时却意外地被清泉镇大厨布洛克的料理所吸引。交谈中，两人在如何处理食材的问题上产生了分歧，约定以料理决一高下。

quests.title: Lucky Find
quests.description: Xiangling believes that Lotus Heads and Jueyun Chilis alone will not let her prevail in the cook-off, and sets off to find more ingredients.
quests.description_chs: 香菱认为只凭莲蓬和绝云椒椒这样的食材还不足以取胜，为了寻找特别的食材她再次踏上寻找之路。

quests.title: Present From the Past
quests.description: Xiangling took a keen interest in the rumor that the ruins contain a gigantic Cryo Regisvine, and ran inside to investigate. Worried about her safety, you quickly follow the impetuous chef.
quests.description_chs: 听说遗迹中有巨大的急冻树，香菱产生了兴趣，急急忙忙跑进了地下遗迹。你们担心香菱冲动之下遇到危险，紧跟着也进入了遗迹。

quests.title: Cooking Showdown
quests.description: After obtaining the rare ingredients, Xiangling is finally ready for the cook-off. The showdown between the two head chefs is about to begin.
quests.description_chs: 得到了珍稀的食材之后，香菱终于做好了进行料理对决的准备。两位大厨之间的胜负即将开始。

quests.description_chs: （弃用）$UNRELEASED

quests.description: (Scrapped)

quests.title: A Teapot to Call Home: Part I
quests.description: The crisis looming over Liyue Harbor has calmed, and it's business as usual in the city. However, Madame Ping, the flower-admirer from Yujing Terrace, seems to have something more to discuss with you...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的危机已然平息，城中的事务也大多重回正轨。 不过，在玉京台赏花的萍姥姥似乎还有件事想和旅行者商量…

quests.title: Jade Chamber Rising
quests.description: Liyue Harbor is all abuzz with the news of the Jade Chamber's rebuilding. Go to Yujing Terrace and ask Ningguang for the details.
quests.description_chs: 璃月港内最近流传着有关「重修群玉阁」的消息，到玉京台找凝光打听一下详情吧。

quests.title: Across the Sea
quests.description: You and Paimon prepare to investigate a ruin near Lingju Pass...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙正在灵矩关附近，准备探索附近的遗迹…

quests.title: Teucer's Terrific Tour
quests.description: The Snezhnayan boy that you met by chance while investigating the Ruin Guards turned out to be Childe's younger brother Teucer. Childe requests that you keep his "identity" a secret and that you give the boy a tour of Liyue.
quests.description_chs: 在调查遗迹守卫时偶然邂逅的至冬国男孩，居然是「公子」的弟弟托克。「公子」拜托你帮他保守「身份的秘密」，并带托克先在璃月转转。

quests.title: Defender of Childhood Dreams
quests.description: Though the process was winding and awkward, Childe proved able to conceal his identity from his brother. Before Teucer could return to Snezhnaya, Childe agreed to his final request — to tour Liyue's Institute for Toy Research. But in truth, that Institute is...
quests.description_chs: 虽然过程有些狼狈，但「公子」还是在弟弟面前成功掩饰住了自己的身份。在托克回至冬国之前，「公子」答应了他最后的要求——参观璃月的「玩具研究所」。可那座「研究所」事实上是…

quests.title: Seagaze Sunset
quests.description: You hear about Sunset Vermillionite from Baizhu and decide to hit up Feiyun Commerce Guild for some information.
quests.description_chs: 从白术那里得知了鸣霞浮生石的情报，去飞云商会打听一下吧。

quests.title: Bygones Times Like Dust Passing
quests.description: Only two materials left to find. Time to ask around at the worksite.
quests.description_chs: 还剩两样材料没有找到，先去工地打听一下消息吧。

quests.title: Where the Heart Finds Rest
quests.description: The time when the Jade Chamber takes to the skies again is drawing closer. Who knows what will happen when it finally does?
quests.description_chs: 距离群玉阁升空的时刻越来越近了。不知道群玉阁升空后，又会发生什么事呢？
(test)间章隐藏任务刷群玉阁$HIDDEN
(test)间章隐藏任务临时传送$HIDDEN

quests.title: Seven-Star Selection
quests.description: As you stroll around Liyue, you bump into a familiar person...
quests.description_chs: 在璃月闲逛的时候，意外地遇见了一位熟悉的人…

quests.title: Candidature Analysis
quests.description: Yelan does not seem particularly reassured by Zhiyi and decides to go down to the wharf to speak to Bolai and find out how well he is rated by others.
quests.description_chs: 夜兰似乎对知易不太放心，决定到北码头找博来打听一下知易的风评。

quests.title: Shadow of Yore
quests.description: You and Paimon recognize a familiar face as you come aboard the Pearl Galley...
quests.description_chs: 行至珠钿舫，你和派蒙偶然认出了一张熟悉的面孔…

quests.title: Vortex's Wake
quests.description: After your chance meeting with Zhongli, you learn that a Fatuus named Kliment is trying to organize an archaeological expedition. Zhongli is roped in as a consultant, along with an archaeologist named Wanyan who volunteers for the task. Though you distrust the Fatui, you join up at Zhongli's invitation. The first subject of this investigation is Osial, Overlord of the Vortex.
quests.description_chs: 偶遇钟离之后，你得知愚人众克列门特正在组建考古小队，除了自告奋勇加入的考古学家宛烟之外，钟离也被聘请成为顾问。虽然你信不过愚人众，但在钟离的邀请下，你还是加入了这支考古小队，而你们的第一个调查目标，则是「漩涡之魔神」奥赛尔。

quests.title: A Ruin Under Lock and Key
quests.description: The expedition to investigate Osial in the Guyun Stone Forest came away with slim pickings. Kliment and Wanyan also clashed vociferously over their differing perspectives, which has greatly displeased the former. During the argument, he heard Wanyan mention the tale of the God of Salt, and decided to take the party there to try their luck, lest he finishes this venture empty-handed.
quests.description_chs: 孤云阁一行，关于「漩涡之魔神」奥赛尔的收获寥寥，克列门特和宛烟还因为观念不同发生了激烈的争吵，这都让克列门特很不开心。他在争吵中听到宛烟提起了「盐之魔神」的故事，为了不让此行一无所获，他决定带队前往地中之盐碰碰运气。

quests.title: Farewell, Sweet Salt
quests.description: With the aid of Zhongli's knowledge, you are able to undo the seals, but before entering the ruin, he lays a condition before Wanyan and Kliment: to alternate who gets claim to each treasure encountered, with only one object permitted per claim.
quests.description_chs: 借助钟离的知识，你们顺利地解开了封印，但在进入遗迹之前，钟离向宛烟与克列门特提出了一个契约：「顺次取物，每次一件」。

quests.title: A Record of All Things
quests.description: Within the ruins, Kliment and Wanyan each betray the contract in turn for personal reasons. As punishment, Kliment is cast out of the ruin and deprived of his reward. Wanyan is made to witness a truth that shatters her beliefs — the God of Salt was gentle but weak and was betrayed and slain as a result. Bearing witness to this incident and filled with conflicted feelings as a result, you follow Zhongli back to Guyun Stone Forest.
quests.description_chs: 遗迹之内，克列门特和宛烟都因为各自的原因违背了契约，作为惩罚，克列门特被剥夺了收获，赶出了遗迹，而宛烟，则是得知了令她信仰幻灭的真相——「盐之魔神」因为过于善良与软弱，招来了背叛与灭亡。作为见证者，心情复杂的你，跟随钟离回到了孤云阁。

quests.title: Foregone Conclusion
quests.description: You decide to announce the Zhiyi has passed the selection to make him lower his guard. Now all that's left to do is wait...
quests.description_chs: 决定宣布知易考察通过，以此来让他麻痹大意。在那之前只能等待…

quests.title: The Search for a Physician
quests.description: Someone seems to be asking for help outside Bubu Pharmacy...
quests.description_chs: 不卜庐门前，似乎正有人前来求助…

quests.title: The Quest for a Cure
quests.description: There seems to be something else going on with the poison in Jialiang's body...
quests.description_chs: 嘉良身上所中之毒，似乎另有隐情…

quests.title: The Formula for a Miracle
quests.description: The boundary between medicine and poison seems to have blurred, as has the line between life and death... Where can one find a truly perfect remedy, or does it exist at all?
quests.description_chs: 毒与药的界限已经模糊，生与死的边界也在动摇…问世间何处能求万全之方？

quests.title: The Illuminated Beast of the Sea of Clouds
quests.description: The three secretaries who originally worked at the Jade Chamber have appeared at Yujing Terrace. It looks like something has them tearing their hair out...
quests.description_chs: 原本在「群玉阁」工作的几位秘书现身在了玉京台，她们似乎正在为一些事情而焦头烂额…

quests.title: A Secretary in a Sea of Humanity
quests.description: Caught between the world of humans and adepti, Ganyu has descended into a funk. After she hits a snag in her plan to return to Jueyun Karst, you follow Ganyu back to Liyue Harbor, intending to resolve her misunderstanding that she has been dismissed from her post...
quests.description_chs: 内心徘徊于人类与仙人的夹缝间，甘雨陷入了精神上的困境。在回归绝云间的计划受挫后，你陪同甘雨回到了璃月港，试图解除甘雨自认为被排挤的误会…

quests.title: A Pact That Crosses Time
quests.description: Accepting the commission of the Tianshu, Uncle Tian, Ganyu very naturally slips into her work mode, coming to the aid of her junior colleague Huixin with ease in the latter's time of need. To express her thanks, Huixin invites you all to Xinyue Kiosk to have a meal...
quests.description_chs: 受到身为「天枢星」的天叔委托，甘雨很自然地进入了工作状态，顺利帮助了后辈慧心解决了工作上的困扰。为了表示感谢，慧心邀请你们来到新月轩参加饭局…

quests.title: Leisurely Chatter
quests.description: Paimon has a sudden yearning for the quirky stories told by Cloud Retainer. Go to Mt. Aocang to see this adeptus, with whom you are quite familiar.
quests.description_chs: 派蒙突然有点怀念留云借风真君讲述的种种趣闻，到奥藏山去见见这位相识已久的仙人吧。

quests.title: A Search for Secrets
quests.description: While eating at Wanmin Restaurant, you encounter Yuandai and Shuyu. Yuandai, forgetful in her old age, cannot remember her past, but perhaps her having once been a chivalrous heroine is a good place to start...
quests.description_chs: 在万民堂吃饭的时候，偶然遇到了远黛与漱玉。年迈健忘的远黛已经不记得曾经的事情，但或许可以从她当过侠客这一点入手调查…

quests.title: Lovely Dreams
quests.description: Unexpectedly, the final clue leads back to Mt. Aocang. Did Yuandai once live there? Why didn't Cloud Retainer mention this? Either way, time to head back there and see if Yuandai recalls anything.
quests.description_chs: 没想到最后的线索竟然指向奥藏山。远黛曾经在奥藏山生活过吗？为什么留云借风真君没有提起这件事呢？总之先回到奥藏山，看看远黛能不能想起什么吧。

quests.title_chs: (test)留云个人线隐藏任务发家具$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)留云个人线隐藏任务发家具$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Rumored Alchemist
quests.description: You arrive at Timaeus' alchemy store in Mondstadt one day to stock up on adventuring supplies. But here, you encounter someone altogether unexpected...
quests.description_chs: 某日，为了补充冒险物资，你来到了蒙德城蒂玛乌斯的炼金铺。在这里，你见到了一位意料之外的人…

quests.title: The Genius Researcher and the Seed of Another World
quests.description: While searching for Albedo, you encounter an odd-looking sister named Rosaria. She claims to know where Albedo is and expresses her willingness to show you the way.
quests.description_chs: 在寻找阿贝多的途中，你偶遇了一位有些奇怪的修女罗莎莉亚。她自称知道阿贝多的行踪，愿意为你带路。

quests.title: The First Experiment: Elements
quests.description: After finding Albedo, Rosaria leaves on her own. You chat with Albedo and discover the objective of his research: to use alchemy to cause a seed from another world to sprout and flourish. To better understand otherworldly lifeforms, Albedo states his desire to observe you and to perform some experiments in the process.
quests.description_chs: 在找到了阿贝多之后，罗莎莉亚便独自离去。你在和阿贝多的交谈中，得知了他的研究课题：使用炼金术让来自异世界的种子发芽并盛开。为了更全面地理解异世界生命，阿贝多提出希望观察同为异世界来客的你，并进行一些实验测定。

quests.title: The Third Experiment: Life
quests.description: After the elemental flow tests, Albedo asks you to display any special, otherworldly abilities you may have, though nothing comes of this. Still, Albedo's interest in you has not waned in the least...
quests.description_chs: 元素力流动实验之后，阿贝多希望你展现一些来自于异世界的特殊能力，然而最后并没有收获。不过，阿贝多对你的兴趣，似乎丝毫没有减弱…

quests.title: The Second Experiment: The World
quests.description: After the experiment begins, Albedo first checks your elemental flow. The result is that both your internal and external elemental flows run smoothly and that there is nothing unusual about them. These results seem very normal indeed, but according to Albedo, this is something to be happy about.
quests.description_chs: 实验开始之后，阿贝多首先为你检测了元素力流动的情况，结果是无论外部流动还是内部流动都很顺畅，没有发现什么异常。虽然结果听上去很普通，但据阿贝多所说，这似乎是值得高兴的结果。

quests.title: The Final Experiment: Withering Glory
quests.description: As the experiments proceed, Albedo obtains more and more data related to you, and the alchemy he envisages begins to take shape. Finally, after a simple test of your physical capabilities, the experiments draw to a close...
quests.description_chs: 随着实验的进行，阿贝多获得了越来越多关于你的研究数据，他脑中的炼金术猜想也在一步步成型。终于，在进行了看似普通的身体机能实验之后，实验即将来到尾声…

quests.title: The Master of Stars' Deception
quests.description: You discover some hilichurls near Wangshu Inn that are giving off dark energy, just as an adeptus who calls himself Starsnatcher is performing some exorcist arts nearby...
quests.description_chs: 你们在望舒客栈附近发现了一些沾染「邪气」的丘丘人，而一位自称「掇星攫辰天君」的仙人正在附近为「信众」们展示驱魔之术…

quests.title: Glimmers of the Vigilant Yaksha
quests.description: As payment to attain Starsnatcher's help, you prepare to go to Wanwen Bookhouse to purchase books about cooking. Upon arriving at the bookstore, you find...
quests.description_chs: 作为让「掇星攫辰天君」帮忙实现愿望的代价，你们准备前往「万文集舍」购买料理相关的书籍。而在那里遇到的是…

quests.title: The Purging of Evil
quests.description: Starsnatcher's ability to purge evil stems from the Sigil of Permission. After an unforeseen mishap, you give chase to a group of hilichurls with an evil aura...
quests.description_chs: 「掇星攫辰天君」的驱魔能力竟是源于「百无禁忌箓」的效果。在他这次意外失手以后，你们向着「邪气」丘丘人离开的方向追去…

quests.title: Insights of Drifting Dreams
quests.description: Under Xiao's guidance, you prepare to use adepti arts to recover the Sigil of Permission and warn the false adeptus of his evil ways. You will confront the false adeptus in a dream and teach him a lesson...
quests.description_chs: 为了回收「百无禁忌箓」并警示「假仙人」不要再作恶，你们准备在魈的指导下施展真正的「仙法」，让「假仙人」在睡梦中得到些教训。
(test)结尾处理魈$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Mysterious Wangsheng Parlor
quests.description: Your adventure takes you to Wuwang Hill, where Paimon senses that something is amiss...
quests.description_chs: 冒险行至无妄坡，派蒙好像觉得有什么不对劲…

quests.title: In Pursuit of a Phantom
quests.description: When you agreed to help Hu Tao and followed her to the Adventurers' Guild, you hadn't counted on becoming part of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's "business development" efforts. No topic is too sensitive for Hu Tao — certainly not matters of life and death — and even though some of her points make sense, you find them somewhat difficult to stomach. Then, when you voice your doubts about her approach, she tells you that she has long since moved on from business development to her next objective: finding someone called "Big G."
quests.description_chs: 为了帮助胡桃而前往冒险家协会，却没想到她想要做的是往生堂的「业务拓展」。在谈及生死的话题上胡桃毫不避讳，虽然她自有一套道理，但你总觉得不太能接受。当你道出疑虑之后，胡桃却惊讶地解释道，「业务拓展」早已结束，现在要寻找一位名叫狼哥的人。

quests.title: Friendships, Wishes, and Regrets
quests.description: Meng tells you that Big G is his childhood friend, who died by misadventure. Filled with regret and worry, Meng believes that due to a supernatural turn of events, Big G has become an evil spirit. Luocheng, another superstitious person who believes in ghost stories just like Meng, visits the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor seeking an exorcism. However, Hu Tao knows that the source of their worries is imaginary, so she comes up with an equally make-believe solution and organizes a fake exorcism. Surprisingly, the spirit of Big G appears before your eyes after the ritual.
quests.description_chs: 从老孟那里，你得知狼哥是他的童年好友，因意外身亡，而现今灵异事件频发，老孟认为是狼哥化作了厉鬼，心中颇为惋惜与担忧。和老孟同样相信凶鬼恶灵传说的，还有一位前来拜访往生堂驱咒的洛成。而胡桃知道让他们如此不安的东西其实只是心理作用，于是将计就计，设下了假的驱咒仪式。没想到仪式之后，狼哥的魂灵竟然主动出现了。

quests.title: Perfect Send-Off
quests.description: It turns out that Big G's spirit was attracted by the exorcism. Upon learning that Big G has not become a malevolent spirit and simply wanted to check on Meng and other childhood friends, Hu Tao decides to fulfill his wish and organize a farewell ceremony for him. To give him peace of mind, you collect keepsakes and well-wishes that Big G's childhood friends prepared for him. The only thing left now is to send him off.
quests.description_chs: 原来狼哥的魂灵是被驱咒仪式吸引而来，在了解到狼哥并非恶鬼，只是关心老孟以及其他童年好友的生活现状之后，胡桃决定满足他的心愿，并为他举办一个欢送仪式。为了解开狼哥的心结，你从他的童年好友那里获得了信物，还获得了他们对狼哥的祝福。现在一切就绪，只待启程与送别。

quests.title: Strange Sights, Stolen Souls
quests.description: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild in Liyue Harbor has a new commission for you. You and Paimon decide to find out what it's all about.
quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的凯瑟琳那里有新委托，你和派蒙决定前去看看。

quests.title: Truth in the Stones
quests.description: You arrive at the mine, the scene of the incident, and begin your investigation. A series of clues makes clear that there is nothing ordinary about this disappearance. What is the connection between the mysterious person behind this incident and the missing miners? Where did the missing miners disappear to? You have to know the truth.
quests.description_chs: 抵达案发矿区，你们展开了调查。接二连三的线索表明，这起失踪事件并不简单…隐藏在事件背后的神秘人物，与失踪矿工之间究竟有何联系？消失的矿工去了哪里？你十分在意。

quests.title: Shifting Earth and Lost Threads Come to Light
quests.description: The evidence at the mining site suggests that the miners followed the road north. You follow the trail, gradually closing in on them.
quests.description_chs: 从矿区找到的线索来看，工人们似乎沿着道路向北去了。你们一路追踪，不断缩减与他们的距离…

quests.title: Amidst Chaos, the Rock Is Unmoved
quests.description: Finally, you reach Nantianmen. A curious ancient tree has quietly stood here throughout the ages, bearing witness to all that has come to pass. To rescue the miners and solve this puzzle once and for all, you proceed to the ancient site that holds all the answers...
quests.description_chs: 最终，你们来到南天门一带。年代久远的奇树静静伫立在此，见证着岁月与山河。为了救回工人、解开谜团，你们一步步走向埋藏着答案的古老之地…

quests.title: Justice, for Books' Sake
quests.description: Paimon wants to know whether the Wanwen Bookhouse has the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide in stock.
quests.description_chs: 派蒙想在「万文集舍」找找看有没有《提瓦特游览指南》的璃月篇。

quests.title: Know Thyself, Know Thy Enemy
quests.description: Your book search sent you to Qingce Village to look for Chang the Ninth. But you arrived to find thugs are trying to force Chang into a bad business deal. Xingqiu won't stand for this, and wants to find out more about the business magnate behind it — Gentry Maocai.
quests.description_chs: 为了找书来到轻策庄拜访常九爷，却正好撞见强买强卖一事。同行的行秋忿忿不平，想要调查主导这桩生意的茂才公的底细。

quests.title: Calm Before the Storm
quests.description: It turns out Gentry Maocai needs a great deal of Cor Lapis to satisfy an order from the Fatui. Xingqiu has written a letter to the Feiyun Commerce Guild, hoping that they can help.
quests.description_chs: 原来茂才公想要完成和愚人众的订单，需要大量石珀。行秋写下了一封信，希望「飞云商会」能出手帮忙。

quests.title: Justice Is Its Own Reward
quests.description: As per Xingqiu's plan, the Feiyun Commerce Guild bought up all the Cor Lapis in Liyue Harbor. All that remains is to purchase Chang the Ninth's batch and Gentry Maocai will have nowhere left to turn.
quests.description_chs: 按照信中的计策，「飞云商会」成功收购了璃月港能买到的所有石珀。只要能买下常九爷手上的石珀，茂才公就陷入了无料可用的绝境。

quests.title: A Private Commission
quests.description: Kamisato Ayaka seems to have something to discuss with you. Meet up for a chat with her at Komore Teahouse.
quests.description_chs: 神里绫华似乎有话要说，到木漏茶室前找她聊聊吧。

quests.title: Woven Wishes
quests.description: At Ayaka's request, you and Paimon accompany her to prepare gifts necessary to meet "Tsubaki."
quests.description_chs: 受神里绫华委托，你和派蒙陪她一起准备与「椿」见面所需的礼物。

quests.title: Food From Afar
quests.description: While the clothes are being made, Ayaka suggests that you and Paimon come with her to Kiminami Restaurant to dine.
quests.description_chs: 衣物制作期间，神里绫华提出带你和派蒙去「木南料亭」用餐。

quests.title: Lasting Promise
quests.description: Having prepared the gifts, you travel together to the place where "Tsubaki" lives.
quests.description_chs: 备齐礼物之后，你们一同前往「椿」的住处。

quests.title: With You
quests.description: Now knowing that all this came from her mother's childhood wish, Kamisato Ayaka invites you to go with her to Amakane Island to take part in a festivity that she has been looking forward to for a long time now.
quests.description_chs: 得知一切都是源自母亲小小的愿望之后，神里绫华鼓起勇气邀请你和她一起前往甘金岛，参加她向往已久的祭典。

quests.title: The Oni's Evil
quests.description: Inazuma's Katheryne would like you to help conduct an emergency investigation...
quests.description_chs: 稻妻的凯瑟琳希望你去调查一个紧急的事件…

quests.title: The Firework Girl's Strange Stories
quests.description: You've been in Inazuma for a while now, but your investigations continue. One day, you and Paimon arrive at the seaside...
quests.description_chs: 抵达稻妻已经有一段时间，你和派蒙的探索还在继续。某一天，你们来到了海边…

quests.title: Expectations Not to Be Betrayed
quests.description: You return with Yoimiya to Naganohara Fireworks, but discover a stowaway hiding inside the shop named Sakujirou. To prevent his capture at the hands of the Tenryou Commission, you must find a way for him to leave Inazuma while preparing for a fireworks show.
quests.description_chs: 和宵宫回到「长野原烟花店」，却在偶然中见到了藏身于店内的偷渡者朔次郎，为了让他不被天领奉行众抓获，只好在准备烟花会的同时，为他寻找逃离稻妻的方法。

quests.title: A Sliver of Hope
quests.description: Though you and Yoimiya managed to secure Sakujirou's passage out by sea, he wavers, unable to reconcile himself to his wish. It is at this moment that Yoimiya recalls an old couple among Naganohara Fireworks' clients who might be able to help him out.
quests.description_chs: 虽然和宵宫一起为朔次郎准备好了出逃的船，但未能了却心愿的他依然犹豫不决。此时宵宫突然想起，在「长野原烟花店」的顾客中，有一对老夫妻可能可以帮上朔次郎的忙。

quests.title: Together Under the Fireworks
quests.description: Unexpectedly, this old couple's child is the Tenryou Commission's Imatani Keisuke, an old acquaintance of Sakujirou's. However, the two of them once had a sharp disagreement, and so Yoimiya is unable to use this prior relationship to help Sakujirou out of his bind. As the Tenryou Commission closes in on Naganohara Fireworks, Yoimiya fears that Sakujirou will forever forfeit his chance to fulfill his wish...
quests.description_chs: 没想到这对老夫妻的孩子，现为天领奉行众的今谷佳祐，竟然是朔次郎的旧识。由于两人曾经发生了激烈的争吵，宵宫也无法利用这层关系解决朔次郎的困局。 与此同时，天领奉行众也追查到了「长野原烟花店」，宵宫担心朔次郎会永远错过了却心愿的机会…

quests.title: The Lonesome Euthymia
quests.description: Your adventure has come to an end for now. You and Paimon decide to pay the Statue of the Omnipresent God a visit...
quests.description_chs: 冒险告一段落，你与派蒙打算再去千手百眼神像看看…

quests.title: To Traverse the Mortal Plane
quests.description: The Shogun seems to be indisposed for some reason, but you, quite unexpectedly, manage to invite Ei to come forth from her Plane of Euthymia. You decide to take her on a trip around town for a change of pace.
quests.description_chs: 将军由于某些原因无法行动，你却意外地将居于「一心净土」中的影请了出来。为了帮她换个心情，就带她在城里随意转转吧。

quests.title: The Fabric of Constancy
quests.description: With you as her tour guide, Ei witnesses a great many new things and even seems to be enjoying herself. You decide to remember this leisurely time by taking a picture.
quests.description_chs: 在你的引领下，影见识到了许多新奇事物，显得很享受的样子。为了纪念这段难得的休闲时光，你提议为她留影。

quests.title: To Hear Mortal Hearts
quests.description: Ippei says that Kujou Kamaji has gone to see the head of the Takatsukasa Clan. Ei decides to go there personally to settle the issue of the Tenryou Commission's internal affairs. Thus, you and Ei head out into the wilds, toward the secret base of the Takatsukasa Clan...
quests.description_chs: 一平说九条镰治去见鹰司家的家主，至今没有归来，影决定亲自出面解决天领奉行内部的问题。于是，你和影一同前往位于野外的鹰司家的隐秘驻地…

quests.title_chs: (test)隐藏任务用于播放八重神子最后的闲置对话$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)隐藏任务用于播放八重神子最后的闲置对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Watatsumi Sightseeing
quests.description: The war is over, and you have received a letter from Kokomi, saying that Watatsumi Island is going to hold a Victory Feast, and that she would like you to attend. However, when you arrive on Watatsumi Island, you find that not all is right with the world here...
quests.description_chs: 战争结束后，你收到了心海的来信，海祇岛正在准备庆功晚会，心海希望你也能来一起参加。 然而，当你抵达海祇岛的时候，却发现这里似乎有些不太对劲…

quests.title: Rumors Abound
quests.description: Peace talks between Watatsumi Island and the Tenryou Commission are due to commence, but a rumor that the Tenryou Commission remains in cahoots with the Fatui is still circulating around the island. To uncover the truth, Kokomi decides to assault the Fatui's temporary encampment...
quests.description_chs: 海祇岛与天领奉行的和谈将近，岛上却出现了「天领奉行与愚人众仍有勾结」的传言。为了调查真相，心海决定进攻愚人众临时营地…

quests.title: Her Secret
quests.description: You have agreed to meet Kokomi near Sangonomiya Shrine. Time to move out.
quests.description_chs: 与心海约定第二天在珊瑚宫附近见面，早点动身出发吧。

quests.title: Victory Banquet
quests.description: Go to the site of the Victory Feast with Kokomi and listen to her speech.
quests.description_chs: 与心海一起前往篝火晚会现场，听心海发表庆功演说。

quests.title: New Beginning
quests.description: You hurry towards the site where the peace talks are to begin. What will the future of Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate look like?
quests.description_chs: 与心海一同赶往和谈现场。海祇岛与幕府的未来，到底会往什么方向发展呢？

quests.title: The Oni's Justice
quests.description: You set off to Yashiori Island using the clues Sango provided...
quests.description_chs: 根据珊瑚提供的线索，你出发前往八酝岛…

quests.title: The Oni's Pride
quests.description: After Daisuke points out the inconsistencies in his story, Arataki Itto is forced to reveal to you that he is currently acting to protect the blue oni. To ascertain the truth, you agree to set out with Itto once again.
quests.description_chs: 被大辅发现蹊跷后，荒泷一斗不得不和你讲明了缘由：他所做的一切都是为了袒护青鬼。为了见证真相，你再次与荒泷一斗一同出发。
(test)鬼婆婆闲置对话任务$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: Mysterious Urban Legend
quests.description: You planned to visit the Yae Publishing House, but after arriving in Hanamizaka, you find that it is more lively than usual here...
quests.description_chs: 本想去八重堂看看，没想到来了花见坂之后，却发现这里比平时更加热闹…

quests.title: Friendship in Writing
quests.description: It turns out that Youhei and Shingo had summoned a spirit with the method recorded in "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." Yae Miko suggests going to the Yae Publishing House to discuss how to respond...
quests.description_chs: 原来洋平与信悟是用了《真实探灵笔记》中记载的方法进行了降灵。八重神子提出到八重堂前商议对策…

quests.title: A Centuries-Long Dream
quests.description: The light novel is a great hit. It has successfully outshone "A Firsthand Guide to Summoning Spirits." Now, it is time to catch the spirit behind it.
quests.description_chs: 轻小说大获成功，顺利削弱了《真实探灵笔记》的影响，也是时候把幕后凶手抓出来了。

quests.title: Banquet of Parting
quests.description: What can we do for these youkai? If you were to answer honestly, it could only be a grand farewell party.
quests.description_chs: 我们能为那些妖怪们做些什么呢？平心而论，大概只有一场盛大的欢送会吧。

quests.title: New Shoots from Old Branches
quests.description: As you and Paimon pass by Ogura Textiles & Kimonos, you bump into two rather familiar people...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙路过「小仓屋」，意外遇到了两位熟人…

quests.title: The Truth Is Also a Lie
quests.description: As you go off to send your well-wishes, Ayato gradually realizes that there is some plot at play behind this wedding. According to his reasoning, you are rapidly approaching the truth...
quests.description_chs: 在送上祝福的过程中，神里绫人渐渐察觉到这场婚姻背后隐藏着不为人知的阴谋。根据他的推理，你们正在迅速靠近真相…

quests.title: The Wind Settles
quests.description: Ayato claims that your job is done and that all that remains is to wait for the Kanjou Commission's internal reaction. Will things really proceed as he thinks they will?
quests.description_chs: 神里绫人称应做之事已经完成，接下来就静待勘定奉行内部的反应。事情真的会如他预料那样发展吗…

quests.title: Upon the Plain, a Purple Shadow
quests.description: You and Paimon travel near Byakko Plain on your journey...
quests.description_chs: 在冒险的途中，你和派蒙来到白狐之野附近…

quests.title: Through the Mist, a Name Unveiled
quests.description: To prevent the attacker from causing more harm, you and Kazuha decide to investigate his identity.
quests.description_chs: 为了防止袭击者造成更多伤害，你和枫原万叶决定去调查他的身份。

quests.title: Ere the End, a Glance Back
quests.description: As it turns out, the one behind the missing person case is a cursed blade that has possessed Amenoma Yuuya's body. To save the latter and to prove the absurdity of the blade's fixation, Kazuha eventually takes up the cursed blade himself.
quests.description_chs: 原来失踪事件的罪魁祸首就是控制了天目优也的妖刀。为了拯救天目优也，也为了证明妖刀的想法荒谬可笑，枫原万叶最终亲自拿起了妖刀。

quests.title: Cleansing Light
quests.description: The Adventurers' Guild in Inazuma seems to have a commission concerning the Sacred Sakura...
quests.description_chs: 稻妻的冒险家协会，似乎有一项关于神樱树的委托…

quests.title: Farewell to the Past
quests.description: Many people's memories have escaped from the damaged roots of the Sacred Sakura. Raiden Ei takes the opportunity to tell you many stories about her cherished friends and the Inazuma she wants to protect.
quests.description_chs: 神樱树破损的根系中逸散出了许多人的回忆，雷电影借此机会向你讲述了她所珍视的友人，以及她想要保护的稻妻的诸多故事。

quests.title: Radiant Sakura
quests.description: In Raiden Makoto's remnant realm of consciousness, Ei and the Shogun Puppet engage in an endless fight. For Inazuma, and also for Ei herself, you wish to lend a hand — as you once did — to help her get through this sore test.
quests.description_chs: 在雷电真残存的意识空间之内，影和人偶将军开始了看不到尽头的战斗。为了稻妻，也是为了影，你想要像过去那样帮助影，让她能顺利通过此番艰苦的考验。

quests.title: Encounter in the Realm of Dreams
quests.description: Following Paimon's whim, you return to Inazuma where you encounter an unknown youkai. Intrigued by this small creature, you are drawn into a moonlit encounter...
quests.description_chs: 因为派蒙的心血来潮而重返稻妻的你偶遇了某种不知名的小妖怪，你被它吸引着，踏入了一场月下的邂逅…

quests.title: Crisis at the Aisa Bathhouse
quests.description: You and Paimon follow the address on Mizuki's invitation and find your way to the Aisa Bathhouse. However, before you take the chance to enjoy a pleasant soak, it strikes you that business at the bathhouse isn't going so well...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙使用瑞希赠送的邀请函找到了那家名为秋沙钱汤的店，但在享受服务之前，你们发觉这家店的经营情况似乎很不乐观…

quests.title: A Deceit Called Happiness
quests.description: The financial troubles at the Aisa Bathhouse appear to be almost over when a sudden turn of events turns everything on its head. You and Mizuki soon realize that the root cause of the crisis still persists...
quests.description_chs: 秋沙钱汤面临的经营危机似乎即将过去，但一场变故又突然来临。你和瑞希都意识到，你们并没有解决危机的根源…

quests.title: Descendant of Nightmares
quests.description: On a lonely and desolate island, you and Mizuki discover the hiding place of Emura Chuuya. It seems that the truth behind the recent nightmares may well be lurking inside...
quests.description_chs: 在荒无人烟的孤岛上，你和瑞希找到了江村中弥的藏身地。有关近期这些噩梦事件的真相，似乎就潜藏其中…

quests.title: Afterword
quests.description: The nightmare crisis has finally been resolved and you have received a new invitation letter from Mizuki. Finally time for Paimon to enjoy the all-inclusive spa day she's been so looking forward to...
quests.description_chs: 魇带来的危机终于被彻底解决，你也从瑞希那里收到了新的邀请函，派蒙终于可以享受她心心念念的全套服务了…
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Start of Contamination
quests.description: You haven't gone to see Katheryne in a while. Why don't you go have a look?
quests.description_chs: 有段时间没有见到凯瑟琳了，要不要过去看看呢…？

quests.title: Into the Hinterland
quests.description: With the mechanical crab as your guide, it is time to head to the contaminated region.
quests.description_chs: 有了机械螃蟹充当「导游」，是时候前往污染区深处了。

quests.title: Heart of the Machine
quests.description: The mechanical crab has stopped at a certain point. The source of the contamination seems to be within.
quests.description_chs: 机械螃蟹停在了某个地方，里面似乎就是污染区的源头。

quests.title: Garden Memories
quests.description: Now that you've left the lab, you should inform Katheryne that the contamination issue has been resolved.
quests.description_chs: 离开实验室后，首先要将污染解除的消息告知凯瑟琳…
（test）任务结束后NPC处理环$HIDDEN
（test）凯瑟琳奖励$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Warm Rhythm of the Streets
quests.description: To prepare supplies for your adventure, you and Paimon come to the Grand Bazaar...
quests.description_chs: 为了筹备冒险物资，你和派蒙来到了大巴扎…

quests.title: Show Canceled
quests.description: With your encouragement, Nilou decided to debate with the Akademiya scholar about the demolition of the theatre. Thus, she needs to collect a lot of information.
quests.description_chs: 在你的鼓励下，妮露决定就剧场拆除一事和教令院学者进行辩论。为此，她需要收集很多论据。

quests.title: The Reason We Are Gathered Here
quests.description: Everything is ready and now it's up to Nilou's performance in the debate.
quests.description_chs: 一切准备完毕，接下来就看妮露在辩论中的表现了。

quests.title: Suspicious Smuggling Case
quests.description: You decide to take a look around the Akademiya...
quests.description_chs: 你们决定到教令院看看…

quests.title: Chain of Interests
quests.description: You repelled the chasing mercenaries and now it is time to leave for the desert.
quests.description_chs: 打跑了不停威逼利诱的佣兵团，是时候动身去沙漠了。

quests.title: All Returns to Silence
quests.description: It seems that even a matra is involved in the Canned Knowledge smuggling. Cyno decided to let you take the secret letter back to the Akademiya and enter the Restricted Repository to procure information.
quests.description_chs: 似乎连风纪官都卷入了罐装知识走私案中，赛诺决定让你携带密信返回教令院，进入秘密资料室打探消息。

quests.title: Dream of Awakening
quests.description: One day, you and Paimon notice that many people in Sumeru City are talking about dreams...
quests.description_chs: 某天，你和派蒙在须弥城里，听到了很多人在讨论梦境的话题…

quests.title: Dream of Falling
quests.description: You realize that many people may be experiencing unusual dreams just like Ilman. To prevent the dreams from causing more harm, you must return to "A Moment of Dreams" to take measures.
quests.description_chs: 你们意识到可能有许多人都和埃勒曼一样，正在经历不同寻常的梦境。为了避免这场梦产生更多危害，你们必须尽快返回「品梦一刻」采取措施。

quests.title: Dream of Farewell
quests.description: The artificial dream failed to erase suffering but instead created a sweet illusion. It has gone out of control and eventually collapsed. Everyone has now returned to reality with mixed feelings...
quests.description_chs: 人为创造的梦境并没有消除苦难，只是制造了甜蜜的骗局。它在失控中轰然崩塌，众人终于怀抱着复杂的心情回到了现实…
(test)火堆熄灭控制任务$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: Where Lies the Path Home
quests.description: One day, you and Paimon run into an old friend at Sumeru's city gates...
quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙在城门口偶遇了一位熟悉的朋友…

quests.title: Fragmented Testimony
quests.description: You've heard that Alhaitham has become the Acting Grand Sage. Considering his personality, will the other scholars accept him? Time to pay the Akademiya a visit.
quests.description_chs: 听说艾尔海森当上了代理贤者，以他的性格真的没问题吗？去教令院打听一下吧。

quests.title: A Thorough Investigation
quests.description: Ilyas remembered two things that he had to do, one of which is to collect his pay at the Research Preparation Center.
quests.description_chs: 伊利亚斯记得自己有两件不得不做的事，其中一件是去调研筹备处领取薪水。

quests.title: Pride and Prejudice
quests.description: While stopping by Gandharva Ville, Ilyas managed to recover his memories. It's now time to follow him to Siraj's hideout.
quests.description_chs: 在化城郭，伊利亚斯恢复了过去的记忆。他说自己想起来了西拉杰的藏身之所，跟他一起去看看吧。

quests.title: Shade Upon Red Silk
quests.description: One day, you and Paimon stop by the Grand Bazaar...
quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙行至大巴扎…

quests.title: Annals of the Scarlet Sands
quests.description: During your investigation, you accidentally stumbled upon Dunyarzad's father's name. After discussing the matter with Dehya, she decides that Dunyarzad should be informed of all that has transpired...
quests.description_chs: 在调查中，你们意外发现了迪娜泽黛父亲的名字。商量之后，迪希雅认为要把整件事告诉迪娜泽黛…

quests.title: Sincerity's Facade
quests.description: The truth is revealed. Dehya's father has long passed. Still, his comrades in arms seek to avenge him. Before judgment falls, Dehya decides to lend them her aid.
quests.description_chs: 原来迪希雅的父亲早已亡故，团员们一直都想为他复仇。在审判降临之前，迪希雅选择成为他们的助力。

quests.title: What Shape Does the Self Hold
quests.description: From your investigation, it seems that Apep might be terminally ill. To learn how to save it, you must make a trip to The Chasm and find a special elemental life-form.
quests.description_chs: 在调查中得知，阿佩普很可能已经病入膏肓。为了知晓拯救它的办法，你们必须去一趟层岩巨渊，寻找一只特殊的元素生物。

quests.title: Another Home There May Yet Be
quests.description: The elemental life-forms' "family" linger around for a long time. In order for them to be reunited one day, you have to first properly deal with the parting in the present moment...
quests.description_chs: 元素生命的「家人」久久没有离去。为了有朝一日它们还能重聚，也需要妥善处理眼前的分别…

quests.title: The Seeker of a Meteor Shower
quests.description: Back in Inazuma, Yoimiya is preparing for a romantic journey...
quests.description_chs: 稻妻城的少女正在筹备一次浪漫的旅行…

quests.title: All Things Flawless and Pure
quests.description: You and Paimon tell Yoimiya that meteor showers respond to people's wishes. In response, Yoimiya wants to spend some time getting herself ready for the occasion...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙告诉宵宫流星雨会回应愿望而出现，宵宫想要为此做一些准备。

quests.title: A Flower that Blooms Across the Sky
quests.description: Avin doesn't want to forget her Aranara friend, so you resolve to help her recover the wonderful memories of her past. The Aranara you summoned is also happy to lend a hand...
quests.description_chs: 艾文不愿忘记自己的兰那罗朋友，你们决定帮她把曾经美好的回忆都找回来，这件事也得到了应召而来的兰那罗的帮助。

quests.title_chs: （test）补充爱尔海森个人线全局变量$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: （test）补充爱尔海森个人线全局变量$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Mysterious Letter
quests.description: You and Paimon return to Sumeru to visit some local friends.
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙回到须弥探望当地的朋友们。

quests.title: After Repose
quests.description: It's been some time since your last meeting. You and Paimon are invited to go camping with Cyno, Tighnari, and Collei.
quests.description_chs: 许久不见，你和派蒙受邀与赛诺、提纳里及柯莱一同露营。

quests.title: Footprints Sunken Beneath the Sands
quests.description: Cyrus's strange situation puts everyone on alert, and Cyno went after him alone. As his friends, you, Paimon, and Tighnari could never turn a blind eye to his predicament.
quests.description_chs: 居勒什的异样情况引起众人警觉，赛诺更是独自前去追他。作为好朋友，你、派蒙和提纳里绝不会对他的困难坐视不理。

quests.title: Sage of Sages
quests.description: Sethos leads you into the ancient Temple of Silence. There, you learn why Cyrus went into the desert alone, and the origin of Cyno's power. Next, it's time to face the requirements of the Temple of Silence.
quests.description_chs: 赛索斯带你们进入古老的缄默之殿，在那里，你们得知了居勒什孤身进入沙漠的原因，以及赛诺身上这份力量的来由。接下来，就该面对缄默之殿的要求了。

quests.title: The Dead Past is the Living Present
quests.description: After the sands have settled, you and the others bid farewell to the ancient grounds and return to the Akademiya...
quests.description_chs: 事情告一段落，你们一行人将告别古老之地，返回教令院…
(test)4.6赛诺2隐藏父任务$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Phantom Thief's Reappearance
quests.description: The bustling streets of the Court of Fontaine seem more lively than usual. Why not take a walk around?
quests.description_chs: 枫丹廷的街道似乎比平时更热闹，四处转转吧。

quests.title: The Magician's Secret
quests.description: Lyney and you agreed to meet outside Hotel Debord. Go meet him at the appointed time.
quests.description_chs: 与林尼约定在德波大饭店门口碰面，在约好的时间去见他吧。

quests.title: The Truest Thing
quests.description: With the Phantom Weasel arrested, Lyney's show can finally take place. Fingers crossed that everything goes smoothly...
quests.description_chs: 怪盗貂被抓捕归案，林尼的魔术秀可以顺利举办了。希望一切顺利…

quests.title: The Interview
quests.description: What's made headlines today? Go to The Steambird and check it out!
quests.description_chs: 今天的报纸上会写什么呢？到蒸汽鸟报社附近看看吧。

quests.title: An Opportunity for Rebirth
quests.description: You and Paimon arrive at the dormitories in the Fortress of Meropide...
quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙来到梅洛彼得堡的监舍区域附近…

quests.title: The Proud "Beret Society"
quests.description: Through your conversation, you learn of an organization known as the "Beret Society" that provides support for prisoners who feel helpless and lonely. Wriothesley suggests that you come with him and take a look at their daily lives.
quests.description_chs: 聊天中，你们知晓了名为「檐帽会」的组织，正在为迷茫或孤独的罪人提供帮助。莱欧斯利提议一同去看看这些人平时的生活。

quests.title: It's What He Deserves
quests.description: Evidence from Avice suggests that the Beret Society's leader, Dougier, has been using extremely cruel methods to control its members. No one could sit there and watch such evil deeds unfold.
quests.description_chs: 阿维丝提供的证据指出，「檐帽会」的会长杜吉耶为了控制手下的成员，使用了非常残忍的手段。对此恶行，无论是谁都无法坐视不管。

quests.title: A Familiar Threat
quests.description: Paimon is curious about Neuvillette. Go talk to him.
quests.description_chs: 派蒙对那维莱特很好奇，去找他聊聊天吧。

quests.title: Ever-Surging Memories
quests.description: Neuvillette comes up with another way to investigate — using his powers to search for memories and emotions within the Fountain of Lucine. You hope everything goes as planned...
quests.description_chs: 那维莱特想到了一个新的调查办法，就是利用他的力量对露景泉进行感知，查找其中可疑的记忆与情感。如果能顺利就好了…

quests.title: In a New Light
quests.description: You learn of the culprit's name from the criminals Navia gathered. However, that person is currently at the Fortress of Meropide. It looks like you'll have to make a trip down there...
quests.description_chs: 从娜维娅带来的嫌犯口中问出了主谋的名字，但这个人此刻正在梅洛彼得堡，看来需要亲自跑一趟那里…

quests.title: To Yesterday
quests.description: One day, you and Paimon arrive at the Adventurers' Guild to check out the commissions there...
quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙来到冒险家协会查看委托…

quests.title: Whither Should the Water Flow?
quests.description: Having met with the troupe, you learn two critical members have yet to return. First is Pauleau, who is responsible for completing the script. He is in Poisson.
quests.description_chs: 与剧团成员交谈了解到，还有两位关键成员没有回到剧团中，首先是负责创作后续剧本的波洛，他正在白淞镇。

quests.title: This Life, Just Like a Light Trickle of Song
quests.description: The members of the troupe do not see eye to eye on the ending of the script, and everyone believes they should hear what the last member, Vilmant, has to say on it. So, you set off from Poisson...
quests.description_chs: 剧团成员在剧本的走向上存在分歧，众人认为需要听取最后一位成员维尔芒的意见。于是你们从白淞镇动身…
(test)4.2水神线隐藏父任务$HIDDEN

quests.title: Shimmering Memories
quests.description: One day, you are stopped by a familiar voice while in the Court of Fontaine...
quests.description_chs: 某日，你们在枫丹廷被熟悉的声音叫住…

quests.title: Lost and Inherited
quests.description: Colter tells you stories of the Spina di Rosula's past. After a rest, it is time to head off to the Court of Fontaine.
quests.description_chs: 在水边科尔特讲述了刺玫会曾经的故事，休息之后，该继续向枫丹廷出发了。

quests.title: Yesterday's Tears, Tomorrow's Light
quests.description: You have a pleasant time and a fine night in the Fleuve Cendre. It is time to go and give the clothes you picked up to Adele.
quests.description_chs: 在灰河度过了充实而快乐的一夜，现在应该出发，将取到的衣服送给阿黛尔了。

quests.title_chs: (test)娜维娅个人线隐藏父任务孤儿$HIDDEN

quests.title: Where Honed Blades Clash
quests.description: A fashion festival is being held in Fontaine. You and Paimon decide to check it out for yourselves...
quests.description_chs: 枫丹似乎正在举行一场时尚盛典，你和派蒙决定前去一探究竟…

quests.title: Stained Spots
quests.description: If the hem of a skirt is stained, can it still take the stage?
quests.description_chs: 若是裙摆沾上了污渍，那它还能否登上舞台…

quests.title: The Woven and the Cut
quests.description: What should one forsake, and where should one persist? The answer that the designer gives amidst cutting and knitting is...
quests.description_chs: 该舍弃什么，又该坚持什么？这是设计师在裁剪与编织中要给出的答案…

quests.title: The Child Who Doesn't Exist
quests.description: It's a fine day. Yes, a fine day for a stroll around Poisson!
quests.description_chs: 天气不错，抽空去白淞镇逛逛吧。

quests.title: Sea Breeze Rendezvous
quests.description: After discussing the plan with Lyney and the others, you go to the seaside to meet The Knave in an attempt to distract her...
quests.description_chs: 与林尼他们商定了作战计划，去附近的海边见见「仆人」，想办法引开她的注意…

quests.title: Birds in a Cage
quests.description: After hearing some "secrets" of the House of the Hearth from Clervie, the conflicts between the children have begun to surface...
quests.description_chs: 听克雷薇讲述了一些壁炉之家的「秘闻」，孩子们之间的矛盾也逐渐浮出水面…

quests.title: Into the Sunlight
quests.description: The Knave is well aware of the plans Lyney and the others have hatched. She proposes a deal that seems to be a good chance to get to the bottom of all this...
quests.description_chs: 「仆人」对林尼他们的动向一清二楚，同时提出了一个交易。这似乎是搞清真相的好机会…

quests.title: Beauty Expert
quests.description: The Court of Fontaine seems to be holding quite a lively promotion event.
quests.description_chs: 枫丹廷似乎正在举办一场促销活动，非常热闹。

quests.title: Switcheroo
quests.description: After Sigewinne finally finishes a busy day as head nurse, it seems as though a new problem has already arrived...
quests.description_chs: 希格雯作为护士长的忙碌一日终于结束，但新的麻烦似乎已经到来…

quests.title: Underground Crime
quests.description: A new clue discovered in Rawat's mother's residence seems to be a critical piece of evidence allowing the investigation to proceed.
quests.description_chs: 在拉瓦特母亲住处意外发现的线索，成为了让调查能够继续下去的关键情报。

quests.title: The Truth of What Was
quests.description: The many-layered mysterious case caused by cosmetics has now been fully solved, and after Sigewinne finishes helping the Marechaussee Phantom wind up the case, she prepares to tell you a story about the past...
quests.description_chs: 由一款美妆产品引发的重重谜案终于被彻底告破，希格雯协助逐影庭完成了最后的收尾工作，而她也准备好向你讲述一段往事…

quests.title: "Judgment Day"
quests.description: On the streets of the Court of Fontaine, a pair of familiar faces seem to need your help...
quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷的街道上，好像有两位熟悉的友人需要帮助…

quests.title: Hunters' Gathering
quests.description: "A long, long time ago..."
quests.description_chs: 「很久很久以前…」

quests.title: Buried Honor
quests.description: There seems to be something unusual about today's story...
quests.description_chs: 今天的故事，似乎有些不同寻常…

quests.title: Vanquishing Phantoms
quests.description: "Now, as we face the perils of the long night..."
quests.description_chs: 「至此，直面长夜之危…」

quests.title_chs: (test)克洛琳德线镜像大世界入口控制$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)克洛琳德线镜像大世界入口控制$HIDDEN

quests.title: Top Note: Floral Debt
quests.description: Port Ormos has been exceptionally lively lately. It looks like preparations for something big are underway...
quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港最近热闹非凡，似乎正在筹办什么大事…

quests.title: Middle Note: Blood Due
quests.description: The disputes behind "Auguste" seem to be far more complex than you expected...
quests.description_chs: 「奥古斯都」背后牵涉的纠葛，似乎远比你们预想的多…

quests.title: Base Note: Auguste
quests.description: The true identity of "Kirya" has finally been exposed... His path of vengeance reaching its end.
quests.description_chs: 「基里亚」的真身终于暴露…他的复仇之路也将迎来尽头。

quests.title_chs: (test)希格雯个人线隐藏父任务控制group卸载$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)希格雯个人线隐藏父任务控制group卸载$HIDDEN

quests.title: Shaped by Fame
quests.description: Navia seems to be keeping an eye on something in front of Hotel Debord...
quests.description_chs: 娜维娅似乎在德波大饭店门口观察着什么…

quests.title: Roasted by Flames
quests.description: As Escoffier promised, a fiery culinary showdown is about to begin...
quests.description_chs: 爱可菲如约而至，一场炽烈的料理对决即将展开…

quests.title: Ice-Frosted Endgame
quests.description: Behind the turmoil, a cold truth awaits...
quests.description_chs: 风波背后，藏着冰冷的真相…
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title: A Mysterious Visitor From Huitztlan
quests.description: You encounter two kids beneath the cliffs outside the Scions of the Canopy tribe. They seem to require some help...
quests.description_chs: 在悬木人部族外的山崖下偶遇了两位小朋友，他们看起来需要帮助…

quests.title: A Hero's Rite
quests.description: Having arrived at the Scions of the Canopy, you meet the young girl you helped before, Huni...
quests.description_chs: 来到了悬木人部族，你们再次遇见了之前帮助过的小女孩胡妮…

quests.title: Kinich's Deal
quests.description: An unexpected encounter finds you just as you are planning to go to Elder Trinidad's dwelling...
quests.description_chs: 你们正打算前往特立尼达长老的住处，一位意外人士却抢先找到了你们…

quests.title: I, Flame Bearer
quests.description: Following your deal with Kinich, you prepare to walk around the tribe, making room for him to maneuver...
quests.description_chs: 依照与基尼奇的交易，你们准备在部族里逛逛，为他拉扯出一些行动的空间…

quests.title: The Last Turnfire Night
quests.description: Having finished your preparations, the last Turnfire Night approaches...
quests.description_chs: 你们做好了准备工作，最后的回火夜也将来临了…

quests.title: Those Searching for the Mysterious Island
quests.description: While wandering in the wilderness, you hear two tourists crying for help, and you and Paimon decide to aid them...
quests.description_chs: 在野外游历的你听到了两名游客的呼救声，你和派蒙决定施以援手…

quests.title: The Legend of the Mysterious Island
quests.description: Your curiosity having been piqued, you decide to head to the People of the Springs, and ask the tribal leader about the legends of the mysterious island.
quests.description_chs: 被勾起好奇心的你们决定前往流泉之众，向部族首领打听有关神秘岛的传说。

quests.title: Someone Trustworthy
quests.description: It turns out that in order to reach the mysterious island, it is necessary to have a guide, one with whom mutual trust is shared...
quests.description_chs: 原来前往神秘岛的必要条件是一名可以互相托付的向导…

quests.title: Where the Koholasaurs Gather
quests.description: The predeparture preparations are complete. It's time to go to the location you and Mualani agreed on...
quests.description_chs: 出发前的准备都已经完成，是时候前往与玛拉妮约定好的地点了…

quests.title: The Riddle of Sea and Sky
quests.description: Mualani successfully figures out the next destination based on the clues found in the valley, but it seems that new challenges await you there...
quests.description_chs: 根据从山谷中拿到的线索，玛拉妮成功找到了下一个目的地，但那里似乎又有新的挑战等待着大家…

quests.title: The Mysterious Island's Truth
quests.description: You finally determine the mysterious island's location, but whether or not you'll be able to finish your journey as you desire remains to be seen...
quests.description_chs: 你们终于确定了神秘岛的最终所在，但能否如愿完成神秘岛之旅，犹未可知…
(test)父任务描述$HIDDEN

quests.title: Tepetli Dissonance
quests.description: Within the Children of Echoes, Imix, from Muhuru's Gemporium, seems to have run into some major difficulties...
quests.description_chs: 在「回声之子」中，「穆胡鲁宝石铺」的伊蜜似乎遇见了大麻烦…

quests.title: Threadlike Whispers
quests.description: The time you and Tlazolli agreed upon has almost arrived. You prepare to pay her a visit to check on the Blazegem Inscription's progress.
quests.description_chs: 与特拉佐莉的约定时间快到了，你们准备再次前去拜访，询问燃晶名刻的制作进度。

quests.title: A Faint Signal Lingers
quests.description: Xilonen has caught a glimpse of the Blazegem Inscriptions' forging process and has guessed what Tlazolli means to use them for. For safety reasons, she will dismantle this particular Inscription and analyze its inner workings first, and then decide whether to help Tlazolli save the gravely ill Nechca.
quests.description_chs: 希诺宁已经窥到了「燃晶名刻」的制作工艺，也推测出了特拉佐莉制作它的用意。为了保险起见，她会在完全拆解这枚「燃晶名刻」，并完全分析其内部结构后，再决定是否要帮助特拉佐莉拯救重病的妮赫佳。

quests.title: Wailing Cacophony
quests.description: Tlazolli has revealed her true intentions, coercing "Nechca" into her self-proclaimed "abandoned" workshop. If you wish to save the child who sought your help, you must pursue them.
quests.description_chs: 特拉佐莉已然露出了自己的獠牙，她胁迫着「妮赫佳」前往了自己那座对外宣称已废弃的工坊。如果想要拯救那个向你们求救的孩子，就必须追上去。

quests.title: Serenity's Reprise
quests.description: Tlazolli awaits her punishment, Nepecha has regained her "name," and the Blazegem Inscriptions are about to be destroyed. The nightmare and entrapment have both dissipated, and it is all over. Xilonen has also brought Nepecha to her own workshop. Perhaps she still has something in mind...
quests.description_chs: 特拉佐莉正等待着接受惩罚，妮佩卡重新获得了自己的「名字」，「燃晶名刻」也即将被销毁。噩梦与囚笼都消弭于无形，一切都结束了。希诺宁也已经将妮佩卡带回了自己的工坊，或许，她还有着下一步打算…

quests.title: Hoarse Echoes
quests.description: You visit Cheven at the agreed-upon time. At her invitation, you decide to see the former master artisan Tlazolli.
quests.description_chs: 你们按照约定的时间去拜访了夏温。在她的邀请下，你们决定去见一见那位「前铸名师」特拉佐莉。

quests.title: Ardent Land of Plenty
quests.description: As you arrive at the outskirts of the Great Volcano of Tollan, you come across a young girl by the roadside...
quests.description_chs: 行至图兰大火山外围，你们在路边偶遇了一位少女…

quests.title: The Wingless One of Tlalocan
quests.description: There seems to be a crestfallen person near the Flower-Feather Clan...
quests.description_chs: 在花羽会附近，似乎有位失意的人…

quests.title: The Night Before the Trial
quests.description: After resolving the Wingless's problem, you rush back to the trial site...
quests.description_chs: 解决完失翼者的问题后，你们又赶往试炼场地…

quests.title: Tracks Through the Wilderness
quests.description: The Flower-Feather Clan's flying trials have officially started, but a shocking sight greets those at the site...
quests.description_chs: 花羽会的飞行试炼正式召开，但在试炼现场却出现了惊人的一幕…

quests.title: Mortal Pursuit
quests.description: Coya attacked humans to rescue her daughter. The clues point toward a craftsperson named Tepal...
quests.description_chs: 柯娅为了救回自己的女儿奇梅而袭击了人类。如今一切线索都指向一位名叫「特帕尔」的工匠…

quests.title: Time for the Showdown
quests.description: In the distant skies, far from the surface, the airborne workshop bears silent witness to the amassing and annihilation of obsession...
quests.description_chs: 在远离地面的高天之上，空中工坊沉默地见证着执念的堆积与毁灭…

quests.title: Calling from the Masters of the Night-Wind
quests.description: After happening across a baby Iktomisaurus, a mysterious presence guides you into the Masters of the Night-Wind's settlement...
quests.description_chs: 偶遇了一只幼年暝视龙之后，某种神秘的存在引导你进入烟谜主的驻地…

quests.title: Legendary "Color"
quests.description: You accept the Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind's commission, and are determined to complete the task that you have been entrusted with...
quests.description_chs: 你接受了烟谜主首领的嘱托，决心完成自己被赋予的使命…

quests.title: A Commission Catches You in Natlan
quests.description: You and Paimon bump into a squad of Fatui at the Masters of the Night-Wind, and you meet their employer. Thus does a commission from Fontaine find its way to you...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙在烟谜主部族驻地偶遇了一支愚人众小队，并结识了他们的雇主，一份从枫丹追来的委托就此找上了你…

quests.title: Please, great shaman!
quests.description: After you sincerely beseech her, Citlali finally agrees to help. But to your surprise, Granny Itztli's name does not merely bring with it assistance...
quests.description_chs: 在你的诚恳请求下，茜特菈莉终于答应出山帮忙。但令你意外的是，黑曜石奶奶的名号带来的似乎不只是助力…

quests.title: Seven-Hued Ruins
quests.description: With Citlali's assistance, you find the ruins left behind by the Battle of Seven Colors. However, the truth that awaits your discovery is far beyond your expectations...
quests.description_chs: 在茜特菈莉的协助下，你们成功找到了七彩之战的遗址。然而，等待你们揭开的真相似乎远比预想中要多…

quests.title: The Color of Memory
quests.description: After all has been settled, Citlali invites you to her dwelling. It seems she's found an answer to the question that was troubling her before...
quests.description_chs: 妥善解决事件后，茜特菈莉邀你前往她的住所，之前困惑她的那个问题似乎终于有了答案…

quests.title: Sage Supreme
quests.description: The fateful day of the Epic Feast Showdown has arrived, and you hunger for the taste of challenge.
quests.description_chs: 转眼间就到了「豪宴热斗」开始的日子，你们决定前往挑战。

quests.title: The Meaning of Courage
quests.description: With hearts as one, you and Varesa set out to investigate the true identity and intentions of the Sage-Lord of Fungi.
quests.description_chs: 下定决心之后，你们和瓦雷莎一起行动起来，调查「蕈之贤主」的真实身份与它的目的。

quests.title: Smokeless War
quests.description: You've finally found some key materials. All that's left is to cook the mushroom and see what happens...
quests.description_chs: 终于寻到了关键的材料，接下来就是烹饪蘑菇，看看会发生什么…

quests.title: Orchard Repose
quests.description: Varesa accompanies you to her home, the Collective of Plenty, to introduce you to the local customs.
quests.description_chs: 瓦雷莎陪同你们来到她的家园「沃陆之邦」，打算为你们介绍这里的风土人情。

quests.title: Sinister Undercurrent
quests.description: On an otherwise ordinary day on the road, you suddenly feel a strange discomfort...
quests.description_chs: 在旅行中寻常的一天，身体却莫名地感到不适…

quests.title: Special Training
quests.description: Skirk agrees to help investigate the mysterious person's whereabouts. In the meantime, you should work on improving your strength.
quests.description_chs: 丝柯克答应帮忙调查神秘人的下落。在此期间，努力提升自身的实力吧。

quests.title: All Devouring
quests.description: Your training is over and Skirk has located the culprit behind the scenes. Proceed with caution.
quests.description_chs: 特训结束，丝柯克也定位到了幕后真凶所在之处，小心地前进吧。

quests.title: Heart and Mind
quests.description: Skirk's strength is returning quickly but she still doesn't seem to be satisfied. She thinks something's wrong with her body and hopes to solve her problems through meditation. You arrange to see her in a couple of days. Hopefully, everything works out as planned...
quests.description_chs: 丝柯克的力量恢复得很快。但她似乎对此仍不满意，认为身体出了什么问题，想要通过冥想来解决。与她约定两天后再次见面，希望一切顺利…

quests.title: Unbounded
quests.description: After reconciling with herself, Skirk awakens once more and reclaims her full powers. It's time to teach the culprit a lesson.
quests.description_chs: 重新醒来后，与自身和解的丝柯克重新取回了力量。该给幕后真凶一点教训了。

quests.title: To a Carefree Vacation!
quests.title_chs: 出发！无忧无虑的度假之旅？
quests.description: As summer blooms once more, you and Paimon arrive in Tenochtzitoc and prepare yourselves for a carefree vacation...
quests.description_chs: 夏日再临，你与派蒙来到了特诺奇兹托克，准备迎接一场无忧无虑的度假之旅…

quests.title: To Colorfall Cliffs!
quests.description: Bennett told you about a scenic spot called "Foamflower Fields" at Colorfall Cliffs...
quests.description_chs: 你听班尼特说「彩彩崖」有着一处名为「沫彩花海」的胜地…

quests.title: To Guiztli Ridge!
quests.description: Chasca told you about some head-to-head challenges at Guiztli Ridge...
quests.description_chs: 你听恰斯卡说「刺梨岩」有些具备对抗性质的的挑战项目…

quests.title: To Wavey Bay!
quests.description: Mualani told you about the many aquatic attractions on offer at Wavey Bay...
quests.description_chs: 你听玛拉妮说「浪浪湾」有着丰富的水上项目…

quests.title: The World Is Your Canvas!
quests.title_chs: 畅玩！举目之处皆为画布！
quests.description: The warm sunlight shines on your back, urging you to set off once again. Well, what are you waiting for? Stretch your legs and enjoy the Easybreeze Holiday Resort with all your friends!
quests.description_chs: 暖融融的阳光照耀后背，催促你们再次出发。那还等什么呢？撒开脚丫，与同伴们在悠悠度假村尽情游玩吧！

quests.title: The Surprise That Awaits Us All!
quests.description: The Easybreeze Album is filled with the happy memories of your time spent with everyone. At last, the time has come for prizes to be presented...
quests.description_chs: 悠悠纪念册填满了你与大家共度的欢乐时光，终于，兑奖的时间到了…

quests.title: A Curtain Call for a Colorful Summer Night!
quests.description: Until the sun rises once more...
quests.description_chs: 直到太阳又一次升起…
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title: Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!
quests.description: The flagship attraction, "Twilight Cruise," is waiting for professional testers...
quests.description_chs: 大型游乐项目「暝导游船」正等待着专业的测试员…

quests.title: Time to Test the Asha Speedrun!
quests.description: The flagship attraction, "Asha Speedrun," is waiting for professional testers...
quests.description_chs: 大型游乐项目「阿夏快跑」正等待着专业的测试员…

quests.title: A Mother's Last Wish
quests.description: While traveling, you receive a sudden invitation from Alice. She hopes you and Paimon can help Durin fulfill a wish — one connected to his late mother, "M"...
quests.description_chs: 在外游历的你忽然收到了艾莉丝的邀请，她希望你和派蒙能帮助杜林完成一件事，而这件事正好与杜林的母亲——那位已经逝世的魔女M有关…

quests.title: A Prophecy From the Past
quests.description: The story in the book seems to describe Durin's experiences. Curious about what remains untold, you and Durin step back into its pages to uncover the missing parts of his story.
quests.description_chs: 书中的故事所描述的似乎是杜林的经历，你和杜林都很好奇这个故事还有什么等待补全的地方。于是你们再次进入了书中的世界，寻找那些尚未被揭示的秘密…

quests.title: Fate's Accursed Wiles
quests.description: The book reveals that Durin is bound by a curse born of prophecy. You recall how a blessing once helped him overcome it in Simulanka — maybe reliving that moment will complete the story...
quests.description_chs: 书中的故事告诉你们，杜林背负着来自一个预言的诅咒。但你想起了在希穆兰卡用祝福帮助杜林战胜诅咒的往事，在书中重现这件往事，或许就是补全这个故事的办法…

quests.title: Revelation Beneath the Stars
quests.description: Why do people start to forget Durin? You and Paimon have no clue. Just then, the magic book offers another hint — M's story does not end in Simulanka. And the next chapter seems to lead to where Durin first set foot in this world...
quests.description_chs: 杜林为何会被他人遗忘？对于如何解答这个问题，你和派蒙都没有头绪。这时，魔法书又给出了新的提示——原来魔女M书写的故事并没有在希穆兰卡迎来结局，新的篇章似乎指向了杜林刚刚来到这个世界时落脚的地方…

quests.title: The Solution of Fate
quests.description: Following the clues from the previous chapter, you head to Dragonspine to find Albedo. It seems the mysteries around Durin are about to be revealed, but the trials prepared by "fate" are waiting for you as well...
quests.description_chs: 根据从上一个篇章中获得的线索，你们前往蒙德雪山寻找阿贝多。杜林身上的谜团似乎都将在这里获得解答，但「命运」准备的难题也已经等候多时…

quests.title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
quests.description: The book gives no new hints for now. You decide to rest for a while before meeting Durin again...
quests.description_chs: 魔法书还没有给出后续篇章的提示，你决定休息一段时间再去找杜林…

quests.title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
quests.description: The book gives no new hints for now. You decide to rest for a while before meeting Durin again...
quests.description_chs: 魔法书还没有给出后续篇章的提示，你决定休息一段时间再去找杜林…

quests.title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
quests.description: Durin's unexpected accident disrupts your original plans, and you have no choice but to wait for him to wake up...
quests.description_chs: 杜林遭遇的意外打乱了你们原先的计划，你们不得不先等待杜林醒来…

quests.title: Interlude: A Moment's Rest
quests.description: You find an important clue, but until Albedo returns, the full truth remains out of reach...
quests.description_chs: 你们已经找到了关键的线索，但在阿贝多回来之前，你们仍旧无从得知完整的答案…

quests.title: Triumphant Warrior
quests.description: Through everyone's united efforts, the Abyssal calamity in the north seems to have been quelled...\nThe day of triumph draws near.
quests.description_chs: 在众人的奋战之下，北方的深渊灾厄似乎已经平定…\n凯旋之期，已在近前。

quests.title: Fated Warrior
quests.description: The scryglass reflects visions of the future, the wolf spirit harbors memories of the past...\nThe threads of fate are ever-changing.
quests.description_chs: 水占盘里倒映出未来的幻景，狼灵之中寄宿着往昔的追忆…\n命运之数，变幻无常。

quests.title: Lonely Warrior
quests.description: Even if you had an army of ten thousand men, in the end, you must face this fight alone...\nStep forward... lonely warrior.
quests.description_chs: 来时纵有千军万马，末路亦不免孤军奋战…\n孤独之人，请上前来。

quests.title: The Championship Begins
quests.description: Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.
quests.description_chs: 在挪德卡莱度过了一段安宁祥和的时光，去问问凯瑟琳最近有没有什么值得注意的事情吧。

quests.title: Twice Upon a Gaze
quests.description: Having completed the qualifiers successfully, Linnea suggests going to Speranza to celebrate properly...
quests.description_chs: 顺利完成海选赛后，莉奈娅提出去斯佩兰扎好好庆祝一下…

quests.title: Tread the Right Path
quests.description: After waking from her dream, Linnea decides to seek Celaeno out once more and uncover the whole truth.
quests.description_chs: 梦醒之后，莉奈娅决定再次去找刻莱诺，问清楚一切的真相。
