(test)隐藏$HIDDEN
(test)父任务描述$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Bough Keeper: Dainsleif
quests.description: Katheryne of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to tell you.
quests.description_chs: 蒙德城冒险家协会的凯瑟琳小姐似乎有什么事想要告诉你…

quests.title: Sister Victoria's Vexation
quests.description: Sister Victoria seems to be troubled by something...
quests.description_chs: 维多利亚修女似乎因为某事而发愁…

quests.title: Sudden Shouting
quests.description: Someone suddenly starts calling for Barbara in Wolvendom...
quests.description_chs: 在奔狼领中，突然有人大声呼喊着芭芭拉…

quests.title: The Church's Affairs
quests.description: At Barbara's request, you head back to Mondstadt to report to Sister Victoria.
quests.description_chs: 在芭芭拉的拜托下，先回到蒙德城，向维多利亚修女回报。

quests.title: The First Chilibrew Ingredient
quests.description: To make some Chilibrew, Barbara has asked you to look for some fresh Jueyun Chilis near the Stone Gate.
quests.description_chs: 为了制作辣味饮料，芭芭拉拜托你前往石门附近，寻找新鲜的绝云椒椒。

quests.title: Knight and Deaconess, Ready for Battle!
quests.description: Repel the Treasure Hoarders and rescue the merchant being threatened by them.
quests.description_chs: 击退所有盗宝团，救下被盗宝团胁迫的商人。

quests.title: The Second Chilibrew Ingredient
quests.description: To make some Chilibrew, you prepare to go with Barbara to the Whispering Woods to look for some Sweet Flowers.
quests.description_chs: 为了制作辣味饮料，你准备和芭芭拉一同去低语森林附近采集甜甜花。

quests.title: Ulterior Motive...?
quests.description: Defeat the suspicious person
quests.description_chs: 击退可疑人士。

quests.title: Healing Is My Job
quests.description: To heal Uwe, you accompany Barbara to search the Whispering Woods for Small Lamp Grass.
quests.description_chs: 为了给乌维治疗，你和芭芭拉一同前往低语森林搜集小灯草。

quests.title: A Very Special Beverage
quests.description: After helping to clean up the Cathedral, you get ready to meet Barbara at The Cat's Tail.
quests.description_chs: 处理完了教堂的清扫事宜，你准备前往猫尾酒馆附近与芭芭拉汇合。

quests.title: Give It Up!
quests.description: Sayu has been discovered by Kano Nana, and has no choice but to return to Chinju Forest to practice ninjutsu. She begs you to come along, and so you do...
quests.description_chs: 早柚被鹿野奈奈发现，不得不返回镇守之森修习忍术。在早柚的央求下，你也只能同往…

quests.title: A Mysterious Order
quests.description: As you walk through Inazuma City, you feel a strange gaze from somewhere around you.
quests.description_chs: 你行走在稻妻城中，突然感受到周围某处投来了异样的视线…

quests.title: Bottleneck Breaking
quests.description: You tell Sayu that she needs enough nutrition to grow tall. She follows you enthusiastically to Inazuma City...
quests.description_chs: 你告诉早柚想要长高的话需要补充足够的能量，于是她兴冲冲地和你前往稻妻城…

quests.title: Sleep Alone Can't Wait
quests.description: Rather than working or training, Sayu thinks that sleeping is of the utmost urgency and importance.
quests.description_chs: 相比起工作和训练，早柚觉得还是抓紧时间睡觉更重要。

quests.title: Operation Substitution
quests.description: So Sayu wanted you to learn ninjutsu so that you could replace her at work...
quests.description_chs: 原来早柚想让你学会忍术，这样就可以代替她工作了。

quests.title: Shuumatsuban Suspicions
quests.description: You decide to investigate the Shuumatsuban personally. You and Sayu decide to lure the person who gave the order out...
quests.description_chs: 你决定亲自去调查「终末番」之事，于是你打算和早柚一起把下达命令的人引出来…

quests.title: Countryside Wandering
quests.description: Yunning of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe is currently outside Liyue branch of the Adventurers' Guild, fretting over someone's disappearance.
quests.description_chs: 云翰社的经理韵宁，似乎正在璃月港的冒险家协会外，为某人的失踪发愁…

quests.title: Accidental Encounter
quests.description: You meet Gorou and Yae Miko near Yae Publishing House. Gorou seems to be somewhat troubled...
quests.description_chs: 在八重堂附近遇到了五郎与八重神子，不知为何五郎看上去有些困扰…

quests.title: What Shall We Do?
quests.description: You decide to help Gorou find a way to defeat Yae Miko so that he may exorcise his fears.
quests.description_chs: 为了帮助五郎克服恐惧，你决定与五郎一起寻找战胜八重神子的方法。

quests.title: Special Training
quests.description: To help Gorou exorcise his fears, you play the roles of people he is not good at dealing with. However...
quests.description_chs: 为了帮助五郎克服恐惧，你决定扮演五郎不擅长应对的人。然而…

quests.title: Hard to Track
quests.description: As you approach the wharf of Liyue Harbor, an unusually-dressed young man comes up to you, asking after some really strange business...
quests.description_chs: 行至璃月港码头附近，有一位衣着不同寻常的少年想要向你打听一些奇怪的见闻…

quests.title: Distant Gaze
quests.description: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits. He seems a little dejected when you point this out. As he uses a popsicle to suppress his pure-yang spirit, you both feel someone's gaze on you from the side.
quests.description_chs: 少年方士重云掌握了很多听上去不太可靠的妖邪情报，在你提醒了他之后，他显得有些沮丧。在他用吃冰棍的方法压制纯阳之体的时候，你们都感觉到了从一旁投过来的视线。

quests.title: The Exorcist's Path
quests.description: Dalong leaves after having been given half the popsicles, feeling quite pleased. After this small interlude, you and Chongyun continue discussing evil spirits. Chongyun hopes to tap on your abundant experience as an adventurer to adjudge the truth or falsehood of information concerning evil spirits. To that end, you head to Wanwen Bookhouse together.
quests.description_chs: 将冰棍分了一半给大隆之后，大隆满意地离开了。小插曲之后，你和重云的话题又回到了「妖邪」之上。重云希望能借助你丰富的冒险经验，判断「妖邪」的真伪，于是，你们一起前往了「万文集舍」。

quests.title: Popsicles and Their Curious Uses
quests.description: Dalong leaves after having been given all the popsicles, feeling most pleased. For Chongyun, these popsicles are essential to suppressing his pure-yang spirit, and so he must have some on his person at any given time. The two of you head to Wanmin Restaurant to restock.
quests.description_chs: 重云将所有的冰棍都送给了大隆，大隆非常开心地离开了。对重云来说，冰棍是压制纯阳之体必不可少的东西，必须随身携带。于是，为了获得更多的冰棍，你和重云决定前往「万民堂」。

quests.title: For A Child's Smile
quests.description: Chongyun's mind is still on that kid named Dalong even after you've made some more popsicles. The two of you head to Chihu Rock, intending to give the new popsicles to him as well.
quests.description_chs: 做好更多的冰棍之后，重云还惦记着之前那个名叫「大隆」的孩子。于是，你和重云结伴前往吃虎岩，打算把新做的冰棍送到他手上。

quests.title: Secret Identity
quests.description: You were here at Yae Publishing House to keep watch, but...
quests.description_chs: 本来想前往八重堂望风，没想到…

quests.title: A Friend's Path
quests.description: While writing replies, Gorou encounters a letter from one of his subordinates and is once again troubled...
quests.description_chs: 写回信时看到部下的来信，五郎似乎也陷入了新的烦恼…

quests.title: Ordinary Memorial
quests.description: Gorou says that his box is at the Adventurers' Guild. Go with him to ask Katheryne.
quests.description_chs: 五郎说自己有一个盒子在冒险家协会，跟五郎一起去问问凯瑟琳吧。
（test）处理桌椅隐藏$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Test of Courage
quests.description: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits, but you decide not to expose this fact out of courtesy. The way Chongyun sees it, the most likely spot for evil spirits to show up is Wuwang Hill, where a Test of Courage is currently taking place. The test requires two people to go in together, so you accept his invitation and accompany him there...
quests.description_chs: 少年方士重云掌握了很多听上去不太可靠的妖邪情报，出于礼貌，你并没有当面拆穿这一点。在重云看来，最有可能有妖邪出没的地方，是正在举办试胆大会的无妄坡。由于试胆大会需要双人结伴入场，你答应了重云的邀请，与他同往…

quests.title: Sudden Discomfort
quests.description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. To prevent his constitution from going out of control, you look for something that might help suppress his pure-yang spirit...
quests.description_chs: 你和重云顺利进入了试胆大会的会场，然而妖邪的踪迹找到一半，重云突然觉得体内阳气躁动，不得不停下来休息。为了让重云的体质不要失控，你急忙去寻找能够压制阳气的东西…

quests.title: Independent Actions
quests.description: Chongyun's pure-yang spirit has finally been brought under control, but he is now aware that the strange goings-on during the Test of Courage are a result of human activity. However, neither of you is ready to give up yet, and at Chongyun's suggestion, you split up and continue to search for traces of the paranormal...
quests.description_chs: 重云的纯阳之体终于得到了控制，但重云也知道了试胆大会的怪异事件都是人为引起的事实。然而你们并不甘心，在重云的建议下，你们分头行动，继续寻找妖邪的踪影…

quests.title: Ever Deeper
quests.description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, and despite causing a misunderstanding, you also gain knowledge of evil spirits. The two of you proceed deeper, equal parts expectant and cautious.
quests.description_chs: 你和重云顺利进入了试胆大会的会场，虽然引起了一些误会，但也掌握了一些关于妖邪的情报。兼备期待与警惕，你们走向会场的更深处。

quests.title: The Bottom of Things
quests.description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. But it would be a shame to leave without having found any evil spirits. And so you forge on alone, leaving Chongyun behind to rest.
quests.description_chs: 你和重云顺利进入了试胆大会的会场，然而妖邪的踪迹找到一半，重云突然觉得体内阳气躁动，不得不停下来休息。可是寻不到妖邪也很可惜，于是在让重云留下来休息之后，你独自前往更深处探索。

quests.title: Killjoy
quests.description: After a conversation with the Test of Courage staff, you discover that the spooky things happening there are all instigated by humans. While you expected as much, you imagine that Chongyun would be quite disappointed if you told him so...
quests.description_chs: 在和工作人员交谈之后，你发现试胆大会的怪异事件果然都是人为引起的。虽然这是意料之中的事，但是告诉重云的话，他还是会很失望吧…

quests.title: The Missing Person
quests.description: Bantan Sango Detective Agency issued a curious commission. You wonder what case it is that even detectives have gotten out of their depths.
quests.description_chs: 万端珊瑚侦探社发布了一项奇怪的委托，究竟是什么案件，连侦探社也束手无策吗？

quests.title: After the Curtain Falls
quests.description: Yun Jin wandered into a perilous place while searching for inspiration, and would have been in trouble if not for your intervention. To thank you, she agrees to meet you after her performance...
quests.description_chs: 云堇为寻灵感深入险地，幸得你及时出手相助。 为了答谢你的帮助，云堇与你相约在演出结束后再见一面…

quests.title: Backstage Suspicions
quests.description: The self-proclaimed Editor-in-Chief of The Steambird and a journalist come for an ad-hoc interview with Yun Jin, but they seem somewhat suspicious...
quests.description_chs: 自称来自蒸汽鸟报社的主编与记者临时采访了云堇，但他们的言行却有些可疑…

quests.title: The Missing Thing
quests.description: It turns out that the missing young detective was investigating a mysterious case on Watatsumi Island. According to him, something vital is missing on this island. What could it be?
quests.description_chs: 先前不见踪影的侦探少年，原来一直在海祇岛调查着一桩奇异的案件，他声称这片岛屿缺少了重要的东西，会是什么呢？

quests.title: Half a Day's Leisure
quests.description: Yun Jin declines a great number of invitations to spend a laid-back day with you at Chihu Rock...
quests.description_chs: 云堇推却了诸多邀请，与你一同前往螭虎岩放松心情…

quests.title: Adventurous Acquaintance
quests.description: You make the acquaintance of a rather passionate adventurer at the front desk of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild...
quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城的冒险家协会前台附近，你邂逅了一位非常热情的冒险家…

quests.title: Something... Other Than Adventure?
quests.description: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... running around the city?
quests.description_chs: 答应了与班尼特一起行动，但这次你们决定做些冒险以外的事，比如…在城里转转？

quests.title: What Is This, a Day Trip?
quests.description: You agree to travel with Bennett, but you're doing some things unrelated to adventure this time — for example... having a stroll in the great outdoors?
quests.description_chs: 答应了与班尼特一起行动，但这次你们决定做些冒险以外的事，比如…去野外散散心？

quests.title: Treacherous Thermadon
quests.description: You should only go adventuring after making sure that you're fully prepared! You and Bennett prepare some food before you challenge the Deserted Ruins of Thermadon.
quests.description_chs: 冒险的话果然还是要做好万全准备，在前往忒耳摩冬遗迹之前，你和班尼特打算先准备些吃的。

quests.title: Expansive Eya
quests.description: An adventurer requires naught but courage and strength. The two of you prepare to head directly to the Deserted Ruins of Eya.
quests.description_chs: 冒险只要勇气和实力就够了，你和班尼特准备直接前往埃伊亚遗迹冒险。
(test)【隐藏】班尼特Coop天气恢复处理$HIDDEN

quests.title: First Glimpse of Meaning
quests.description: Yun Jin wandered into a perilous place while searching for inspiration, and would have been in trouble if not for your intervention. To thank you, she agrees to teach you some acting techniques...
quests.description_chs: 云堇为寻灵感深入险地，幸得你及时出手相助。 为了答谢你的帮助，云堇答应向你传授一些表演技巧…
(test)茶馆氛围$HIDDEN

quests.title: A Special Guest
quests.description: The Crux returns safely from Inazuma and is preparing to celebrate. The only difference is that today, you're the guest of honor...
quests.description_chs: 从稻妻顺利返航的南十字船队，正举办例行的庆功宴会，与以往不同的是，这回你成了北斗邀请的特别来客…

quests.title: Life on the High Seas
quests.description: At Beidou's invitation, you take part in the "Shield of the Crux" sailor training. Time to get a taste of life out at sea, far from any dry land...
quests.description_chs: 在北斗的邀请下，你参加了「南十字之盾」的船员培训，就用这种方式，稍微体验一下远离陆地的海上生活吧…

quests.title: Beneath the Surface
quests.description: At Beidou's invitation, you take part in the "Spear of the Crux" sailor training. Time to get a taste of the side of sailor life that few know about...
quests.description_chs: 在北斗的邀请下，你参加了「南十字之矛」的船员培训，就用这种方式，稍微领略一下船队不为人知的另一面吧…

quests.title: Guili Plains Treasure Hunt
quests.description: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in the Guili Plains. What will you encounter on the way?
quests.description_chs: 在你的建议下，你们决定前往归离原寻找宝藏，这一路会遇到什么呢？

quests.title: Qingce Village Treasure Hunt
quests.description: At your suggestion, the two of you decide to seek the treasure in Qingce Village. What will you encounter on the way?
quests.description_chs: 在你的建议下，你们决定前往轻策庄寻找宝藏，这一路会遇到什么呢？

quests.title: The Missing Thing
quests.description: It turns out that the missing young detective was investigating a mysterious case on Watatsumi Island. According to him, something vital is missing on this island. What could it be?
quests.description_chs: 先前不见踪影的侦探少年，原来一直在海祇岛调查着一桩奇异的案件，他声称这片岛屿缺少了重要的东西，会是什么呢？

quests.title: Report back
quests.description: After finding the missing young detective, you bring him back to the Police Station...
quests.description_chs: 顺利找到了失踪的侦探少年，成功将他带回奉行所复命…

quests.title: Heizou Talks Fraud
quests.description: Heizou plans to hold an anti-fraud campaign called "Heizou Talks Fraud." First of all, you two need to look for some actors...
quests.description_chs: 平藏计划举办一场名为「鹿说诈骗」的反诈骗宣传活动，首先你们需要找来几位参演的演员…

quests.title: The Sixth Proposal
quests.description: You run into Kaveh on the streets of Sumeru City. He seems to be embroiled in an argument with a client...
quests.description_chs: 在须弥城的街头见到了卡维，他似乎正在和什么人争论不休。

quests.title: A Refuge in the Sands
quests.description: You decide to help Kaveh convince the client to come to his side. However, it seems like the client's trying to hide something from you...
quests.description_chs: 决定与卡维一起去说服刚刚的委托人。委托人似乎也有什么隐情没有说出口…

quests.title: Long-Sealed Mystery
quests.description: The well-respected young detective suddenly receives a complaint. You wonder what the story behind it is...
quests.description_chs: 口碑载道的少年侦探突然遭人投诉，这封投诉信背后究竟隐藏着怎样的故事…

quests.title: Maid-in-Training
quests.description: In accordance with your growing fame as the Honorary Knight, one of your junior Knights of Favonius would like to receive your guidance...
quests.description_chs: 随着「荣誉骑士」的声名渐响，骑士团里似乎也有一位后辈希望得到你的指点…

quests.title: The Art of Hospitality
quests.description: You and Noelle met a strange guest near Mondstadt named Alois. Alois claims to be a merchant who has lost his cargo due to a monster attack. Noelle decides to bring Alois to Mondstadt to help him find his lost goods...
quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔与你在蒙德城附近邂逅了一名奇怪的客人，阿洛瓦。 阿洛瓦自称是一名商人，因为魔物袭扰而丢失了货物。 为了帮助阿洛瓦找回失物，诺艾尔决定带他前往蒙德城…
(test)为了展现蒙德的好客之风，诺艾尔热情地准备起了接待工作。

quests.title: Noelle's Strength
quests.description: Noelle, who aims to become a Knight of Favonius, has shared her troubles with you and hopes that you'll be able to help her with her chivalric training. To display the fruits of her daily training to her, Noelle takes you to the Knights' training ground...
quests.description_chs: 向往着成为西风骑士的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼，希望你能指点她的骑士修行。 为了向你展示她的修行日常，你们来到了骑士团的训练场…

quests.title: Live Practice
quests.description: Noelle has great strength but is never able to use it in real fights. You arrange some training to help her gain more practical combat experience...
quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔虽然有着强大的力量，却总是不能在实战中好好发挥。 为了让诺艾尔获得更多实战经验，你为她安排了一些训练…

quests.title: Strength Training
quests.description: Noelle has great strength, but the path to greater strength is never-ending. Your suggestion to help her bring out yet more power is... mining.
quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔虽然有着强大的力量，但追求力量的道路是无止境的。 为了让诺艾尔获得更强的力量，你给出的建议是：挖矿…

quests.title: Fleeting Leisure
quests.description: Noelle, who aims to become a Knight of Favonius, has shared her troubles with you and hopes that you'll be able to help her with her chivalric training. To get the workaholic Noelle some rest, you suggest that the two of you have some tea and let loose a little...
quests.description_chs: 向往着成为西风骑士的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼，希望你能指点她的骑士修行。 为了让勤奋过度的诺艾尔获得足够的休息，你提议和诺艾尔一起喝杯茶放松一下…

quests.title: Gift and Intent
quests.description: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...
quests.description_chs: 面对陷入恋爱困境的贝雅，诺艾尔一如既往地伸出了援手。 商议之后，你们决定用一份礼物帮贝雅传递心意…

quests.title: Gift and Intent
quests.description: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...
quests.description_chs: 面对陷入恋爱困境的贝雅，诺艾尔一如既往地伸出了援手。 商议之后，你们决定用一份礼物帮贝雅传递心意…
(test)(隐藏)诺艾尔Coop贝雅线BE成就用$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: A Whole New Style
quests.description: After hearing about the client's budget problems, Kaveh decides to adopt a more cost-effective and simplistic style.
quests.description_chs: 听委托人说了眼下的窘境，卡维决定采用更省经费的简约风格。

quests.title: Wealthy Merchant
quests.description: After hearing about the client's budget problems, Kaveh decides to solicit some rich merchants for a potential sponsorship.
quests.description_chs: 听委托人说了眼下的窘境，卡维决定到富商那里拉一些赞助。

quests.title: The Birdwatcher
quests.description: An unexpected traveler, far from home, is hanging out in Port Ormos...
quests.description_chs: 一位你意料之外的异乡人正在奥摩斯港闲逛…

quests.title: The Price of a Wish
quests.description: You were unable to secure a sponsorship deal, but Dori seems to have more to say...
quests.description_chs: 并没能与商人谈拢，但多莉似乎有什么话想说…

quests.title: Past Mementos
quests.description: You accompany Kaveh back to his place, where he digs out a number of mementos from his childhood. Are there any interesting stories behind these simple objects?
quests.description_chs: 与卡维来到家中，看到他找出了小时候的旧物。这些物品上又有什么样的故事呢？

quests.title: The First Ideal
quests.description: Kaveh decides to put aside his mother's notebook for now. You agree to take a walk around with him.
quests.description_chs: 卡维决定暂时不把精力花在破解密码本上。与他一起到处走走吧。

quests.title: Wondrous Times
quests.description: Kaveh suggests that you pay a visit to his mother's former professor. Maybe Professor Zaha Hadi will have the clues you seek...
quests.description_chs: 卡维提议去见母亲的老师，或许那位妙论派的泰斗知道些什么…

quests.title: Treasure and True Interest
quests.description: Kaveh mentioned a Kshahrewar senior of his who has somehow struck gold without taking any personal commissions. You resolve to ask him for some career tips.
quests.description_chs: 卡维提到了一位不接委托但财富惊人的妙论派学长，试着向那位学长取取经吧。

quests.title: A Familiar Face in a Faraway Place
quests.description: You walk and talk with Kaeya, and discuss what to do next...
quests.description_chs: 你与凯亚边走边聊，开始讨论接下来去哪儿的话题…

quests.title: Feathers Adrift in a Spring Breeze
quests.description: A chance meeting with a friend in a faraway land is hard to come by, so why not join up and travel together for a time?
quests.description_chs: 他乡遇故知最是难得，既然不期间相逢，不如结伴四处游历。

quests.title: Studious Maid
quests.description: Noelle is usually brimming with energy, but recently she has been cooped up in the library, worrying about something or other...
quests.description_chs: 向来充满活力的诺艾尔，最近似乎一直待在图书馆中，为某件事情发愁…

quests.title: Journey to Liyue
quests.description: Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, she decides to join you on a trip to Liyue to relieve her stress...
quests.description_chs: 因骑士选拔而焦虑不已的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼。 在你的建议下，诺艾尔与你一起前往璃月散心…

quests.title: While the Millelith Stands Guard
quests.description: Noelle is mistaken for a Knight of Favonius several times over the course of the trip. After things have calmed down a little, you decide to see what Noelle could learn from the Millelith down by the harbor.
quests.description_chs: 在游览途中，诺艾尔几次被误认作西风骑士。风波暂歇后，你们打算继续前往港口向千岩军请教…

quests.title: A Knight's Journey Through Liyue
quests.description: Noelle is mistaken for a Knight of Favonius several times over the course of the trip. After things have calmed down a little, you decide to stop by Third-Round Knockout and take a short break.
quests.description_chs: 在游览途中，诺艾尔几次被误认作西风骑士。风波暂歇后，你们打算折返「三碗不过港」稍作休息…

quests.title: Adventurer's Entrance Exam
quests.description: Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, the two of you head to the Adventurers' Guild, hoping to get some extra exam experience.
quests.description_chs: 因骑士选拔而焦虑不已的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼。 在你的建议下，诺艾尔与你一起前往冒险家协会，希望能熟悉考试的氛围…

quests.title: Adventurer's Entrance Exam
quests.description: After fully understanding Noelle's reasons for seeking him out, an elated and excited Cyrus decides to put you both through his new exam at the highest difficulty level.
quests.description_chs: 「完全」理解诺艾尔的来意后，兴致高涨的塞琉斯向你们发起了最高难度的考核。

quests.title: Adventurer's Entrance Exam
quests.description: After fully understanding Noelle's reasons for seeking him out, an elated and excited Cyrus decides to put you both through his new exam at the highest difficulty level.
quests.description_chs: 「完全」理解诺艾尔的来意后，兴致高涨的塞琉斯向你们发起了最高难度的考核。

quests.title: Noelle Rides Out
quests.description: Noelle reveals to you that she is very anxious about the Knights of Favonius selection exam. At your suggestion, she decides to emulate the knights she knows in an attempt to overcome her sense of unease.
quests.description_chs: 因骑士选拔而焦虑不已的诺艾尔向你倾诉了自己的苦恼。 在你的建议下，诺艾尔开始模仿起身边的骑士，来克服对未来的不安…

quests.title: Substitute Acting Grand Master Noelle
quests.description: Noelle decides to emulate Jean by returning to Mondstadt and helping the citizens with their problems.
quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔决定向琴学习，回到蒙德城，帮助居民解决问题…

quests.title: Noelle the Intelligence Operative
quests.description: Noelle decides to emulate Kaeya by heading to the Angel's Share and attempting to gather intel on any threats to Mondstadt's security.
quests.description_chs: 诺艾尔决定向凯亚学习，前往「天使的馈赠」，收集事关蒙德安全的情报…

quests.title: Reunion
quests.description: You've spent long enough away from Mondstadt. It is time to return.
quests.description_chs: 离开蒙德已经许久，是时候回去了。

quests.title: Poems Dedicated to the Wind
quests.description: The winds of Mondstadt are leisurely as ever. Enjoy the gentle breeze as you go along.
quests.description_chs: 蒙德的风一如既往的悠闲，一道享受柔风吹拂吧。

quests.title: An Ordinary Day for the Knights of Favonius
quests.description: Similar things are always happening at the Knights of Favonius...
quests.description_chs: 类似的事情常在骑士团上演…

quests.title: Fragrance of Wine
quests.description: Stories mellow fine wines, and we fall in love with the warmth therein.
quests.description_chs: 酒因为故事而醇厚，你因为其中的温暖而爱上酒。

quests.title: Taste of Home
quests.description: It's time to go home, and enjoy some time with family.
quests.description_chs: 回到家中，回到家人身边去吧。

quests.title: All the World's a Stage
quests.description: Drama is both the generalized form and essence of reality. Just what kind of light does the story onstage reflect in his eyes?
quests.description_chs: 戏剧是对现实的凝练与概括，在他的眼中，此刻舞台上的故事到底折射出了何种光芒呢？

quests.title: The Cat's Tail's Bartender
quests.description: They say that there's a popular bartender at The Cat's Tail.
quests.description_chs: 据说，「猫尾酒馆」里有一位人气颇高的调酒师。

quests.title: To Catch a Kitten
quests.description: Searching for three kitties in Mondstadt might not be the easiest thing in the world...
quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城里寻找三只小猫，或许不是一件简单的事。

quests.title: A Special Base Drink
quests.description: Diona would like to go to Dadaupa Gorge to secure a certain special "base drink."
quests.description_chs: 迪奥娜似乎想要去达达乌帕谷寻找一种特殊的「基底饮品」。

quests.title: The Shadow Over Dadaupa
quests.description: Getting deep into Dadaupa Gorge might require a cunning plan...
quests.description_chs: 想要深入达达乌帕谷，似乎需要一些特别的技巧…

quests.title: Samachurl Herbal Soup
quests.description: According to Diona, the herbal soup made by samachurls can possibly be used to make an antidote to alcohol.
quests.description_chs: 据迪奥娜说，丘丘人萨满的草药汤，似乎能作为制作解酒药的材料之一。

quests.title: Special Cocktailing Condiments
quests.description: Diona wants to look for some special flavoring for her cocktail.
quests.description_chs: 迪奥娜似乎想要去寻找一些特殊的「调酒辅料」。

quests.title: Exchanging Pointers
quests.description: In order to learn the tricks of a professional mixologist, Diona decides to exchange pointers with Connor.
quests.description_chs: 为了学习到专业的调酒手法，迪奥娜即将与康纳展开一场切磋。

quests.title: Behind His Back
quests.description: At Thoma's invitation, you come to the Yashiro Commission, only to hear two samurai talking about him behind his back...
quests.description_chs: 接到托马的邀请来到社奉行，却听到有两名武士在背后议论托马…

quests.title: Host's Invitation
quests.description: Thoma would like to do something for you to thank you for your help during the Vision Hunt Decree...
quests.description_chs: 为了感谢你在眼狩令期间的努力，托马想要为你做些什么…

quests.title: Thanks for Your Hospitality!
quests.description: Thoma heads to Komore Teahouse first. He seems to be preparing something...
quests.description_chs: 托马先一步前往木漏茶室，好像是要准备什么东西…

quests.title: Start Spreadin' the News
quests.description: Help Thoma advertise his housekeeping course to attract more people to come.
quests.description_chs: 在城内宣传托马的家政课，吸引更多人前来参加。

quests.title: Small-Scale Changes
quests.description: Help Thoma advertise his housekeeping course at the Yashiro Commission to attract even more people to come.
quests.description_chs: 在社奉行所宣传托马的家政课，努力吸引更多人前来参加。

quests.title: Under the Same Shade
quests.description: There are many stray cats and dogs gathered under the sakura tree that Thoma saw.
quests.description_chs: 来到托马所见的地点，樱花树下聚集了许多流浪猫狗。

quests.title: Ninken by the Shore
quests.description: You find the masterless ninken that Thoma mentioned, but its attitude is a bit...
quests.description_chs: 找到了托马所说的那只无主的忍犬，但忍犬的态度似乎有些…

quests.title: Bits and Bobs for Cats and Dogs
quests.description: You meet up with Thoma again, and he brings the finished sweater.
quests.description_chs: 与托马再次会合，托马也带来了织好的毛衣。

quests.title: A Trip for Two in Ritou
quests.description: You have a relaxing time together with Thoma in Ritou.
quests.description_chs: 在离岛，与托马一起度过假日时光。

quests.title: Unforeseen Circumstances
quests.description: You receive word of the latest crisis while trying to help Thoma win respect...
quests.description_chs: 在寻找能让托马获得尊重的办法时，意外得知了最近出现的危机…

quests.title: The Jade Chamber Once More
quests.description: You receive an invitation from Ningguang, she seems to have something to discuss with you.
quests.description_chs: 你收到了凝光的邀请，她似乎与你有要事相商…

quests.title: Business as Usual
quests.description: According to the schedule, the first thing you need to do is wake Ningguang up...
quests.description_chs: 根据认真严谨的日程表，首先需要做的是将凝光唤醒…

quests.title: Exchanging Intelligence
quests.description: Now that the banquet is over, next up is Ningguang's meeting with her informants.
quests.description_chs: 宴会结束之后，按照之前的日程安排，接下来凝光会和她的情报人见面。

quests.title: Auction Games
quests.description: After finishing her meal, Ningguang is worried about the auction that her secretaries are in charge of, and so you go to inspect the site with her. What's got her all concerned, you wonder?
quests.description_chs: 结束用餐之后，凝光对秘书们负责的拍卖会不太放心，于是你决定和她去现场看看。究竟是什么让她看上去有些顾虑呢？

quests.title: Liyue Millennial
quests.description: Ningguang would like to use the board game she created to commemorate the battle against Osial. As such, she wishes to produce a very special figurine.
quests.description_chs: 凝光想要以她发明的棋戏纪念与奥赛尔的战斗，还想要制作一枚很特殊的棋子。

quests.title: Starting From Zero
quests.description: Ningguang would like to relive the experiences she had when she was just starting out. She thus invites you to play a game of starting from the very bottom. You head to the wharf together...
quests.description_chs: 凝光想要重温创业之初的心情，为此她邀请你参与一场从零开始赚取摩拉的游戏。于是你们一同前往码头…

quests.title: Endless Smoke
quests.description: Ningguang would like to relive the experiences she had when she was just starting out. She thus invites you to play a game of starting from the very bottom. When you mention the Northland Bank, she decides to let you have a look at how things are now.
quests.description_chs: 凝光想要重温创业之初的心情，为此她邀请你参与一场从零开始赚取摩拉的游戏。在你提到北国银行之后，凝光决定让你见一下现状。

quests.title: Time Off!
quests.description: Ningguang has been working pretty hard all day. You'd like to help her take a day off. She seems to have some idea of what she'd like to do during this down-time...
quests.description_chs: 凝光一直都很辛苦，你决定为她放一天假。至于休息时间要做什么，她似乎有些想法…

quests.title: Ways and Means
quests.description: The Police Station's Uesugi is fretting about the Arataki Gang...
quests.description_chs: 奉行所门口的上杉，似乎正为荒泷派的事情犯愁…

quests.title: To the Shrine
quests.description: To obtain the forgiveness of the Grand Narukami Shrine, Shinobu has to make a trip there.
quests.description_chs: 为了取得鸣神大社的原谅，久岐忍不得不往影向山走一趟…

quests.title: Gang Bylaws
quests.description: Having heard that Shinobu is about to implement some special Gang Bylaws, Mamoru and the others flee as quickly as they can...
quests.description_chs: 听闻久岐忍有意制定「派中法度」后，阿守等人瞬间逃之夭夭…

quests.title: Key Decision
quests.description: Shinobu, her temper cooling for now, decides to go back to her real plans for the day...
quests.description_chs: 暂时消气的久岐忍，决定先去忙她的「正事」…

quests.title: Shrine Maiden for a Day
quests.description: According to Miko's "suggestion," you work as shrine maidens at the shrine...
quests.description_chs: 你们听从了神子的「建议」，在神社中承担起巫女的工作…

quests.title: In the Aftermath
quests.description: Thanks to Yae's "generous concession," you are able to head down the mountain to clean the flyers up...
quests.description_chs: 在神子「大度」的让步下，你们前往山道去清理小广告…

quests.title: That'll Learn Them!
quests.description: Akira and the others have escaped physical punishment, but they are still whisked off to Hanamizaka to attend lessons...
quests.description_chs: 阿晃等人虽然逃过了皮肉之苦，却还是被抓去花见坂上起了课…

quests.title: Temporary Escape
quests.description: With your aid, Akira has made his escape for now, but can he really get away with this?
quests.description_chs: 阿晃在你的帮助下暂时藏身，但他真的能就此逃过一劫吗？

quests.title: Drowsy Evening Star
quests.description: One day, you walk into the Sumeru Akademiya...
quests.description_chs: 某日，你来到须弥城教令院…

quests.title: The Wisdom Seelie
quests.description: Layla mentioned that the Wisdom Seelie could help with her thesis. You feel a little skeptical, but still decide to check it out with her.
quests.description_chs: 莱依拉提到「知慧仙灵」能帮她解决论文的问题，你虽有疑惑，但还是决定跟她去看看。

quests.title: Taking the Opposite Route
quests.description: After weighing the pros and cons, you decide to seek out the Wisdom Seelie's true identity.
quests.description_chs: 权衡利弊之后，你们打算直接把「知慧仙灵」的正体找出来。

quests.title: Compiling the Clues
quests.description: You should be able to make progress with the information you have gathered so far...
quests.description_chs: 信息收集得差不多了，以现在掌握的情报，应该能有所进展…

quests.title: Further Investigation
quests.description: The Wisdom Seelie left a few hints in its letter. Perhaps you could first figure out what it's up to.
quests.description_chs: 既然「知慧仙灵」在信件中给出了提示，姑且看看它想要做什么吧。

quests.title: One Final Step
quests.description: Layla's perseverance has finally paid off, and you uncover the truth behind the Wisdom Seelie...
quests.description_chs: 咬牙坚持之后，你们终于有机会窥见「知慧仙灵」的真相…

quests.title: An Exasperating Prank
quests.description: You know that it might not be fruitful even if you pursue it to the end, so you decide to forget about the Wisdom Seelie's prank and watch over Layla as she rests.
quests.description_chs: 就算追寻下去或许也不会有结果，你决定将「知慧仙灵」的恶作剧抛到脑后，带莱依拉去休息。

quests.title: A Change of Pace
quests.description: Instead of placing your bet on a sketchy legend, catching up on some rest seems like the better option for Layla right now.
quests.description_chs: 与其把希望寄托在不着边际的传说上，不如先帮莱依拉把状态调整过来吧。

quests.title: The Helper
quests.description: Layla will have to face the problems with her thesis, and perhaps a little push is all that she needs.
quests.description_chs: 论文的问题总需要面对，她或许只要有人在后面推她一把。

quests.title: Thesis Defense Practice
quests.description: Having obtained the device, Layla still wishes to practice for her upcoming thesis defense...
quests.description_chs: 在解决了仪器的问题之后，莱依拉还想要为即将到来的答辩做一点准备…

quests.title: The Remaining Problem
quests.description: It feels like Layla has become a completely different person with everything under her control.
quests.description_chs: 莱依拉表现出了完全不同的状态，现状似乎都在她的掌控之中。

quests.title: Fresh Air
quests.description: Will it make Layla feel better if she puts academics aside and completely relaxes for once?
quests.description_chs: 如果暂时把所有和学业有关的东西放到一边，莱依拉的状态会不会好转呢？

quests.title: One Hearty Meal Later
quests.description: After enjoying your meal, it's time to continue moving forward. But the destination isn't all that important — feeling carefree is the only thing that matters.
quests.description_chs: 享用了野餐之后，又可以继续前进了。目的地不重要，重要的是自由的心情。

quests.title: A Mysterious Senior...?
quests.description: Tighnari is at Pardis Dhyai, waiting for a certain mysterious senior...
quests.description_chs: 禅那园中的提纳里，正在等候一位神秘的前辈…

quests.title: Essential Classic
quests.description: For Collei's future and that of all Sumeru, Faruzan decides to start a certain class...
quests.description_chs: 为了柯莱与全须弥的未来，珐露珊决定开一门识字课…

quests.title: Early Learning Mechanism
quests.description: Faruzan decides to come to the aid of Acara Crafts for the sake of the children and the Akademiya's future...
quests.description_chs: 为了孩子们与教令院的未来，珐露珊决定协助阿折罗造像…

quests.title: Wanderings of a Lonesome Shadow
quests.description: After getting free of her academic tangles, Faruzan decides to first go to Pardis Dhyai...
quests.description_chs: 成功摆脱教令院的纠缠后，珐露珊决定先前往禅那园…

quests.title: A Decision
quests.description: There seems to be a familiar figure near the Hotel Debord...
quests.description_chs: 德波大饭店附近，似乎有个熟悉的身影…

quests.title: Mask
quests.description: Lynette decides to return to the reception...
quests.description_chs: 琳妮特决定回到酒会…

quests.title_chs: (test)废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了$UNRELEASED
quests.description_chs: (test)父任务 4$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Break
quests.description: It's curtains for this act, and Lynette gets a long-overdue break...
quests.description_chs: 事情终于告一段落，琳妮特迎来了久违的小憩…

quests.title: Detectives
quests.description: Lynette decides to head to the newspaper agency...
quests.description_chs: 琳妮特决定前往报社…

quests.title_chs: (test)废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了废弃了$UNRELEASED
quests.description_chs: (test)父任务 7$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Closure
quests.description: The fog is lifting, and you are getting closer to the truth...
quests.description_chs: 勘破迷雾，你们终于抵近真相…

quests.title: A Path Through the Storm
quests.description: You share your feelings with Paimon before embarking on the next phase of your journey.
quests.description_chs: 在踏上下一段旅程之前，先和派蒙整理一下思绪与心情吧…

quests.title: Blocked?
quests.description: As Quinn was transporting fruit back to Mondstadt, his path was blocked near the Thousand Winds Temple, and he was ambushed by hilichurls. Defeat the hilichurls and save Quinn.
quests.description_chs: 昆恩在运送水果回蒙德城时，在千风神殿附近被路障拦截，遭到丘丘人的围攻。消灭丘丘人，解救昆恩

quests.title: Owe Mora, Pay Mora
quests.description: Something seems to be troubling Goth...
quests.description_chs: 歌德先生似乎正在为某事发愁…

quests.title: Owe Mora, Pay Mora
quests.description: Something seems to be troubling Goth...
quests.description_chs: 歌德先生似乎正在为某事发愁…

quests.title: Lost Key
quests.description: Wyatt, who escorts goods, is fond of drinking. However, after some heavy drinking, he has lost his key. Try following his footprints to find his key and bring it back to him.
quests.description_chs: 押送着货车的怀尔德酷爱喝酒，但是在一次大醉之后，他的钥匙被自己弄丢了。尝试跟随着怀尔德脚印的痕迹寻找钥匙，并交还给他。

quests.title: Food Delivery
quests.description: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.
quests.description_chs: 为了满足顾客的需要，猎鹿人餐馆持续提供着送餐服务。但是因为顾客众多，餐馆里的人手严重不足，莎拉小姐想要找一个人来帮忙送餐。

quests.title: Urgent Repairs
quests.description: Allan was transporting hunting goods to Mondstadt, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...
quests.description_chs: 艾伦正运送着猎物去蒙德城，但是货车却被丘丘人袭击，货物和他自己都陷入了危险的境地…

quests.title: Big Pudgy Problem!
quests.description: Slimes have suddenly appeared on the Mondstadt docks, and it seems Arthur has become caught up in the commotion...
quests.description_chs: 史莱姆突然在蒙德城的码头出现，在码头附近的阿瑟尔似乎被卷入其中…

quests.title: Language Exchange
quests.description: Ella Musk wants to find a group of hilichurls to practice her Hilichurlian. She claims to have a solid grasp of the basics, as well as plenty of communication experience... It's just that she's never had a chance to actually speak with them.
quests.description_chs: 艾拉·马斯克想要找一群丘丘人练习丘丘语口语。她自称已经有了「完善的语言基础」和「充沛的交流经验」…只是一直没有实际交流过。

quests.title: The Crux Clash
quests.description: After meeting some of the contestants, you reckon that this will be a milk run. Still, your ticket to Inazuma is at stake here. Best not to let your guard down during the tournament.
quests.description_chs: 在了解了参赛者的状况之后，你预计这是一次很轻松的比赛。但比赛结果事关前往稻妻的船票，所以万不可掉以轻心。

quests.title: Language Exchange
quests.description: Ella Musk wants to find a group of hilichurls to practice her Hilichurlian. She claims to have a solid grasp of the basics, as well as plenty of communication experience... It's just that she's never had a chance to actually speak with them.
quests.description_chs: 艾拉·马斯克想要找一群丘丘人练习丘丘语口语。她自称已经有了「完善的语言基础」和「充沛的交流经验」…只是一直没有实际交流过。

quests.title: Blocked?
quests.description: Anthony set off from Mondstadt towards Springvale to find medicine for his sister Anna, but was set upon by hilichurls along the way. Defeat the hilichurls and save Anthony.
quests.description_chs: 安东尼从蒙德城前往清泉镇周边，为妹妹安娜找药，但是在途中却被路障拦截，遭到丘丘人的围攻。消灭丘丘人，解救安东尼。

quests.title: Blocked?
quests.description: Myrana was enjoying a rare opportunity to go out for a walk, but on the way to the winery is stopped and attacked by hilichurls. Defeat the hilichurls and save Myrana.
quests.description_chs: 米拉娜正在享受难得的散步时光，但是在前往酒庄的路上被路障拦截，遭到丘丘人的围攻。消灭丘丘人，解救米拉娜。

quests.title: Blocked?
quests.description: Jack was on his way to a new adventure spot, but has found himself under attack by hilichurls at Drunkard Gorge. Defeat the hilichurls and save Jack.
quests.description_chs: 杰克正去一处新的冒险地点探险，但是在醉汉峡却被路障拦截，遭到丘丘人的围攻。消灭丘丘人，解救杰克。

quests.title: Adventurer Exam: Battle Tactics
quests.description: Anna from Mondstadt would really like to become an adventurer...
quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的安娜真的想要成为冒险家…

quests.title: Language Exchange
quests.description: Ella Musk wants to find a group of hilichurls to practice her Hilichurlian. She claims to have a solid grasp of the basics, as well as plenty of communication experience... It's just that she's never had a chance to actually speak with them.
quests.description_chs: 艾拉·马斯克想要找一群丘丘人练习丘丘语口语。她自称已经有了「完善的语言基础」和「充沛的交流经验」…只是一直没有实际交流过。

quests.title: Food Delivery
quests.description: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.
quests.description_chs: 为了满足顾客的需要，猎鹿人餐馆持续提供着送餐服务。但是因为顾客众多，餐馆里的人手严重不足，莎拉小姐想要找一个人来帮忙送餐。

quests.title: Urgent Repairs
quests.description: Farrah was taking some goods to a spot near Drunkard Gorge to sell to passing trade caravans, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...
quests.description_chs: 法拉正准备运货去醉汉峡附近，向路过的商队兜售货物，但是货车却被丘丘人袭击，货物和他自己都陷入了危险的境地…

quests.title: Urgent Repairs
quests.description: Magar is transporting goods to Springvale, but his transport was attacked by hilichurls, and now both he and the transport are in danger...
quests.description_chs: 玛伽正准备运货去清泉镇，但是货车却被丘丘人袭击，货物和他自己都陷入了危险的境地…

quests.title: Lost Key
quests.description: Wyatt, who escorts goods, is fond of drinking. However, after some heavy drinking, he has lost his key. Try following his footprints to find his key and bring it back to him.
quests.description_chs: 押送着货车的怀尔德酷爱喝酒，但是在一次大醉之后，他的钥匙被自己弄丢了。尝试跟随着怀尔德脚印的痕迹寻找钥匙，并交还给他。

quests.title: Follow the Wind
quests.description: The grand final of the Crux Clash is about to begin, and you will soon meet your opponent. Victory is but one step away...
quests.description_chs: 「南十字武斗会」的决赛即将开始，对手的真容也将浮出水面，距离夺冠只差一步。

quests.title: Adventurer Exam: The Art of Adventure
quests.description: Anna from Mondstadt would really like to become an adventurer...
quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的安娜真的想要成为冒险家…

quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的安娜真的想要成为冒险家…

quests.description_chs: 维多利亚修女似乎正在思考一件事…

quests.title: Big Pudgy Problem!
quests.description: Slimes have suddenly shown up at Dawn Winery, and it seems Tunner has become caught up in the commotion...
quests.description_chs: 史莱姆突然在晨曦酒庄出现，在酒庄附近的特纳似乎被卷入其中…

quests.title: Big Pudgy Problem!
quests.description: Slimes have suddenly shown up on the mountain behind Springvale, and it seems Timid Morrow has become caught up in the commotion...
quests.description_chs: 史莱姆突然在清泉镇后山出现，在附近的胆小的莫罗似乎被卷入其中…

quests.title: Return to Days of Winter
quests.description: Viktor, a Fatuus stationed in Mondstadt, has finally received orders to return home...
quests.description_chs: 待在蒙德城的愚人众维克多先生终于接到了回国的命令…

quests.title: Three Wishes
quests.description: Setting foot on Inazuma's main island — Narukami Island — for the first time, you carry your Invitation Letter to Komore Teahouse, not knowing what might happen next...
quests.description_chs: 初次登上稻妻的主岛——鸣神岛，你拿着邀请函前往「木漏茶室」，又会有什么新的邂逅呢？

quests.title: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild
quests.description: Katheryne from the Adventurers' Guild has sent you an invitation.
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的凯瑟琳向你发出了邀请。

quests.title: Every Day a New Adventure
quests.description: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild seems to have a new commission for you.
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的凯瑟琳似乎有新的委托想拜托你。

quests.title: Whispers in the Wind
quests.description: Glory misses her boyfriend who went on a long journey. She's looking for a way to carry her words to him.
quests.description_chs: 双目失明的葛罗丽思念着远游的男友，正在寻找传递自己心愿的方式…

quests.title: Long Distance Love
quests.description: Godwin, a Knight of Favonius, is yearning for his lover who stayed in Mondstadt. He's looking for someone to deliver a letter to her...
quests.description_chs: 西风骑士古德温正记挂着在蒙德城里的恋人，正在找人帮他送信回去问候…

quests.title: Grateful to the Gods
quests.description: Jilliana is looking for someone to clean the Statues of The Seven, since she hasn't had time lately...
quests.description_chs: 吉丽安娜小姐正在寻找一个人，替她去清扫久未打理过的七天神像…

quests.title: Timaeus' Alchemy Tutorial
quests.description: Timaeus is deeply enraptured with alchemy. He wonders it there are others like him, that are drawn to this ancient and mysterious art...
quests.description_chs: 蒂玛乌斯沉醉于炼金术的奥秘之中。他暗自期待着有没有人跟他一样，也被这古老而神秘的学问所吸引…

quests.title: The Meaning of Meaningless Waiting
quests.description: The village guardian who has lost his Vision seems to have forgotten why he had remained there in the first place...
quests.description_chs: 失去了神之眼的村庄守护者，似乎忽然忘却了留在此地的意义…

quests.title: A New Storm Is Brewing
quests.description: Sister Vind wishes to get to the top of the watchtower but something has gotten in her way. She's trying to think of a way through...
quests.description_chs: 芬德修女想要登上瞭望塔，但似乎被什么挡住了，她正在思索通过的方法…

quests.title: Adventure Takes Courage!
quests.description: Patchi is near the Thousand Winds Temple, trying to find a way to enter...
quests.description_chs: 徘徊在千风神殿附近的帕琪小姐，正在烦恼着进入神殿的方法…

quests.title: Stop, Albert. Stop!
quests.description: A suspicious person is lurking around the Cathedral. Sister Victoria wants someone to deal with them...
quests.description_chs: 有可疑的人在教堂周围徘徊，维多利亚修女正在寻找愿意处理这件事的人…

quests.title: Michelle Never Stops!
quests.title_chs: 永不停歇的风与米歇尔小姐
quests.description: Michelle is on her way to work, looking quite exhausted...
quests.description_chs: 米歇尔小姐正在去工作的路上，但看起来她已经很疲惫了…

quests.title: Ellin, the Wannabe Knight
quests.description: Ellin is working hard to become a knight, but her training doesn't seem to work out. She seems to need some guidance...
quests.description_chs: 为了成为一名骑士，艾琳正在努力练习，但却始终不得章法。艾琳希望有人能来指导她…

quests.title: Anna the Adventurer!
quests.description: It appears that Anna from Mondstadt has successfully become an adventurer.
quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的安娜，似乎已经成功地成为了一位冒险家。

quests.title: Step by Step
quests.description: Doolan is frustrated and wandering around the Thousand Winds Temple...
quests.description_chs: 徘徊在千风神殿附近的杜兰先生，正在烦恼着……

quests.title: Pigeon, Duck, and Child
quests.description: Timmie is sulking again. This time, it's not about a pigeon being scared away...
quests.description_chs: 提米又在生闷气，但这次似乎并不是鸽子被吓走了这么简单…

quests.title: A Little Booze Doesn't Hurt...
quests.description: Nimrod wants to enjoy a few drinks from the tavern, but he needs some help to deal with his wife...
quests.description_chs: 为了能安心地喝几杯小酒，宁禄先生正在酒馆里找人帮忙……

quests.title: To Treat the Well-Meaning Well
quests.title_chs: 愿仁义之人被仁义以待
quests.description: How did the samurai who lost his Vision become stuck in a quagmire of troubles brought upon him by the people?
quests.description_chs: 失去神之眼后被民众所「刁难」的武士，究竟经历过什么才会使他落得这般田地？

quests.description_chs: 『天使的馈赠』酒馆生意一直很红火，但最近酒保查尔斯却有些发愁…

quests.description: Guy is feeling depressed...
quests.description_chs: 盖伊先生正在忧郁着…

quests.title: Nora, Run!
quests.description: Nora wants to play on top of the statue, but Sister Grace forbids her to...
quests.description_chs: 诺拉想要去风神像上玩，但是葛瑞丝修女并不同意…

quests.title: The More Treasures the Merrier
quests.description: Marjorie seems to be upset about not having enough goods...
quests.description_chs: 玛乔丽小姐似乎正因为货物不足而发愁…

quests.title: A Swordmaster's Path Is Paved With Broken Blades
quests.title_chs: 剑道家的道路铺满剑道梦的碎片
quests.description: The swordmaster who aimed to be the greatest under heaven descended into madness after losing his Vision. You decide to help his disciples investigate the cause...
quests.description_chs: 以天下第一为目标的剑道家在失去神之眼后忽然陷入疯狂，你决定帮助他的徒弟调查原因…

quests.title: Things a Father Can Do
quests.description: Tunner seems to be really sick...
quests.description_chs: 特纳先生似乎病得很厉害…

quests.title: Pigeons Go AWOL
quests.description: Draff is angry at the pigeons he keeps...
quests.description_chs: 杜拉夫先生正因为自己养的鸽子们而生气…

quests.title: The Limitations of an Adventurer
quests.description: Herman seems to be troubled...
quests.description_chs: 赫尔曼先生正在发愁…

quests.title: The Best Audience in All of Mondstadt
quests.description: An adventure story has gotten Jack all excited. He's desperate for someone to help him track down the monster from the story...
quests.description_chs: 杰克正因为冒险故事而兴奋，想要找人帮他去实地搜索故事中怪物的踪迹…

quests.description: Timmie seems to have a bone to pick with you over some matter. Perhaps Sister Grace might know a way to help resolve things between you two...
quests.description_chs: 提米正因为某件事而与你赌着气。葛瑞丝修女也许知道能与提米和解的方法…

quests.title: Floral Fresh
quests.description: Flowers don't stay fresh for long. Flora, the owner of the Floral Whisper, has been thinking of ways to preserve them better...
quests.description_chs: 因为鲜花难以长久保存，鲜花商店「花语」的店主芙萝拉小姐正在思考着关于保存鲜花的方法…

quests.title: A Flower Blooms in a Prison
quests.description: After fulfilling Kamisato Ayaka's three wishes, you successfully win her trust. And now the next step is...
quests.description_chs: 在实现了神里绫华的三个心愿后，你成功获得了她的信任，那么下一步行动是…

quests.title: Fresh Flora
quests.description: To help Flora ascertain the effectiveness of putting plants in cold storage, you must head to Dragonspine once again to retrieve the flowers buried in the snow...
quests.description_chs: 为了帮芙萝拉小姐确认「冷藏花卉」的效果，你需要再次前往雪山，取回之前埋进雪中的花卉…

quests.title: Fresh Flora

quests.description_chs: 为了帮芙萝拉小姐确认「冷藏花卉」的效果，你需要再次前往雪山，取回之前埋进雪中的花卉…

quests.title: Emergency Supplies
quests.description: Riese is preparing emergency supplies to protect some reckless adventurers from getting in trouble on Dragonspine...
quests.description_chs: 为了让一些过于莽撞的冒险家不至于在雪山中遇险，里瑟先生正准备在雪山里放置一些应急补给…

quests.title: Amidst Stormy Judgment
quests.description: Komore Teahouse is empty, silent as the grave but for Taroumaru's uneasy barking. You have a bad feeling about this...
quests.description_chs: 木漏茶室空无一人，太郎丸在不安地吠叫，一种不祥的预感涌上你的心头。

quests.title: In the Name of the Resistance
quests.description: Your first meeting with the Raiden Shogun leads to a clash beyond your expectations. With a warrant out for you, your only option to reverse the situation now is to throw your lot in with the Sangonomiya resistance.
quests.description_chs: 与雷电将军的初次见面，发生了超乎预想的冲突。被稻妻通缉的你，现在唯有投靠珊瑚宫的反抗军才能扭转局面。

quests.title: Sword, Fish, Resistance
quests.description: At Sangonomiya Kokomi's invitation, you decide to visit Sangonomiya Shrine, the headquarters of the resistance army.
quests.description_chs: 循着与珊瑚宫心海的约定，你决定前往反抗军本部的珊瑚宫做客…

quests.title: Chasing Shadows
quests.description: The person Diluc called in turned out to be Jean from the Knights of Favonius. After some discussions, it is discovered that it was the Fatui who stole the Holy Lyre der Himmel. You must retrieve it to rescue Dvalin.
quests.description_chs: 迪卢克带来的人正是骑士团的琴，众人一番交谈，发觉窃取天空之琴的是「愚人众」。为了拯救特瓦林，你们必须取回天空之琴。

quests.title: A Boy's Letter
quests.description: Draff of Springvale seems to be fretting over a letter...
quests.description_chs: 清泉镇的杜拉夫先生，似乎正为了一封信而犯愁…

quests.title: Poetry Exchange
quests.description: Ella Musk believes she's come up with another way to communicate with hilichurls. She's looking for somebody to help carry out her idea...
quests.description_chs: 艾拉·马斯克又想出了一个和丘丘人交流的新方法。她正在寻找一个人，来帮助她进行这次的实践…

quests.title: Cleanup At Dawn II
quests.description: At the behest of head housemaid Adelinde, maids Moco and Hillie have begun cleaning up. However, they seem to have run into a spot of trouble...
quests.description_chs: 在女仆长爱德琳的安排下，女仆摩可和海莉也开始了打扫，但是，她们似乎遇见了一点麻烦…

quests.title: Setting Sail
quests.description: It has been a while since you struck an agreement with Beidou to go to Inazuma together. You decide to check on how things are progressing...
quests.description_chs: 与北斗一起前往稻妻的约定已经过去一段时间了，你决定前去打听一下事情的进展…

quests.title: Confessions of an Outlander
quests.description: You arrive at Ritou in Inazuma smoothly and meet up with your contact, Thoma. But it seems that outlanders are far from welcome here...
quests.description_chs: 顺利抵达稻妻的离岛，并与接头人托马相遇。不过异乡人似乎在离岛并不怎么受欢迎…

quests.title: Ritou Escape Plan
quests.description: Thoma has set you a test to leave Ritou by your own power, lest your journey end here...
quests.description_chs: 如何靠自己的力量离开离岛，这是托马留给你的下一环考验，否则旅途就只能停滞不前…

quests.title: Those Who Yearn for the Gods' Gaze
quests.description: You take up the post of leader of Swordfish II. Unexpectedly, Teppei has also received a promotion...
quests.description_chs: 你晋升成为了反抗军「剑鱼二番队」队长，没想到哲平也同样受到了提拔…

quests.title: Delusion
quests.description: The secret weapon and last resort of the resistance is, in fact, Delusions. Teppei's death ignites an unquenchable flame of rage within you...
quests.description_chs: 作为反抗军救命稻草的「秘密武器」竟是邪眼，战友哲平的死使你难以抑制对愚人众的怒火…

quests.title: The Servant's Path
quests.description: Blinded by fury, you fall into a trap laid by Scaramouche. But as you are about to black out, you catch a glimpse of Yae Miko's form...
quests.description_chs: 被愤怒冲昏头脑的你落入了「散兵」的陷阱之中，在你昏迷前的一瞬间，却见到了八重神子的身影…

quests.title: Proof of Guilt
quests.description: You hurry to find proof of your claims to Kujou Sara that the Kujou Clan has betrayed the Shogunate within three days.
quests.description_chs: 三天时限内，为了向九条裟罗证明九条家已经背叛幕府的事实，你需要赶快找到证据。

quests.title: Blind Loyalty, Reckless Courage
quests.description: The evidence of the Tenryou Commission's treason is in your hands. How will Kujou Sara's viewpoint change?
quests.description_chs: 天领奉行背叛幕府的证据已经到手，如此一来，九条裟罗的立场是否会发生转变呢？

quests.title: Duel Before the Throne
quests.description: Kujou Sara storms towards Tenshukaku in a fury. You realize that this is your chance to meet the Raiden Shogun again, but an unexpected yet familiar figure greets you before the throne...
quests.description_chs: 九条裟罗愤怒地冲向天守阁，你意识到这是自己再次见到雷电将军的机会，可在将军的御座之前，赫然出现了另一个熟悉的身影…

quests.title: The Omnipresent God
quests.description: Before the Raiden Shogun's martial might, you sense that initiating Yae Miko's plan may not be as easy as you thought. It might be best to leave Tenshukaku and make further plans from there...
quests.description_chs: 在雷电将军的武艺面前，你意识到想要实现八重神子的计划并没有那么容易，先离开天守阁再做打算吧…

quests.description_chs: 在枫丹科学院，你遇见了枫达开发组的成员安里，他似乎正在为某事而忙碌着…

quests.description: Heinry seems to have made some progress, but who knows just what kind of Fonta he's produced...
quests.description_chs: 安里的研究工作似乎取得了一些进展，不知道他究竟做出了怎样的枫达…

quests.description: This world is about to become a more dangerous place for adventurers. Unlock new challenges, you who are ready. Ad astra abyssosque!
quests.description_chs: 这个世界即将向冒险家呈现出更危险的样貌，倘若你已将一切准备就绪，向着星辰与深渊，开启更深一层的挑战吧。

quests.description: You meet two seemingly troubled Fontainians in Natlan...
quests.description_chs: 在纳塔，你见到了两个看上去很苦恼的枫丹人…

quests.description: Pele Nui of the People of the Springs seems to have encountered some trouble...
quests.description_chs: 「流泉之众」的佩蕾·努伊似乎遇见了一些小麻烦…

quests.title: How to Make Friends
quests.description: Outside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, a Scion of the Canopy seems to be troubled about something...
quests.description_chs: 在圣火竞技场旁边，有一位「悬木人」的部族成员正在为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Prophets of Pop
quests.description: You meet a musician in Natlan named Milu Nui, but he appears to have run into some trouble...
quests.description_chs: 在纳塔，你遇见了一位名为米卢·努伊的音乐人。但他似乎遇见了一些麻烦…
