quests.description_chs: 在「回声之子」部族中，特拉忒正在为某事而发愁…

quests.title: Grow Up Quickly, Littl'Un
quests.description: At the Children of Echoes' tribal settlement, the archaeologist Tahmures and her assistant Akeor appear to have run into some trouble...
quests.description_chs: 在「回声之子」部族中，考古学家塔莫蕾和她的助手阿基约似乎遇见了一些麻烦…

quests.title: Grow Up Quickly, Littl'Un...?
quests.description: At the Children of Echoes' tribal settlement, the archaeologist Tahmures seems extremely anxious about something...
quests.description_chs: 在「回声之子」部族中，考古学家塔莫蕾正焦急万分…

quests.title: Sharpshooter on Hand
quests.description: You meet a poet from Liyue inside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame...
quests.description_chs: 在圣火竞技场中，你遇见了一个璃月诗人…

quests.title: Saurian Versus Mountain
quests.description: Within the Children of Echoes, Tlatem is presently troubled by a certain matter...
quests.description_chs: 在「回声之子」部族中，特拉忒正在为某事而发愁…

quests.title: Saurian Versus Mountain
quests.description: Tlatem, from the Children of Echoes' tribal settlement, is presently troubled by a certain matter...
quests.description_chs: 在「回声之子」部族中，特拉忒正在为某事而发愁…

quests.title: Hey, Your Letter!
quests.description: Michica from the Scions of the Canopy seems to have been having some trouble recently...
quests.description_chs: 「悬木人」的米齐卡，最近遇见了一些麻烦…

quests.title: Hmm? Natlan?
quests.description: You are accosted by someone at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame...
quests.description_chs: 在圣火竞技场，你被一个人叫住了…

quests.title: A Forest of Change
quests.description: You and Paimon arrive in Sumeru, and you prepare to find a way to get an audience with Lesser Lord Kusanali...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙来到须弥，准备寻找觐见小吉祥草王的办法…

quests.title: Further Observation
quests.description: You can't be said to have really settled into rehabilitation at Gandharva Ville yet, but you can still ask Collei for some information.
quests.description_chs: 虽说不得已开始了化城郭的疗养生活，但似乎可以向柯莱打听一些情报。

quests.title: Chronic Illness
quests.description: Yesterday did not quite end so well, so you and Paimon decide to go check on Collei.
quests.description_chs: 因为前一天最后的「不欢而散」，你和派蒙决定去看看柯莱的情况。

quests.title: Silent Seeker of Knowledge
quests.description: According to Tighnari, the Akademiya researcher Haypasia, who lives alone in the forest, is the ideal person to direct Irminsul-related queries to.
quests.description_chs: 按照提纳里的说法，独居林中的教令院学者海芭夏，才是解答世界树相关疑问的最佳人选。

quests.title: The Trail of the God of Wisdom
quests.description: You and Paimon finally arrive at Sumeru City. Well, will you be able to get an audience with the Dendro Archon?
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙终于到达了须弥城，接下来能否顺利找到觐见草神的办法呢？

quests.title: Lost in Prosperity
quests.description: Learning that the stolen package may have something to do with the gods, you and Paimon immediately set out for Port Ormos.
quests.description_chs: 得知教令院的失物可能与神明有关后，你和派蒙立刻动身前往奥摩斯港…

quests.title: Ever So Close
quests.description: As agreed, you gain Dori's trust. Now, it is finally time to discuss "business" with Alhaitham.
quests.description_chs: 既然依照约定成功获得了多莉的信任，接下来终于可以和艾尔海森谈谈「正事」了。

quests.title: The Coming of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description: The Sabzeruz Festival is about to begin. As agreed, you return to Sumeru City to find Dunyarzad and take part in the festival together.
quests.description_chs: 花神诞日已经快到了，按照约定，你回到须弥城寻找迪娜泽黛，准备一起参加花神诞祭。

quests.title: The Arrival of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description: As agreed, you go to the festival with Dunyarzad and others... Wait... This feels somewhat familiar...
quests.description_chs: 按照约定，你和迪娜泽黛等人一起参加花神诞祭…等等…好像有些熟悉…

quests.title: The Continuation of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description: You come to attend today's Sabzeruz Festival, but you are haunted by a lingering sense of déjà vu...
quests.description_chs: 你来参加了今天的花神诞祭，可伴随你的，却是挥之不去的既视感…

quests.title: The Samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description: Now you know very well that this is not the first time you have attended the Sabzeruz Festival. To save Dunyarzad, you must find a way to get to the bottom of the truth.
quests.description_chs: 如今你很清楚，这早就不是你第一次参加花神诞祭了。为了拯救迪娜泽黛，必须想办法找到真相。

quests.title: The Causality of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description: The samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival continues. Are you really getting close to the truth?
quests.description_chs: 「花神诞日的轮回」仍在继续着，你真的有在向着真相迈进吗？

quests.title: The End of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description: Discovering the truth behind the samsara of the Sabzeruz Festival is not enough. You still need to find a way to break out of it. The good news is, you now see a glimmer of hope...
quests.description_chs: 只是破解了「花神诞日的轮回」的真相还不够，你还需要找到脱离现状的方法，但至少已经看到希望…

quests.title: Dawn
quests.description: In the end, Nilou's dance ushered in the dawn. If memory serves, you seemed to have seen Dunyarzad in front of the stage...
quests.description_chs: 最终妮露的舞蹈给大家带来了黎明。如果没有记错的话，那时你似乎也在舞台前看到了迪娜泽黛…

quests.title: The Empty Illusions of the Sabzeruz Festival
quests.description: In your memory, you never seem to have tried to go outside the city, which is curious.\nToday you decide to try...
quests.description_chs: 在你的记忆里，似乎从来没有尝试过到城外去，这令人感到好奇。今天的你决定进行尝试…

quests.title_chs: (test)须弥3.0主线第一天锁时间逻辑处理$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)须弥3.0主线第一天锁时间逻辑处理$HIDDEN

quests.title: Like a Triumphant Hero
quests.description: It has been a long time since the Sabzeruz samsara, and many things cannot be ascertained until Nahida gets back in form. Today, you go to the Adventurers' Guild as usual...
quests.description_chs: 「花神诞日的轮回」事件已过去许久，在纳西妲回复精力之前，许多事情还无法查明。这天你如同往常一样，前往冒险家协会…

quests.title: The Gaze From a Certain God
quests.description: The unexpected appearance of the Fatui Harbinger, The Doctor, means that the Fatui must have played a part in the nefarious plot involving the Sumeru Akademiya... You must act now.
quests.description_chs: 愚人众执行官「博士」的出场令人始料未及，这也意味着须弥教令院背后酝酿的阴谋有愚人众的参与…必须抓紧行动了。

quests.title: The Four at Loggerheads
quests.description: You have temporarily lost Nahida's help, but according to the message she left behind, you will meet someone in the desert who can help you get out of the woods. To foil the nefarious plot between the Akademiya and the Fatui, you set off on another journey.
quests.description_chs: 暂时失去了纳西妲的助力，但根据纳西妲留下的信息，你将会在沙漠遇到可以帮忙打破现状的帮手。为了破坏教令院与愚人众的阴谋，你再次踏上旅程。

quests.title: The Missing Village Keepers
quests.description: Entrusted by Isak, a resident of Aaru Village, you and Cyno begin looking for clues about the Village Keepers...
quests.description_chs: 受阿如村居民伊萨克委托，你和赛诺一起在村子里寻找有关守村人的线索…

quests.title: Cry From the Eleazar Hospital
quests.description: After arresting the Radicals together with Dehya, you escorted them back to Aaru Village. The testimony revealed the involvement of a mysterious man and his forces. At the same time, Alhaitham has appeared in front of the village chief's house...
quests.description_chs: 与迪希雅一起抓捕激进派人士后，你们将这些人押送回阿如村。证词将矛头指向神秘人及其背后的势力，与此同时，艾尔海森出现在村长家门口…

quests.title: Secret of the Scorching Desert
quests.description: As agreed, you go to the place designated by Rahman to exchange hostages...
quests.description_chs: 根据约定，你们前往拉赫曼指定的地点准备交换人质…

quests.title: Jnagarbha Day
quests.description: The Akademiya's Jnagarbha Day has finally come. All your plans and preparations are for one purpose, and one purpose only — to save a god.
quests.description_chs: 终于到了「识藏日」的这天，一切计划安排与一切的准备，都只为了一个目标——「拯救神明」。
（test）3.1须弥主线下隐藏对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Through the Predawn Night
quests.description: As agreed, you and the others gather in the village chief's house to hold a meeting...
quests.description_chs: 依照约定，众人在阿如村村长家集合并召开会议…

quests.title: As by a God's Side
quests.description: As your plan progresses, more and more preparations have been done for the important day. However, this does not mean the process is as smooth as can be...
quests.description_chs: 随着计划推进，为重要之日所做的准备也越来越全面。然而，这并不意味着过程中没有意外…

quests.title: A Toast to Victory
quests.description: The operation to save Lesser Lord Kusanali has concluded. Despite the many surreal experiences that ensued, you feel surprisingly calm after waking up again in bed, facing the rising sun.
quests.description_chs: 拯救小吉祥草王行动顺利告结，虽说之后发生了许多超乎想象的事，但再一次从卧榻上醒过来面对着朝阳，心情竟很平静…
海芭夏&纳西妲$HIDDEN

quests.title: Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies
quests.description: Although you have saved Lesser Lord Kusanali, there is no time to celebrate or rest, for there is a nascent god to stop and Irminsul to save... Now, the fate of Teyvat is in your hands.
quests.description_chs: 尽管已经成功救下小吉祥草王纳西妲，但没有时间欢喜或是喘息。阻止新神的诞生，拯救世界树…这一刻，提瓦特的命运似乎都背负在了你们身上。

quests.title: The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call
quests.description: In order to look for more information about your sibling, you and Paimon decide to visit Nahida in the Sanctuary of Surasthana once more. Along the way, you hear people discussing something...
quests.description_chs: 为了得到更多有关血亲的信息，你和派蒙再次前往净善宫拜访纳西妲，途中，你们听到有人正在讨论某个话题…

quests.title: A Dance of Destruction
quests.description: The Balladeer has caused a series of unexpected consequences within Irminsul, and you're the only one aware of that. In order to ascertain the situation, you head off to Inazuma...
quests.description_chs: 散兵在世界树内部的作为引发了一连串意想不到的后果，而你是唯一见证人。为了确认变化情况，你动身前往稻妻…

quests.title: The Kabukimono's Finale
quests.description: The information you gathered left you with a heavy heart. You decide to return to the Sanctuary of Surasthana and tell Nahida about everything you learned...
quests.description_chs: 种种结果令人心情沉重。你决定返回净善宫，将这些事告知纳西妲…

quests.title: As Though Morning Dew
quests.description: The puppet has given up his original name. Just as the title "Wanderer" suggests, he has truly become a person with no name.
quests.description_chs: 人偶已然舍弃他原本的名字，如「流浪者」这一称号所示，他成了一个无名之人。
（test）修改3.3间章完成后任务$HIDDEN

quests.title: Where Flowers Awaken
quests.description: Following a tranquil stay in Nod-Krai, you check in with Katheryne to see if anything noteworthy has happened lately.
quests.description_chs: 在挪德卡莱度过了一段安宁的时光。去问问凯瑟琳最近有没有什么值得注意的事情吧。

quests.title: A Divergence Leading to Oneself
quests.description: The situation appears far worse than you previously imagined, with anomalies occurring in Irminsul and Nahida in a coma... It seems best to first leave Sumeru City with everyone and head for Caravan Ribat.
quests.description_chs: 看来情况比想象中要严重不少，世界树出现异常，纳西妲也昏迷不醒…先跟随众人一同离开须弥城，前往喀万驿吧。

quests.title: Ancient Shadows Re-Emerge
quests.description: The Jinn-induced sandstorm has subsided. Return to the Temple of Silence and discuss the situation with your friends.
quests.description_chs: 镇灵引发的沙暴被顺利平息，回到缄默之殿跟朋友们交流一下现状吧。

quests.title: Winds of the Past
quests.description: To stop Stormterror's siege, you must venture out and eliminate the elemental flows left within the ruined Temples of the Four Winds. Amber is waiting for you at the Temple of the Falcon.
quests.description_chs: 为了消除风魔龙的威胁，你们需要消灭废墟中残留的力量。为此，你前往西风之鹰的庙宇，安柏正在庙宇门口等待你们。

quests.title: Crash Course
quests.description: Kaeya will accompany you to explore the Temple of the Wolf.
quests.description_chs: 北风之狼的庙宇由骑士凯亚与你们一道探索。

quests.title: Sparks Amongst the Pages
quests.description: Lisa is in charge of clearing the Temple of the Lion alongside you.
quests.description_chs: 丽莎负责与你们共同扫查南风之狮的庙宇。
送礼任务测试$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: First Stage Ended
quests.description: After completing the first stage, talk to Paimon for a hidden quest
quests.description_chs: 一阶段结束后，与派蒙对话的隐藏任务$HIDDEN

quests.title: Wanderer's Trail
quests.description: The god took away your only kin, and you were sealed and cast into a deep slumber. Upon your awakening, you wandered alone for a time until you met a strange companion named Paimon, thus beginning your journey through the continent of Teyvat...
quests.description_chs: 神带走了你唯一的血亲，而你也被神封印，陷入沉眠。醒来后你先是独自流浪，后来又与奇妙的伙伴「派蒙」相遇，开启了提瓦特大陆的探索之旅…

quests.title: Bird's Eye View
quests.description: You begin your journey in Starfell Valley, exploring the land and seeing its sights together with Paimon.
quests.description_chs: 从坠星山谷启程，你和派蒙走走看看，一路前行。

quests.title: Unexpected Power
quests.description: As you advanced, a Statue of The Seven appeared on the horizon ahead of you. At Paimon's suggestion, you go to investigate.
quests.description_chs: 在你们前进的道路上，出现了一座奇特的「七天神像」。在派蒙的建议下，你上前查看。

quests.title: Wind-Riding Knight
quests.description: On the path to Mondstadt, you inadvertently eavesdropped on a meeting between a huge dragon and a mysterious figure. As you proceeded with various doubts in mind, a perky young girl showed up to block your path.
quests.description_chs: 在前往蒙德城的路上，你们意外打搅了巨龙与神秘人的相会。在带着疑惑继续前行的你面前，一位轻盈的少女突然出现，挡住了你的去路。

quests.title: Forest Rendezvous
quests.description: Unexpectedly, the power of Anemo within the Statue of The Seven resonated with you. You decided to begin your investigation with the Anemo Archon of Teyvat's Seven Archons. As such, the first order of the day is to reach the land under the Anemo Archon's protection: Mondstadt.
quests.description_chs: 令人意外的是，七天神像中的风元素之力竟与你产生了呼应。你们决定，先从提瓦特七神中的风神开始调查，于是，你们的第一步，便是前往风神护佑之地：蒙德城。

quests.title: City of Freedom
quests.description: With your help, the problem was resolved quickly. Led by Amber, you reach the city of freedom — Mondstadt.
quests.description_chs: 有了你们的帮助，麻烦很快解决。在安柏的带领下，你们来到了自由城邦——蒙德。

quests.title: Dragon Storm
quests.description: The usually peaceful Mondstadt was suddenly assailed by a dragon. This is the Stormterror that Amber spoke of, and was the gigantic creature that you encountered in the forest earlier.
quests.description_chs: 本该宁静祥和的蒙德城中，巨龙突然来袭。它正是安柏提到的风魔龙，亦是你们先前在林中遇见的巨兽。

quests.title: Knights of Favonius
quests.description: You repelled Stormterror with some difficulty. Kaeya of the Knights of Favonius witnessed the battle, and you were invited to make a trip to the Knights headquarters.
quests.description_chs: 你们艰难击退了来袭的风魔龙。来自西风骑士团的凯亚目睹了这一过程，此后，你们受邀前往骑士团总部一叙。
隐藏任务，控制蒙德城的天气和三地城的光线特效$HIDDEN

quests.title: Going Upon the Breeze
quests.description: The girl's name is Amber, and her duty as an Outrider is to escort you to Mondstadt. However, she has another task to attend to first, which is to clean out the hilichurls that have been wandering around outside the city.
quests.description_chs: 少女名为安柏，身为侦察骑士的她提出护送你们前往蒙德。但是在那之前，她得先解决城外四处游荡的丘丘人，这是她此次出城的任务。

quests.title_chs: (test)控制第一幕开始的隐藏任务$HIDDEN

quests.title: Shadow Over Mondstadt
quests.description: Thanks to your efforts, Mondstadt's elemental flow has returned to normal. It's time to report back to Jean.
quests.description_chs: 在你们的努力下，蒙德的元素流动终于回归了正常，是时候回到蒙德，向琴回报你们的进展了。

quests.title: Unexpected Encounter
quests.description: Returning to Mondstadt, you encountered a clash between Jean and the Fatui. Afterward, you showed Jean the dragon tear that you found in the forest, and at her request, once again joined the investigation into Stormterror Dvalin.
quests.description_chs: 你们回到蒙德城，偶然遇到了琴与「愚人众」的冲突。此后你向琴展示了在森林中发现的风龙泪滴，在琴的请求下，你又一次参与到了对风魔龙特瓦林的调查之中。

quests.title: That Green Fellow
quests.description: As you were heading out to investigate, you happened upon the mysterious guy that you saw talking to the dragon.
quests.description_chs: 正准备出发调查的你们，在骑士团总部的门外，见到了跟风魔龙对话的神秘家伙。

quests.title: Let the Wind Lead
quests.description: The mysterious fellow claimed to be a bard named Venti, but left on his own accord before you could get him to explain his relationship with the dragon. You follow him to the giant tree at Windrise.
quests.description_chs: 这位神秘人自称吟游诗人温迪，你还没等到温迪解释清与巨龙的联系，他便自顾自离开了。追着他的脚步，你们来到了风起地的巨树下。

quests.title: Venti's Plan
quests.description: Stopped at last, Venti explained that he had tried and failed to cleanse Dvalin's curse during their previous meeting. Now, he has been forced to rely on the Holy Lyre der Himmel's power if he is to restore Dvalin.
quests.description_chs: 终于停下脚步的温迪向你解释，他在低语森林中与特瓦林相见时，本想为它清除诅咒，却没能成功。现在，如果想要让特瓦林恢复本心，不得不依赖「天空之琴」的力量。

quests.title: Venti's New Plan
quests.description: Venti's plan to sweet talk his way into getting the Holy Lyre back backfires. He's come up with a new plan, but seems he'll need your help for it to work.
quests.description_chs: 温迪准备用花言巧语将天空之琴骗到手的计划毫不意外的失败了，于是温迪想了个新计划，这个新计划看来需要你的帮助。

quests.title: Wild Escape
quests.description: Venti's plan to steal the Holy Lyre went off without a hitch. Well, almost — when the Lyre was almost in your hands, a stranger stole it from under your noses. Your movements alerted the guards, forcing you to flee the Cathedral.
quests.description_chs: 你几乎完美地执行了温迪的计划，眼看天空之琴即将到手，一个陌生人突然出现拿走了天空之琴。而你们的动静也惊动了守卫，一行人只得仓皇逃出大教堂。

quests.title: Behind the Scenes
quests.description: In your haste fleeing from the confusion, you found yourself in Diluc's tavern, where — to your surprise — he decided to help hide you. Diluc agrees to meet back at the tavern after nightfall with his "contacts" — who could they be?
quests.description_chs: 从大教堂中逃出的你们慌不择路的逃进了迪卢克的酒馆，但是迪卢克意外的决定庇护并帮助你。于是，在迪卢克的引荐下，你们在打烊后的酒馆遇到了意想不到的人。

quests.title: State of the Holy Lyre der Himmel
quests.description: After a fierce battle, you managed to seize the Holy Lyre der Himmel back from the hands of the Fatui. For some reason, Venti seems to express a great nostalgia for the Lyre...
quests.description_chs: 你们历经战斗，终于从愚人众的手中取回了失窃的天空之琴。不知道为什么，温迪对天空之琴表现得甚为怀念。

quests.title: Fallen Tears
quests.description: The Holy Lyre is in poor condition, but you manage to restore some of its Anemo power by using Dvalin's tears. To restore its full power, you will need to look for more tears.
quests.description_chs: 天空之琴的状态已经不如以往，但是通过风龙泪滴，你们成功地将风元素注入到天空之琴中。为了让天空之琴进一步恢复力量，你们需要更多的风龙泪滴。

quests.title: Hidden Tears
quests.description: Dvalin's footprints are all over Mondstadt, and one of his tears fell upon a ruin deep within the forest.
quests.description_chs: 特瓦林的足迹遍布蒙德，其中一颗泪滴掉落在林中废墟。

quests.title: Stolen Tears
quests.description: The corrupted dragon tear has even attracted hilichurls. You must get it back from them.
quests.description_chs: 被污染的风龙泪滴甚至吸引了丘丘人，你不得不向丘丘人讨回泪滴。

quests.title: Crystal Tears
quests.description: After completing the retrieval of the tears, you meet up with the rest of the group.
quests.description_chs: 泪滴收集完毕，你们一行人再度汇合。

quests.title: Reunion With the Dragon
quests.description: Dvalin's tears restored the Holy Lyre back to its full power. Now, you are finally ready to purify Stormterror.
quests.description_chs: 借助风龙泪滴的力量，天空之琴完全恢复了力量。净化风魔龙的准备已经完成。

quests.title: Let's go on an Adventure
quests.description: The Adventurers' Guild can give you Adventure Reports on the area surrounding Mondstadt. All reports are free!
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会会介绍给你蒙德周边的冒险情报。情报都是公开免费的哦~$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: Hurdle
quests.description: You came to Stormterror's Lair to once again attempt Dvalin's rescue. However, it is surrounded by wind barriers made by Stormterror, and the dark forces at work have no intention of letting you break through those barriers so easily.
quests.description_chs: 你们来到风龙废墟，再次试图拯救特瓦林，而风魔龙的住所正被暴风的障壁包围着。但幕后黑手无意让你们就这么轻松地突破风障。

quests.title: Empty Abode
quests.description: Assailed by many enemies, you realize that this road will not be an easy one. The way into Stormterror's Lair is strewn with obstacles, and so you must proceed with caution to find a path along the ruined walls.
quests.description_chs: 敌人来袭，你们意识到这一路上不会轻松。进入风龙废墟的道路上充满了障碍，你们不得不小心观察，从残垣断壁中寻找道路。

quests.title: Light Guiding Ceremony
quests.description: The entrance to Stormterror's Lair is just ahead, but the light seals bar the way in. You must once again face a trial in order to break those seals.
quests.description_chs: 风龙废墟的入口就在眼前，光之封印阻挡了你进入废墟深处。为了解除封印，你再次面临考验。

quests.title: Calm Before the Storm
quests.description: The three light seals have each been broken by you in their turn, and the path to the decisive showdown is open. You once again return to the lair's entrance to put an end to things.
quests.description_chs: 三层封印一一被你解除，决战的道路已经打开。为了终结这一切，你们回到了废墟入口。

quests.title: A Long Shot
quests.description: After a long and daring pursuit of Dvalin, who has been led astray by the Abyss Mages, you are about to finally confront him once and for all.
quests.description_chs: 追逐着被深渊法师蛊惑的特瓦林，你们即将迎来与它的正面对决。

quests.title: Ending Note
quests.description: Amber says that Jean is waiting for you at the Cathedral. Apparently, it's something to do with the Holy Lyre der Himmel...
quests.description_chs: 听安柏说，琴团长正在大教堂等你，似乎与天空之琴事件的收尾事宜有关…

quests.title: Abyss Mage
quests.description: You used the Holy Lyre der Himmel to summon Stormterror, only to be prevented from saving it due to the interference of the Abyss Order. But you haven't given up yet — and Diluc has been able to swiftly obtain a new lead...
quests.description_chs: 你们用天空之琴唤来了风魔龙，却在深渊教团的阻挠下，没能成功挽回它的心意。但你们并没有放弃，迪卢克很快得到了新的线索…

quests.title: When the Wind Dies Down
quests.description: You finally managed to save Dvalin. Is this where the story of the wind ends?
quests.description_chs: 在你们的努力下，特瓦林终于被解救。风带来的故事，是否就此随之落幕了呢？
(test)拆qq人营地奖励$HIDDEN

quests.title_chs: (test)任务结束后与温迪的空闲对话$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)任务结束后与温迪的空闲对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Like the Faint Moonlight of Yesteryear
quests.description: Lyney has been acquitted, but you are not sure about what your next step should be. You decide to take up Navia's offer for a farewell meal to celebrate your cooperation...
quests.description_chs: 林尼的冤案得到解决，你对下一步行动似乎有些迷茫。面对十分珍惜与你的合作关系的娜维娅，你决定回应她的邀请去吃「散伙饭」…

quests.title: Liyue: Theater Mechanicus
quests.description: Ruijin from Liyue Harbor is promoting a new "game"...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的瑞锦正在招呼人过去玩一种新型的「游戏」…

quests.title: Towards the Lanterns Origin
quests.description: Every year, on the day of the first full moon, the Lantern Rite of Liyue takes place. On that night, everyone in Liyue releases Xiao Lanterns and Mingxiao Lanterns into the bright night sky. Within each of the xiao lanterns, placed a natural levitation stone, and on it hung one's wishful prayer, or a painting depicting one's desire. The lanterns slowly fly away while carrying a hope that the lights emitted by the lanterns might guide the soul of once Liyue's faithful protector, to return and reunite once more. You and Paimon have arrived at this solemn moment of Liyue, preparing for your five-days-long journey...
quests.description_chs: 每年第一个月圆之夜，就是璃月的「海灯节」。在夜里，人们会放出「霄灯」和「明霄灯」，升上夜空。「霄灯」中编入了天然浮空的「浮生石」，挂上书写心愿或绘制图画的愿签放飞，祈愿历史上曾护佑璃月的英雄魂魄寻灯归来，一聚团圆。你与派蒙来到了节日期间的璃月，准备度过为期五日的旅程…$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Water Beneath the Lanterns Flows Deep
quests.description: The most awaited moment of the Lantern Rite is the time when a giant Mingxiao Lantern released into the sky on the night of the fifth day. And the size of the Mingxiao Lantern this year is a sight that you don't want to miss, as the levitation stone used to make the giant lantern float this year is the biggest in 20 years. On this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have prepared a Xiao Market, which was built using the same materials as the lanterns. When you arrived at the Xiao Market, the event organizer Huixin asked you for a favor...
quests.description_chs: 在海灯节，最重要的一项活动，就是在第五日的夜晚放飞巨型花灯「明霄灯」。今年的「明霄灯」壮景可期。用来让巨灯浮空的那块「浮生石」，是二十年来最大的一块。为此，璃月的商人们开设了「霄市」，筹集建灯所用的材料。今天你来到「霄市」时，负责操办节日事宜的慧心，似乎有事想要拜托你…$UNRELEASED

quests.title: In the City of Geo Live the Adepti
quests.description: Materials which are used to make lanterns are all easily flammable, and they're piling up at Liyue's port. Between the mountains of materials, you saw a mysterious figure, which shortly got annoyed by your presence and told you off. You and Paimon shared a look and stared at the piles of wood, paper, and oil... You have a bad feeling about this and you went to the Ministry of Civil Affairs to report the situation. Now you're wondering how they're handling the situation, and you've decided to go and see.
quests.description_chs: 在码头上，大量堆放着建灯所用的易燃材料。而在成堆的材料之间，你见到了形影鬼祟的可疑人士。可疑人士不愿被打扰，呵斥着要你离开。你与派蒙望向木、纸、油……堆积的景象，心中升起了不好的预感。于是你前往璃月总务司，向千岩军的守卫报告了情况。不知他们处理得怎么样了？事关重大，你决定再去打听一番。$UNRELEASED

quests.title: To My Old Friend, Wind Brings My Greetings
quests.description: After receiving your help, Millelith is finally able to assign a little group to reinforce their defenses around the city. Unsatisfied with the lack of effort from them, you've come back to the area hoping to find more clues. To your surprise, you met Xiao, a Liyue adeptus who also has the same intention as you. You both discovered that there are some markings at the corners of the construction site. "If a shackle within the realm of deities and demons got loose, I shall take full responsibility." "But this time, the threat comes from the mortal world —— your world, and thus, you shall take full responsibility, mortal traveler." said the adeptus to you. To decipher the markings and to learn its origin, you're reminded of that person that you've met in Mondstadt, a knight who prioritizes results above all else without caring about every trivial law...
quests.description_chs: 为忙碌至极的千岩军稍微搭了把手以后，终于有一个小队表示，可以抽出人力来加强戒备了。而怀疑此事只是杯水车薪的你，回到了现场，想要再发现一些有用的线索或踪迹。出乎意料地，在堆放易燃材料的现场，你遇到了同样在查看可疑痕迹的璃月仙人——魈。建设现场角落的暗处，被人画下了一个符号。「如果在仙与魔的世界，有什么东西失去桎梏，那就是我的责任。」「但这次的威胁来自人类的世界——你们的世界，所以这是你的责任，人类旅者。」仙人是这样对你说的。为了问明这个符号的来历，你想到了之前在蒙德结识的那位，黑白通吃、游走于灰色地带的骑士…$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Lanterns in the Sea
quests.description: Through Kaeya's informant, you found out that it's a kind of communication marking used by the Treasure Thieves, a criminal organization spanning across Teyvat. It seems this whole thing is not as serious as you originally thought. The Treasure Thieves in Liyue just received an anonymous letter. Out of fear and respect for Xiao, the Treasure Thieves gave the letter to you. The sender requested that someone of high rank from the Treasure Thieves meet with them secretly in Liyue to discuss an important matter. Once again, out of fear and respect for Xiao, they agreed to let you play as a high ranking official of the Treasure Thieves and meet the mysterious sender.
quests.description_chs: 从凯亚的线人那里，你了解到那是跨境黑道组织「盗宝团」的联络符号。事情的真相似乎没有先前猜测得那么可怕。盗宝团的璃月分部，刚才接到了一封匿名信。在魈的威名威慑之下，盗宝团将那封信交给了你。信的主人要求盗宝团高层与他在璃月某处密会，有大事相商。再次地，在魈的威名威慑之下，真正的盗宝团成员同意让你假扮高层，前往信中地址，在约定的时间与匿名信主会面…$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Mysterious Islands: Journey to the Unknown

quests.description_chs: 许久不见可莉了，去骑士团探望她吧！

quests.title: Summer Vacation: Proceed With Caution

quests.description_chs: 看似独立于一切地域之外的海岛，却藏有大量不为人知的机关和秘密。一行人暂时在此驻扎，开启了共同的临海夏日生活…

quests.title: Dodo-King of the Sea: Lying in Wait
quests.title_chs: 海中魔王！静候已久之人
quests.description: The party learns from Barbara that their surroundings seem to be changing once again. Where will the trail lead this time? How many stories lay buried among these islands? And who know what the next surprise will be?
quests.description_chs: 众人从芭芭拉口中得知，周围似乎又有了新的变化。这一次，线索会指向什么？这片海岛背后究竟藏有多少故事，又会在什么时候放出新的「惊喜」呢？

quests.title: The Final Riddle: A Secret Uncovered
quests.title_chs: 最终谜题！秘藏至今的答案
quests.description: Thanks to a joint effort, the party finds the key to solving the final riddle. The truth behind these islands is now within reach, but Klee seems to be more anxious than ever. What is the truth that has quietly sat in wait all this time?
quests.description_chs: 经过共同努力，一行人找到了解除最终机关的方法。真相变得触手可及，然而，可莉却十分紧张。一直以来静静存在着的答案，究竟是…？

quests.title: One for the Foodies, Two for the Show
quests.title_chs: 一筷食二轮烹三餐尽欢四海扬名五味俱全
quests.description: Paimon, ever-gluttonous, pulls you over to Wanmin Restaurant for a good meal. There, you happen to meet Xiangling, who is deep in thought...
quests.description_chs: 馋虫发作的派蒙拉着你去万民堂吃好吃的，刚巧遇到了正在动脑筋的香菱…

quests.title: Three to Get Ready, and Here We Go

quests.description_chs: 大赛在即，你和派蒙去万民堂找香菱…

quests.description_chs: 调查并未得出结论，歌剧院却已将新的罪人送上审判之位。你和娜维娅只得分头行动，为真相拼尽全力…

quests.description: The situation in Inazuma has stabilized, but neither you nor Paimon has been idle. You decide to head over to the Adventurers' Guild and accept a new commission...
quests.description_chs: 稻妻的局势已趋于稳定，但你和派蒙并没有闲下来。你们打算前往冒险家协会，接受新的委托…

quests.description_chs: 经过一段时间的等待，「诀箓阴阳寮」完成了重组。你们准备与辛焱碰头，再次深入「诀箓阴阳寮」，帮助「式大将」找回记忆…

quests.title: Away With Obsessions and Falsehood
quests.description: The time for the critical battle has arrived. You return to the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and meet up with Childe and Shiki Taishou. Time to get to the bottom of all these mysteries...
quests.description_chs: 最关键的一战即将到来，你们将回到「诀箓阴阳寮」中，会合「公子」与「式大将」，解开所有谜题…

quests.title: Path of the Taishou
quests.description: This storm has passed. You and Paimon prepare to visit Shiki Taishou again to see how the Mystic Onmyou Chamber is doing...
quests.description_chs: 这场风波已然平息，你和派蒙准备造访「式大将」，查看「诀箓阴阳寮」的近况…

quests.description_chs: 因为一些奇奇怪怪的想法，派蒙拉着你一同前往蒙德城内的炼金铺…

quests.title: The Snowy Past
quests.description: Paimon, struck by a bout of imagination, drags you off to the alchemy store in Mondstadt to expound her bold hypothesis to Sucrose and Timaeus, but is told that the best person to answer such questions is, in fact, the scholarly Albedo. However, the person waiting for you there is...

quests.description_chs: 受刻晴所托，见多识广的你陪着她研究起了节日送礼一事…

quests.title: The Stars Inscribe the Year's Wishes

quests.description_chs: 意料之外的烟花失窃案，让刻晴越发忙碌…

quests.description: It is time to go to Fontaine, it seems. The next phase of your journey is about to begin...
quests.description_chs: 前往枫丹的时机似乎已经到了，旅者是时候踏上前往枫丹的道路…

quests.description_chs: 与水神匆匆会面以后，你应林尼的邀请，决定前往歌剧院参加他和琳妮特的魔术首演。

quests.description: Although you solved the issue of the towers of the three realms in the three corners, and the darkness covering Enkanomiya has been cleared, a specter of unease still hangs over the Dainichi Mikoshi...
quests.description_chs: 虽然解决了三角三界之塔，渊下宫的黑暗被涤荡一空。但是大日御舆处反而出现了不安的黑云…

quests.title: A Strange Story in Konda
quests.description: A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...
quests.description_chs: 在奇异的狐狸雕像前，戴着面具的神秘巫女似乎有事相求…

quests.description_chs: 魔术现场突发意外，被选中的观众也不知所踪。所有矛头都指向了林尼和琳妮特，但你仍然对此抱有疑问…

quests.title: That Which Our Ancestors Entrusted
quests.description: Concerned about the progress of the Watatsumi Goryou Matsuri, you decide to visit Sangonomiya Shrine...
quests.description_chs: 你很关心海祇御灵祭的进展，于是决定再去一趟珊瑚宫…

quests.title: The Golden Apple Vacation Returns!
quests.description: As summer comes into its own, you receive a mysterious letter. "To Whomsoever Finds This Letter" — the sender seems to be waiting for someone...
quests.description_chs: 随盛夏一同到来的还有一封神秘来信。见字如晤，寄信者似乎在等什么人…

quests.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quests.description: The first day on the island was rather peaceful, yet things start to get strange the next morning... and this seems to only be the beginning. You and the others trace the strange phenomena to an island and find a bonsai that is not supposed to be there.
quests.description_chs: 到海岛的第一天姑且算得上平静。然而次日一早，事情就变得有些奇妙…似乎无论如何也平静不下来了。受异象指引，众人来到一处小岛，在那里，他们竟见到一座本不该出现在这里的盆景…

quests.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quests.description: After touching the bonsai, everyone enters some kind of mysterious mirage — an old mansion where the long-forgotten past of a clan resurfaces... This place is intimately linked to Kaedehara Kazuha.
quests.description_chs: 触碰盆景，众人进入一片不可思议的幻境。古老的宅邸，沉眠多年的家族往事…这里与枫原万叶有着千丝万缕的联系。

quests.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quests.description: As you explore further, the mirage becomes ever more peculiar. Perhaps the decrepit view is a reflection of what Kazuha has been through. You wonder how those hardships he experienced will shape the view in his heart.
quests.description_chs: 随着进一步探索，幻境展现出了更为奇特的形貌。摇摇欲坠的景象，或许正是万叶一路走来所见。不知这种种坎坷，又能在他心中构筑出何种「景」。

quests.title: Blazin' Trails
quests.description: Following the result of Mona's divination, the party heads to another island. There, you see a strangely shaped plant which looks like... some kind of musical instrument?
quests.description_chs: 根据莫娜的占卜结果，众人登上另一座小岛。静候于那处的，是造型奇特又极富个性的植物，远远看起来就像…咦，这不是乐器吗？

quests.title: Blazin' Trails
quests.description: After drinking the spring water you found for her and recovering her voice, the fiery flower named "Blazing Heart" sends you and the others to the hall of music. The city in the mirage is strikingly similar to Liyue Harbor...
quests.description_chs: 烈焰之花「火炽之心」请众人为其找来唤醒嗓音的泉水。之后，「火炽之心」送众人前往音乐殿堂。幻境中的城镇，其模样像极了璃月港…

quests.title: Into the Deepwater Murk
quests.description: The open day has finally arrived. This is undoubtedly a good chance to find some information. You and Paimon plan to act, and search for clues in the Fortress of Meropide...
quests.description_chs: 期待已久的开放日终于到来了，毫无疑问这是个打听消息的好日子。你和派蒙按计划行事，在梅洛彼得堡内寻找线索…

quests.title: Blazin' Trails
quests.description: Plants and instruments, melodies and memories, old acquaintances and her hometown... All of them constitute a crucial part of Xinyan's music. There must be some reason that her mirage has shown up on this special island.
quests.description_chs: 植物与乐器、音符与回忆、故人与家乡…点点滴滴，都是构成辛焱心中「音乐」的要素。属于她的幻境诞生在这样一座特别的岛屿上，一定有什么原因。

quests.title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse
quests.description: Fischl has not returned, so the party decides to explore the island first and confirm whether there is a mirage as the divination result indicated and to whom it belongs. Soon, everyone finds a night raven statue, along with a mysterious book that it has brought here — Hymn of the Holy Land. After touching the book, you and the others enter the mirage within...
quests.description_chs: 鉴于菲谢尔迟迟未归队，众人决定先一步在岛上探索，验证占卜结果说的下一片幻境是否存在，又属于谁。很快，大家就找到了沙滩上的夜鸦雕像，和一本它所带来的奇妙书籍——《圣国的咏唱》。通过触碰它，众人进入了书中的幻境…

quests.title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse
quests.description: A lofty castle, an unforgettable tale... This must be Fischl's imaginary world. Her mirage is so amazing that every visitor is deeply impressed. However, a mesmerizing dream does not come without a price, just as beautiful flowers often bloom among thistles and thorns...
quests.description_chs: 高耸入云的城堡、萦绕耳畔的传奇故事…这一切，应当就是菲谢尔心中的「世界」了吧。她的幻境是如此惊人，令每一位来访者赞叹。然而，绮梦并非毫无代价，美丽的花朵常诞生于荆棘丛…

quests.title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse
quests.description: There is another Fischl here — born from the darkness, she dominates everything in Immernachtreich. Can fear and cowardice devour souls? Which one of the two Prinzessinnen shall triumph in the end?
quests.description_chs: 另一位菲谢尔——她诞生自黑暗，正君临此地主宰幽夜净土的一切。恐惧与懦弱是否能吞噬心灵？两位皇女，谁又能成为最终赢家？

quests.title: The Ancient Azure Stars
quests.description: Without the need for further divination, everyone heads to the final island in search of the next mirage.
quests.description_chs: 不需要更多占卜，众人前往最后的岛屿寻找下个幻境。

quests.title: The Ancient Azure Stars
quests.description: Upon hearing the voices deep within her heart, Mona becomes lost in some old memories. She has a unique understanding of Astrology and believes in fate regardless of what others think. With this belief in her heart, she leads everyone to explore the mirage...
quests.description_chs: 来自莫娜心底深处的自言自语唤起了许多古老回忆。对于占星术，莫娜有着独特的见解，无论人们是否认可，她都相信「命运」。带着这份信念，她带领众人进一步探索幻境…

quests.title: The Ancient Azure Stars
quests.description: The vast expanse of the starry sky extends endlessly into the distance, with many a fate hidden within. It is simply fascinating: The beautiful sky stands silently in the mirage, its bosom wide and vast, its very existence ancient and gentle, as if it was born to embrace all hankerings after destiny and to grace everyone with its compassion. Mona understands fate in a way similar to this starry sky.
quests.description_chs: 无垠的星空，浩瀚庞大，涵盖了所有命运。多么不可思议，这片静静存在于幻境中的美丽星空有着极为宽广的胸怀，古老又温柔，似乎是怀抱着对命运的向往和对众人的怜悯而生。莫娜对命运的解读，也如它一般。

quests.title: Like Rhyme and Song, the Summer Reverie
quests.description: To find out the truth, everyone returns to the location of the mysterious machine to investigate.
quests.description_chs: 为查明真相，众人再次前往神秘装置所在地进行调查。

quests.title: Sounds From Afar
quests.description: As the harvest season arrives, the Mondstadt's Adventurers' Guild has received a great number of requests from the citizenry. You and Paimon have also arrived back in the city in response to Katheryne's call for aid...
quests.description_chs: 丰收季到来，蒙德的冒险家协会开始接到大量居民的求助委托，你和派蒙也收到凯瑟琳的求援赶回了蒙德…

quests.title: Bonds of Melody
quests.description: Razor decides to make some Thousand-Wind Wine personally to better understand his human parents. However, which ingredients, specifically, was Venti's song referring to?
quests.description_chs: 雷泽为了了解自己的人类父母，决定亲自动手制作「千风佳酿」。不过，温迪的诗歌中提到的几种酿酒材料，究竟是什么呢…

quests.title: The Truth Shrouded in Shadow
quests.description: The appointed day has come. You and Paimon go to the Production Zone once more. Lyney will be waiting for you there.
quests.description_chs: 约定的日子到了，你和派蒙再次前往生产区。林尼会在那里等你们。

quests.title: Aroma of the Past
quests.description: The Knights have provided Razor with the ingredients he needs, and preparations seem to almost be complete. Head over to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters to check in on them.
quests.description_chs: 骑士团为雷泽提供的酿酒材料，似乎已经准备得差不多了，到西风骑士团去看看吧。

quests.title: The Most Fantastic Tournament You've Never Heard Of?
quests.description: The people of Sumeru are gradually returning to their peaceful daily lives, but you and Paimon notice a strange sign while on your way to find new commissions...
quests.description_chs: 须弥的人们正在逐渐返回平静的日常生活，你和派蒙却在寻求委托任务的途中，发现了一块奇怪的告示牌…

quests.title: Nilotpala Cup: Debut Match
quests.description: The Nilotpala Cup qualifiers have started. Time to fight alongside Bongo-Head against other beast tamers!
quests.description_chs: 「月莲杯驯兽师大赛」的预赛开始了，是时候和「咚咚小圆帽」并肩作战，对阵其他的驯兽师了！

quests.title: Dual Missions: Progress and Probe!
quests.description: After learning about Haniyyah's prejudice against Fungi, you seem to have one more reason to win: You won't let her do anything reckless!
quests.description_chs: 听闻海妮耶的激进言论后，你们似乎又多了一个夺冠的动机：不能放任那位驯兽师胡来…

quests.title: Unfathomable Defenses
quests.description: The Nilotpala Cup continues. With many clues collected, new opportunities seem to have emerged.
quests.description_chs: 「月莲杯」的比赛仍在继续。收集了大量线索后，事情似乎出现了某种转机…

quests.title: The Strongest Opponent! The Biggest Crisis!
quests.title_chs: 最强的对手！至大的危机！
quests.description: It is the day of the grand finale. Can you change Haniyyah's mind and find a proper way to help the Fungi settle down? Everything hinges on your success!
quests.description_chs: 决赛的这天终于到来了。能否改变海妮耶的观念，合情合理地安置蕈兽伙伴，全都在此一举！

quests.title: Farewell, My Shroom Buddies
quests.description: It's about time to say goodbye to your shroom buddies...
quests.description_chs: 约定的时间已到，该和蕈兽伙伴们暂时分别了…
(test)隐藏彩蛋$HIDDEN

quests.title: Test of Courage
quests.description: You heard that the Test of Courage is being held. Maybe you should head to the Yashiro Commission to have a look...
quests.description_chs: 听说试胆大会正在举行，要不要去社奉行看看呢…

quests.title: Secret Keepers and Forbidden Zones
quests.description: The Duke, Wriothesley, holds all the Fortress's secrets. You plan to ask him directly and get some grasp of the current situation.
quests.description_chs: 公爵莱欧斯利掌握着梅洛彼得堡的所有秘密。你们打算直接向他提问，以便掌握现状。

quests.title: Haunted Tales
quests.description: You encountered something peculiar in the first round, and the second is just about to begin...
quests.description_chs: 在第一轮试胆大会上遇到了一些「异样」，而第二轮试胆大会也悄然开始…

quests.title: The Currents of Life
quests.description: You thought it was all a misunderstanding caused by youkai, not expecting there to be a secret behind it all...
quests.description_chs: 本以为一切都是小妖怪引发的误会，没想到背后似乎还有隐情…

quests.title: A Thousand Miles for an Enigmatic Tune
quests.description: You return to Liyue with Paimon in anticipation of yet another unforgettable time at the Lantern Rite Festival...
quests.description_chs: 海灯节前夕，派蒙和你回到了璃月，打算在此度过一段难忘的节日时光…

quests.title: A Single Harmony for an Irreplaceable Soul
quests.description: You and Ganyu had agreed to look separately for clues about the woman in Dvorak's story. Now, it's time to meet up...
quests.description_chs: 早些时候，甘雨与你相约，共同寻找故事中女子的线索。现在，约定的日子已经到了…
为了参加「月莲杯驯兽师大赛」，需要向工作人员贝尔福领取关键的道具「意智宝珠」。$HIDDEN

quests.title: Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament
quests.description: A fabulous tournament is well underway at Port Ormos
quests.description_chs: 一场奇妙的比赛在奥摩斯港拉开了帷幕…

quests.title: Between Facades and Familiar Faces
quests.description: It's now time to attend Hu Tao's dinner. You head to Xinyue Kiosk with Paimon in tow...
quests.description_chs: 到了胡桃定好的饭局时间，你跟着派蒙一同前往新月轩赴约…

quests.title: A Gathering of Outlanders
quests.description: As the Windblume Festival approaches, you and Paimon return to Mondstadt, grasped in the throes of festivity, and take on a rather different commission than you are used to...
quests.description_chs: 临近「风花节庆典」，派蒙和你回到了节日氛围浓厚的蒙德，尝试接到不一样的委托…

quests.title: A Riddle Amidst the Crowds
quests.description: Even though the clues are few and vague, you and Sucrose continue to work at uncovering the mystery behind the prophecy...
quests.description_chs: 尽管现有的线索寥寥无几，你和砂糖仍努力想要解开预言中的谜题…

quests.title: Joy Above the Clouds
quests.description: Your friends have promised to provide clues and new ideas to solve the riddle. You expectantly wait at the agreed upon time, planning to convene and go over all you have learned with Sucrose...
quests.description_chs: 朋友们纷纷答应提供关于谜题的线索及思路，你满怀期待地等到了约定的时间，打算与砂糖进一步汇总信息…

quests.title: Calamitous Tread
quests.description: Just as everything seems to have returned to normal, an unknown catastrophe arrives suddenly, like a thief in the night...
quests.description_chs: 就在一切似乎归于安定时，未知的灾难悄然逼近…

quests.title: Opening Festivities
quests.description: Paimon heard from someone or somewhere news about the Akademiya Extravaganza. Head to the Akademiya and ask around for details.
quests.description_chs: 派蒙不知从哪里听来了有关「学院庆典」的消息，到教令院去打听一下详情吧。

quests.title: Competition on the Sands
quests.description: The Interdarshan Championship has entered the second round. This round takes place in the desert. Head to the Aaru Village sub-venue to see how things are going...
quests.description_chs: 学院争霸赛来到了第二轮，这一次比赛地点在沙漠。到阿如村的分会场看看吧…

quests.title: Suspicions Aroused
quests.description: The second round has come to an end, but there are some matters that haven't been resolved...
quests.description_chs: 第二轮比赛落幕，心里却总有些事放不下…

quests.title: To Claim the Crown
quests.description: Time passes by. You're not sure if Aarav has completed his investigation behind the kidnapping case and uncovered the truth yet...
quests.description_chs: 时间慢慢过去，不知道阿拉夫有没有调查清楚绑架案的真相？

quests.title: The Arc of Intellect
quests.description: With the breaking of the diadem, all has come to an end. Head to the main venue and join Kaveh's award ceremony.
quests.description_chs: 伴随着才识之冠破裂，一切终于迎来结束。到主会场参加为卡维举办的颁奖仪式吧。

quests.title_chs: (test)风花节活动任务一阶段隐藏对话$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: (test)风花节活动任务一阶段隐藏对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: Commence! A Suspect Genesis
quests.description: The King of Invokations Grand Prix is underway! Unbeknownst to all, however, there is an even more startling event hiding in its shadow...
quests.description_chs: 「召唤王大奖赛」堂堂开幕！殊不知，在比赛背后，还藏着一个惊天大新闻…

quests.title: Roll! A Sea of New Acquaintances
quests.description: With the cast of the dice, a series of duels arise in Liyue. Yet, the enigma behind the scenes grows ever more peculiar...
quests.description_chs: 惊天一掷！璃月赛区风云迭起！然而，幕后的谜团却愈行愈奇…

quests.title: Cards Out! Grievances Begone
quests.description: These duels are once in a century! Each table is a storm of activity, and old grudges will be settled on this day!
quests.description_chs: 世纪之战！决赛桌前雷雨翻腾，古今纷争于此作结！

quests.title: A Tea Party Most Thorny
quests.description: Now that the serial disappearances case has been solved, you decide to rest up for a while, but something is stirring in the dark...
quests.description_chs: 「少女连环失踪案」的事情告一段落以后，你们决定休整一阵。但与此同时，似乎一些事件正在暗中酝酿…

quests.title: Culminate! Chatter of Joyous Dreams
quests.description: The truth is revealed! What an unpredictable turn of events!
quests.description_chs: 真相大白！一段云谲波诡的旅途！没想到在卡牌之中，还有着这样的宝藏…
(test)3.7大活动隐藏任务$HIDDEN

quests.title: A Mysterious Missive on Paper Wings
quests.description: It appears that Master Jean needs assistance with something. Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters and see what it is!
quests.description_chs: 似乎琴团长有什么事想要寻求协助，那就去西风骑士团看看究竟是什么事吧！

quests.title: Glaze Domain, Multum in Parvo
quests.description: After touching the bottle, you really do enter a Domain, but the owner is nowhere to be seen. If you want to find the sender of the "Magic Invite," you'll need to go deep into the Domain...
quests.description_chs: 触摸瓶子以后，真的进入到了一处秘境之中，只是里面并没有秘境主人的身影。看来，为了找到发出「神奇邀请函」的人，必须得深入这个秘境了…

quests.title: Zip Along (According to Safe Cart Operating Procedures)
quests.title_chs: 疾速观览，切记行车规范
quests.description: To repair the great wheel in the Veluriyam Mirage, you must obtain components that have been dropped in different locations. Klee said that a giant canyon appeared in the area they were investigating...
quests.description_chs: 为了修复「琉形蜃境」中的巨大轮縠，就得取得掉落在了不同地区的零件。可莉说他们查探的区域出现了巨大的峡谷…

quests.title: Fairground Gathering, Summer Lights Illuminated
quests.title_chs: 聚众游园，点亮夏日灯火
quests.description: The third component of the Central Hub fell in the forest to the north. Idyia mentioned that the cousin Eula was searching for has gone to this area as well. Perhaps you'll be able to find something that hints at his whereabouts...
quests.description_chs: 修复核心轮縠的第三个零件落在了北边的密林之中，之前伊迪娅说，优菈要寻找的表亲似乎也到这个区域去了，不知有没有她要找的人的线索…

quests.title: Treehouse Theater: Candlelit Shadows Dancing
quests.title_chs: 树屋剧场，烛影摇晃舞台
quests.description: Go look for the last missing part!
quests.description_chs: 出发前去寻找最后一个零件吧！
(test)幻境Day1闲置$HIDDEN
(test)幻境Day2闲置$HIDDEN

quests.title: Back to Normal: The Story Hidden in the Bottle
quests.title_chs: 恢复如初，银瓶裹藏的故事
quests.description: After retrieving all of the components, the Mirage can finally be returned to working order. All that was hidden will be revealed at the hub...
quests.description_chs: 终于取回了所有零件，这下终于可以使秘境修复运转了，一切隐瞒之事，一定都将在秘境的核心中揭晓吧…

quests.title: Fortress of Meropide
quests.description: At Neuvillette's behest, you are sent to Fortress of Meropide on trumped-up charges to secretly investigate. Your life behind bars is about to begin...
quests.description_chs: 接受那维莱特的委托以后，你们使用假的罪名来到梅洛彼得堡调查，作为犯人的生活正在等着你们…

quests.title: Congenial Gathering
quests.description: You hear that Mondstadt and Liyue are hosting a joint event and decide to take a look...
quests.description_chs: 听说蒙德和璃月合办了一场活动，打听到消息的你们准备前去一探究竟…

quests.title: Tears Among the Leaves
quests.description: You take a stroll while taking in the scenery for poetic inspiration. As you share your verses with each other, there seems to be a faint sense of sorrow amidst the joyful laughter...
quests.description_chs: 行游采风、寻物赏景…在吟诗作对的欢笑间，似有淡淡的哀情显现…
(test)幻境最后一环闲置$HIDDEN

quests.title: Heart of the Deep
quests.description: The fallen leaves float away, carrying with them stories of the past. Will the protagonists of the fairytale rekindle feelings from a distant past?
quests.description_chs: 落叶载着往事流过…故事中的二人，还能否将那段遥远的感情弥合…

quests.title: Water Imp's Conjecture
quests.description: Word arrives from the Fishing Association that they seem to have encountered some kind of problem...
quests.description_chs: 钓鱼协会传来消息，他们似乎遇到了什么麻烦…

quests.title: Prince's Country
quests.description: In order to cure Madame Zuria's child, you begin a fantastical adventure. Today is the day you head to the Kingdom of the Water Imps. Just what will you encounter there?
quests.description_chs: 为了治疗祖莉亚夫人的孩子，你们加入了一场幻想的历险。今天就是前往水妖王国的启程之日，会在那里遇见什么呢？

quests.title: Miraculous Crown
quests.description: The end of the fantastical adventure approaches. At its final destination, will Madame Zuria's child get better, as you all hope?
quests.description_chs: 幻想的历险即将迎来最后一程，在最后的终点处，祖莉亚夫人的孩子会像你们期盼的那样好起来吗？

quests.title: The Crack of Muskets Breaking the Silence
quests.description: During the Fontinalia Festival, children carry baskets and head up and down the streets asking for candies. As you roam the vibrant festive streets, you might just meet some familiar faces...
quests.description_chs: 时值枫丹「千灵节」，孩子们提着篮子走上街头，讨要糖果。漫步在如此热闹的节日街头，或许会遇到几位熟悉的朋友…

quests.title: Fiction and Reality Inside and Outside the Frame
quests.description: The film's shooting is going smoothly. The story recorded in the Kamera seems to be being performed somewhere beyond the frame...
quests.description_chs: 映影拍摄顺利展开，留影机内记录的故事，似乎也在取景框外的某处上演…

quests.title: The Lone Isle Glimpsed Through Fog
quests.description: The lonely isle appeared in silence through the dark fog of night. Wherever shall it lead you...
quests.description_chs: 黑夜的迷雾之中，孤岛悄然而现。它究竟会将你们引向何处…

quests.title: Where the Roses Bloom
quests.description: Where shall the gun barrel of justice point? And who shall the bullet strike...?
quests.description_chs: 「正义」的枪口指向何方？它的子弹，又将命中何人…

quests.title: The Two Musketeers' Triumph
quests.description: This is the day that the winner of the Furina Award shall be revealed at the Fontinalia Film Festival. This is no time for delay. Time to head down to the venue!
quests.description_chs: 今天是揭晓千灵映影节「芙宁娜」奖的日子，事不宜迟，去会场看看吧！

quests.title_chs: （test）控制公告牌阅读顺序的隐藏任务$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN
quests.description_chs: （test）控制公告牌阅读顺序的隐藏任务$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Orioles Bask in Spring, the Heavens Present Auspices
quests.description: You and Paimon return to Liyue, preparing to take part in the annual Lantern Rite. As expected, there are familiar faces to be seen as you walk around the harbor...
quests.description_chs: 你和派蒙回到璃月，准备参加一年一度的海灯节，在港口漫步时，果不其然见到了熟悉的面孔…

quests.title: A Cloud-Sea Appeal, a Brilliance Revealed
quests.description: In order to thank you for your help, Gaming proposes to invite you to Xinyue Kiosk for some dim sum...
quests.description_chs: 为了感谢你们的帮助，嘉明说好要请你们去新月轩喝个早茶…

quests.title: The Glede Returns to the Pavilion
quests.description: Xianyun has hatched a brilliant plan on Gaming's behalf. Now it's time to put it into action...
quests.description_chs: 闲云为嘉明制定了一计良策，该是计划实施的时候了…

quests.title: Hustle and Bustle
quests.description: You and Paimon have been at a loose end lately, so you decide to visit Qiaoying Village...
quests.description_chs: 近日闲来无事，你和派蒙准备去翘英庄看看…

quests.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part I
quests.description: One day, you and Paimon pass through Wangshu Inn, only for a notice to attract your attention...
quests.description_chs: 某日，你和派蒙路过了望舒客栈。在那里，一则告示的内容吸引了你们的注意…

quests.title: Potions Most Potent
quests.description: Lisa seems to be busy with something... for once.
quests.description_chs: 丽莎难得地在为某事而忙碌着…

quests.title: A Breakthrough in Craft
quests.description: The alchemy shop has opened, but you and Paimon are dizzyingly busy...
quests.description_chs: 炼金店铺顺利开业，你和派蒙忙得晕头转向…

quests.title: International Markets
quests.description: It seems like merchants from other nations have arrived at your shop...
quests.description_chs: 似乎有其他国家的商人来到了你的店铺…

quests.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part II
quests.description: After a day's hard work, you and Paimon are now able to deal with the daily kitchen grind. That is, unless some truly picky customers come calling...
quests.description_chs: 经历了一天的忙碌，你和派蒙已然可以应付日常的后厨工作，除非有口味挑剔且要求严苛的客人上门…

quests.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part III
quests.description: According to Smiley Yanxiao, you should be fine no matter how tricky the customer. But it seems that his every such utterance tempts fate...
quests.description_chs: 根据言笑的说法，现在不管来再怎么麻烦的客人，都不成问题。但每次当他这么说的时候，似乎都有麻烦降临…

quests.title: Receiver of Friends From Afar: Part IV
quests.description: This is your final day of employment as a temporary chef. You wonder if this day will pass by peacefully...
quests.description_chs: 这是临时厨师兼职的最后一天，不知这一天能不能平稳度过…

quests.title: The Proscribed, Hidden in Plain Sight
quests.description: Although you met a familiar face, you have obtained no leads on Childe so far. Did you miss something that's hidden in plain sight?

quests.title: A Job Well Done
quests.description: The shop has been a roaring success. Time to celebrate!
quests.description_chs: 店铺经营大获成功，是时候庆祝一番了。

quests.title: This Ain't Your Daddy's Iridescence Tour...
quests.description: You've received an invitation from one Arataki Itto. Having been introduced by his enthusiastic letter, you set out on a trip to Watatsumi Island...
quests.description_chs: 收到了一封「荒泷一斗」送出的邀请函。在这封热情满满的邀请函的介绍下，你踏上了前往海祇岛的旅途…

quests.title: ...It's the Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness!
quests.title_chs: 是荒泷生命摇滚虹色大巡回
quests.description: Thanks to everyone (but especially you), the performance venue is ready at last. It's time for the final celebration...
quests.description_chs: 在众人（特别是你）的倾力付出下，演出场地终于准备就绪，是时候开始最后的庆典了…

quests.title: The Story Begins in a Forest Without Rain
quests.description: "They will descend upon the 'Cliff of Prophecy'..."
quests.description_chs: 「其将于『预言之崖』降临…」

quests.title: They Once Walked the Starry Sky
quests.description:
"They will descend upon the 'Cliff of Prophecy'..."

Thus would the epics of later generations speak of this time:
The heroes leaped light of foot o'er floral cliffs, trials and tribulations besting forthwith. By their arm they brought forth rain and dew, the dark clouds fled, and flowers grew.

Comment in the margins: You forgot to mention how popular the forest tavern was.
Comment below the comment: Wait, did all of you think the wine was good? I thought it tasted kinda weird.
Comment below the comment below the comment: That might be because someone put... into your cup... (the following words are scratched out)
quests.description_chs:
「其将于『预言之崖』降临…」

于是后世的史诗如此记述——
勇者轻足跃芳崖，巧解碍难化纷杂。伊人臂弯化甘霖，愁云散尽木生花。

书卷旁的批注：你忘了提那森林里的酒馆有多热闹。
批注下的批注：话说你们都觉得那酒好喝吗？我怎么觉得一股怪味道？
批注下批注的批注：那可能是因为有人往你杯里放了…（后面的文字被涂掉了）

quests.title: Until the End of the World
quests.description:
"When that time comes, I shall dance, and return the tracks beneath my people's feet back to the stars in the sky..."

Thus would the epics of later generations speak of this time:
The heroes gazed upon the skies of gray, and in carriages bright they went their way. The stars returned and the winds they drove — now the dragon's shadow alone still did rove.
Comment in the margins: I feel that the young nekomata lady in boots who spoke the human tongue needs a line or two!
Comment below the comment: I'll make up for that another day... But really, what did you put into my cup?
Comment below the comment below the comment: I dunno, it wasn't me.
Comment below the comment below the comment: Wasn't me either.
quests.description_chs:
「届时我将起舞，将众生脚下的轨道还予千星…」

于是后世的史诗如此记述——
群杰举目眺云霄，悬车衔灯琼城绕。千星复归风始动，唯余邪龙孤影遥。

书卷旁的批注：我觉得那位穿靴子说人话的猫又小姐也值得两句这样的诗。
批注下的批注：我改天找补找补，但说真的，你们到底往我杯子里加了什么？
批注下批注的批注：我不知道，不是我放的。
批注下批注的批注：也不是我放的。

quests.title: Afterword
quests.description:
"The Hero from another world, supported by their companions, shall restore peace to this world..."

Thus would epics of later generations speak of this time:
Thus was the fell dragon saved, thus was peace restored to Simulanka.
The people then lived happily ever after with the cute little dragon named "Durin."
Annoyed comment in the margins: Hey, you're not even bothering to rhyme anymore!
quests.description_chs:
「异世的勇者与其同伴，会为这个世界重新带来和平…」

于是后世的史诗如此记述——
至此，邪龙被拯救，希穆兰卡重归和平。
人们与那头名为「杜林」的可爱小龙一起，过上了幸福快乐的生活。

书卷旁愤怒的批注：你倒是给我们押韵啊！

quests.title: Give Her Surprises
quests.description: Sumeru is holding the Sabzeruz Festival! Upon hearing the news, you arrive to see some familiar faces...
quests.description_chs: 须弥正在举办花神诞祭，闻讯前来的你，碰见了一群熟悉的面孔…

quests.title: Give Her Sweetness
quests.description: Some would seek to cause trouble during the festival. They cannot be allowed to ruin this surprise...
quests.description_chs: 有人在节日期间蠢蠢欲动，可不能让他们破坏了这份惊喜…

quests.title: Give Her Memories
quests.description: When she thinks back on all her birthdays, will this be the most unforgettable?
quests.description_chs: 当回想起一个又一个生日的时候，这会是她最难忘的那个吗？

quests.title: Night-Wind Letter
quests.description: You receive a letter from the Masters of the Night-Wind asking for your help, signed by Ororon. Just what could have happened...
quests.description_chs: 收到了一封来自烟谜主的求救信，署名是欧洛伦，发生什么事了呢…

quests.title: Vision of Ashen Desolation
quests.description: In order to help Leyla find his spirit, Citlali plans to get more info from within the tribe, but how successful was she...?
quests.description_chs: 为了帮助勒拉寻回他的灵性，茜特菈莉计划去族内打探更多消息，不知道她的成果如何了…

quests.title: The Spirit of Ah K'ulbatil
quests.description: According to Citlali's plan, today's the day to guide Leyla's spirit back to his body. But will everything go off without a hitch...?
quests.description_chs: 按照茜特菈莉的计划，今天就是将勒拉的灵性引导回身体的日子，你们能否顺利完成这件事呢…

quests.title: For Our Saurian Companion
quests.description: Since you've got a free moment, why not take a walk around the Children of Echoes?
quests.description_chs: 闲来无事，到「回声之子」逛逛吧。

quests.title: Medicine Born of Guilt
quests.description: In the first half of the exhibition match, Kachina seems to have something on her mind. Go and ask her about it.
quests.description_chs: 上半场表演赛，卡齐娜看起来有什么心事，去找她问问吧。

quests.title: Spell of Unity
quests.description: Everyone decided to do something after hearing about how badly the last Bloomflower Trials went, and what happened to the little Qucusaur Antu. However, you'll need help from your other friends...
quests.description_chs: 在得知了上一次荣花演武的惨淡收场，以及小绒翼龙安杜的事情后，众人决定为它做些什么。为此还需要其他伙伴们的配合…

quests.title: Lost in Deep Seas
quests.description: You've been looking into the Fortress' "hidden rules" and seem to have obtained many leads on Childe. You are certain this trip will not be in vain.
quests.description_chs: 你们一直围绕着梅洛彼得堡的种种「隐秘规矩」进行调查，很多线索看似都和「公子」有关，相信你们并不会白来一趟。

quests.title: Liyue Celebrates and Eight Adepts Face a Hidden Calamity
quests.title_chs: 璃月港佳节兴，八奇现瘴疠隐
quests.description: The Lantern Rite has come around once more. What stories will be written in Liyue Harbor this year...
quests.description_chs: 海灯节如期而至，今年的璃月港又在发生一些什么故事呢…

quests.title: The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops
quests.title_chs: 往生堂三日无主，玉京台遣将调兵
quests.description: The Lantern Rite has come around once more. What stories will be written in Liyue Harbor this year...
quests.description_chs: 海灯节如期而至，今年的璃月港又在发生一些什么故事呢…

quests.title: Qimen Arts and the Rite of Homa, the Spirits are Calmed and Life Restored
quests.title_chs: 奇门术息灾平昏寿，护摩法净世定幽冥
quests.description: After two days have passed, you decide to visit the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor to see if Hu Tao has returned...
quests.description_chs: 两天过去了，你们打算去往生堂看看胡桃回来了没有…

quests.title: Final Stanza: The Sanctification of Tao Dou
quests.description: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the border crisis has finally been resolved. It seems that Xiangling has something she wants to talk to you about in Liyue Harbor...
quests.description_chs: 在众人的努力下，边界危机终被化解。璃月港里，香菱好像有什么事情找你…
(test)5.2大活动欧洛伦送礼$HIDDEN

quests.title: Business Acumen From the Spina
quests.title_chs: 来自刺玫会的经营学问
quests.description: After all is set, you and Paimon turn your attention to learning how to run the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland under Navia's guidance...
quests.description_chs: 准备停当后，你和派蒙在娜维娅的引导下，开始学习如何经营「海薇玛映影欢乐城」…

quests.title: A Moment's Respite
quests.description: The crisis has been averted... for now. You decide to return to the Fortress of Meropide to see how everyone's doing.
quests.description_chs: 危机暂时解除，你们打算返回梅洛彼得堡看看那里的人们情况如何。

quests.title: As Though Caught in a Dream
quests.description: You receive a long-awaited letter from Yae Miko...
quests.description_chs: 八重神子久违地送来了一封书信…

quests.title: As Though Beholding Illusions
quests.description: Strange phenomena have suddenly appeared near the venue for the Mikawa Flower Festival. Dark undercurrents seem to be forming...
quests.description_chs: 「三川花祭」的会场附近突显异象，似有暗流涌动…

quests.title: As Though Surrounded by Thunder
quests.description: The truth behind the doppelgangers and nightmares has been revealed. The actions of the past send ripples through fate, and the events of today blur the line between dreams and reality.
quests.description_chs: 「二重身」与「噩梦」的真相俱已水落石出。往日因果纷至沓来，今日种种亦真亦幻。

quests.title: As Though Kissed by Dew
quests.description: I know that sweet dreams are as fleeting as the morning dew. And yet...
quests.description_chs: 我知道这好梦，如露水般短暂，然而，然而。

quests.title: An Overnight Fantasyland
quests.description: Out of a mixture of curiosity and concern, you and Paimon head back to the Court of Fontaine for a stroll around.
quests.description_chs: 出于好奇与关心，你决定和派蒙回枫丹廷逛逛。

quests.title: A Series of Twists and Turns
quests.description: After some time, you decide to return to the Palais Mermonia to check up on your Saurian friend.
quests.description_chs: 经过了一段时间，你们决定再访沫芒宫，查看龙伙伴的情况。

quests.title: The Price of Every Price
quests.description: A message arrives from the Palais Mermonia. Seems like it's time to make a move.
quests.description_chs: 沫芒宫传来消息，看来是时候做出行动了。

quests.title: A Wish For Smooth Sailing
quests.description: Thanks to everyone's hard work, the Film Fantasyland is now in full swing. You finally have some free time to chat with your companions...
quests.description_chs: 经过大家的努力，映影欢乐城经营得热火朝天。你终于得闲，准备和伙伴们闲聊一番…

quests.title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
quests.description: Summer is here, and, following a suggestion from Paimon, you head to Yilong Wharf to sample some refreshing green tea. On your way, you unexpectedly run into Yelan, who appears to be right in the middle of something...
quests.description_chs: 夏日已至，在派蒙的提议下，你们前往遗珑埠品尝解暑祛火的绿茶，却意外遇见了正在忙碌的夜兰…

quests.title: Meeting Is Also Parting
quests.description: Acting on intelligence from The Knave, your group arrives at the ruins...
quests.description_chs: 根据「仆人」给出的情报，一行人来到某处遗迹…

quests.title: An Instant of Intoxication, A Meeting by Moonlight
quests.description: After thoroughly dismantling the Dark Financier's money laundering operations, Yelan can finally take a well-deserved break. She invites you to Fontaine to spend a vacation together...
quests.description_chs: 彻底摧毁「黑钱领主」的摩拉除痕团体后，夜兰总算得到了闲暇的时间，邀请你在枫丹共度假期…

quests.title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
quests.description: The time to act is almost upon you. It's time to head to Yilong Wharf and meet up with Yelan...
quests.description_chs: 行动的时间将近，是时候前往遗珑埠的港口与夜兰会合了…

quests.title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
quests.description: All the clues surrounding the Dark Financier point to the auction. After making your final preparations, you get ready to visit the Hotel Debord...
quests.description_chs: 追查「黑钱领主」的线索即将收束在拍卖会上，做好万全的准备后，你们要动身前往德波大饭店了…

quests.title: Dun Dun Dunnn! A Major Crisis!
quests.description: As you travel through Nod-Krai, you decide to take a stroll around Nasha Town...
quests.description_chs: 正在挪德卡莱游历的你决定去那夏镇逛一逛…

quests.title: Those Strange and Intriguing Questions
quests.title_chs: 那些古怪又让人思索的问题
quests.description: You seem to have caught wind of some Akademiya researchers arguing in Port Ormos. Might as well listen in and find out what's going on, right?
quests.description_chs: 在奥摩斯港，似乎听到了几个教令院的学者正在为什么而争吵，靠近听听究竟发生了什么事吧？

quests.title: Boong Boong Bwoooom! A Grand Plot!
quests.description: The appointed time has arrived. You move to investigate the illegal black market...
quests.description_chs: 约定的日期到了，你们动身前往那个「非法黑市」进行调查…

quests.title: Boom Boom Boooom! A Grand Battle!
quests.description: The time you agreed upon with Jahoda has arrived. You wonder if she brings good news...
quests.description_chs: 与雅珂达约定日期到了，不知她是否带回了好消息…

quests.title: Ding Ding Dinggg! A Great Feast!
quests.description: The troubled days have come to an end. You and Paimon decide to pay Aino another visit...
quests.description_chs: 数日的纷扰终于告一段落，你和派蒙决定再去探望爱诺一次…

quests.title: Hunters, Prophets
quests.description: You return to the Spina di Rosula base in Fleuve Cendre, and there, you meet an unexpected friend...
quests.description_chs: 你们返回位于灰河的刺玫会据点休息，却在那里遇到了意料之外的朋友…

quests.title: Return From the Mysterious Realm
quests.description: Returning to Sumeru, you and Paimon run into some old friends...
quests.description_chs: 重返须弥，你与派蒙遇到了一些老朋友…

quests.title: Headlong Into the Sands
quests.description: The appointed time has come. Seek out the truth in the sea of sand.
quests.description_chs: 到了约定的时间，是时候去沙海中探寻真相了。

quests.title: Dodoco's Bomb-Rally Ruckus
quests.description: Klee has picked out her favorite toy...
quests.description_chs: 可莉已经选好了心仪的玩具…
(test)隐藏$HIDDEN

quests.title: An Adventurer's Woes
quests.description: To provide assistance to Nod-Krai's adventurers, the Adventurers' Guild has also placed an order with Aino...
quests.description_chs: 为了给冒险家们提供一些助力，挪德卡莱的冒险家协会也向爱诺发出了订单…

quests.title: A Mysterious Outsourced Contract
quests.description: It seems the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau has business with Aino...
quests.description_chs: 月矩力试验设计局与爱诺的工坊之间似乎也存在业务往来…

quests.title: Backup Plans
quests.description: Aino's working on a backup plan to save her friends...
quests.description_chs: 为了救回伙伴，爱诺设计了备用方案…

quests.title: The Shining Warriors Take the Stage
quests.description: As the white snow flutters down, you return to the foot of Dragonspine...
quests.description_chs: 白雪纷飞时，你们回到了龙脊雪山脚下…

quests.title: Promise You Won't Waste Your Youth
quests.description: A shared hobby brings you all together...
quests.description_chs: 共同的爱好将你们吸引到一起…

quests.title: Now's No Time for Tears
quests.title_chs: 现在不是撒娇哭泣的时候
quests.description: "Some people think I'm not enough. I have two words for those people: Think again."
quests.description_chs: 「我菲耶蒂娜最喜欢做的事情之一，就是对认为我不行的人说：不行。」

quests.title: Apocalypse
quests.description: The prophecy shall inevitably come to fruition, and the plans are all in place. All that's left... is to judge a god.
quests.description_chs: 预言必将发生，计划也已制定，剩下的…唯有审判神明。

quests.title: Go, Fietena, Go!
quests.description: Now's the time to run for your dreams, give it everything you've got!
quests.description_chs: 现在该为梦想而奔跑了，拼尽全力吧！

quests.title: A Little Walk Home
quests.description: Yaoyao and Qiqi are preparing snacks and drinks...
quests.description_chs: 瑶瑶和七七在准备零食和饮料…

quests.title: The Realm of Clouds
quests.description: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?
quests.description_chs: 海灯节到了，今年的璃月港又有什么新变化呢？

quests.title: The Realm of Rocks
quests.description: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?
quests.description_chs: 海灯节到了，今年的璃月港又有什么新变化呢？

quests.title: The Realm of People
quests.description: The Lantern Rite is here. What new changes await in Liyue Harbor this year?
quests.description_chs: 海灯节到了，今年的璃月港又有什么新变化呢？

quests.title: The Infamous Merc Captain
quests.description: Jahoda reminds you that the person you're about to meet on the giant ship is an infamous merc captain who sails the high seas. You had best act with caution...
quests.description_chs: 雅珂达提醒你，你将要在那艘巨舰上会见的是一位纵横远海的佣兵巨头，必须谨慎行事…

quests.title: The Top Dog of the Criminal Underworld
quests.title_chs: 主宰地下世界的黑道大佬
quests.description: Jahoda warns you that the individual staying at The Flagship is a top dog of the criminal underworld. You'd do well to stay on their good side...
quests.description_chs: 雅珂达叮嘱你，在「旗舰」下榻的那位是主宰地下世界的黑道大佬，千万不要惹到对方…

quests.title: The Workshop Owner With a Sweet Tooth
quests.description: Jahoda informs you that the booth reserved for Aino has been sitting empty for too long. You'd better get her here lickety-split.
quests.description_chs: 雅珂达告诉你，给爱诺这家伙预留的展位已经空了太久，赶紧催她过来。

quests.title: The Forest Boar and the Little Witch
quests.description: After experiencing many things, you decide to go to Aisa Bathhouse to relax a bit...
quests.description_chs: 经历不少事件后，你们决定去秋沙钱汤放松放松…

quests.title: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
quests.description: You receive an invitation from the Knights of Favonius...
quests.description_chs: 你接到了来自西风骑士团的邀请…

quests.title: Deluge of Wrathful Waters
quests.description: This is the day you get out of prison, and you proceed to complete the paperwork for your release as arranged.
quests.description_chs: 出狱的日子到了，你们依照约定前去办理出狱手续。

quests.title: For a Reunion Without Tears
quests.description: Alice has used her magic to conjure a bubble that recreate your Mondstadt travels so the story can be shared with the knights who have returned from their expedition. As someone who has experienced it firsthand, you gladly agree to test and check it in advance...
quests.description_chs: 艾莉丝用魔法创造了重现你在蒙德旅行经历的泡泡，用于向远征归来的蒙德骑士团成员讲述这段故事。你作为亲历者，欣然接受了先行体验与检查的工作…

quests.title: Variations on the Song of the Dragon and Freedom
quests.description: The second day's tests have come to a successful close. After a joyful banquet, the third day finally arrives. It's time to test the story's ending...
quests.description_chs: 第二天的测试也圆满结束，在一场快乐的宴会后，你终于迎来了第三天，也就是故事结局部分的测试…

quests.title: Hunting Training
quests.description: Prune seems to be busy taking notes...
quests.description_chs: 布伦妮似乎在忙着记笔记…

quests.title: A Commission From the Curatorium of Secrets
quests.description: Out of the blue, you receive a letter from the Curatorium of Secrets. Nefer seems to have a commission that only you can handle...
quests.description_chs: 你忽然收到了一封来自秘闻馆的信，奈芙尔手里似乎有一份只有你才能处理的委托…

quests.title: Encirclement of Bullets and Silk
quests.description: The criminal puppetmaster lurking in the shadows has finally taken the bait. Yelan from Liyue's Ministry of Civil Affairs and Chevreuse from Fontaine's Maison Gardiennage have embarked on a rare joint operation. However, apprehending the perpetrator isn't the only issue they have to ponder...
quests.description_chs: 幕后的罪犯终于上钩，而来自璃月总务司的夜兰和来自枫丹执律庭的夏沃蕾则罕见地展开了合作。不过，对于她们来说，需要考虑的问题不仅仅是抓捕罪犯…

quests.title: Toys for the Children
quests.description: With Yelan's help, you locate Ashvapati's hideout. There lies a past buried beneath the yellow sands, and with it, the truth behind the entire case...
quests.description_chs: 在夜兰的帮助下，你们找到了阿梵波谛的藏身之处。那里有一段被黄沙掩埋的往事，以及整个案件的真相…

quests.title: Return Home, Children of the Desert
quests.title_chs: 返乡吧，来自沙漠的孩子们
quests.description: The case has finally been resolved. However, when the question of how to deal with Ashvapati arises, everyone appears to have a different opinion...
quests.description_chs: 事情终于告一段落，而至于如何处置阿梵波谛，大家似乎都有自己的想法…

quests.title: The Opera of Noirceur and Blancheur
quests.description: Whether it be the "Focalors" before Neuvillette, or the "Furina" before you, they are performing the same opera, and the final truth is hidden within it...
quests.description_chs: 不论是那维莱特眼前的「芙卡洛斯」，还是你面前的「芙宁娜」，都在演出同样的一出歌剧。最后的真相则藏于这出歌剧之中…

quests.title: If You Should Forget the Entrance to Dreams
quests.description: The Dough King and its kin have come to the little witches' secret base, and they even bring new clues with them...
quests.description_chs: 「面团大王」和它的同族按照约定来到小魔女们的秘密基地，还带来了新的线索…

quests.title: The Magic That Never Fails
quests.description: Thanks to everyone's efforts, you've made progress in the operation to save the imaginary friend...
quests.description_chs: 在众人的努力下，拯救幻想朋友的行动有了新进展…

quests.title: Gena's Great Escape
quests.description: Sayu's fallen asleep again?
quests.description_chs: 早柚又睡着了？

quests.title: Should We Meet Again
quests.description: The Fontinalia Film Festival is coming up. Why not head back to Fontaine? You might just run into some old friends there.
quests.description_chs: 最近是千灵映影节，不如回枫丹一趟，说不定能遇到些老朋友呢？

quests.title: Those We Have Lost
quests.description: Before meeting her friends, she seems intent on resolving "anomalies" within herself first...
quests.description_chs: 在见朋友之前，她似乎想先解决自己的「错谬」…

quests.title: Those We Have Kept
quests.description: Now that she has been "born anew," what will she choose to do next...?
quests.description_chs: 获得了「第二次出生」的她，会想要做些什么呢…

quests.title: Those We Have Kept
quests.description: The film premiere is a success, and she seems to have changed much...
quests.description_chs: 映影成功上映，而她似乎也变了不少…

quests.title: Finale
quests.description: The calamity facing Fontaine has finally come to an end. No matter what happens, the presses won't stop churning news out. In other words, the people will learn about the truth as fast as The Steambird's staffers can write it.
quests.description_chs: 枫丹的灾难总算告一段落。无论经历了什么，报社都不会闲下来，也就是说，在枫丹，蒸汽鸟报的撰稿速度就是人们了解真相的速度。

quests.title: Liyue Game
quests.description: A mysterious man calling himself the Cricket Referee excitedly invites you to play a game popular with the masses in Liyue.
quests.description_chs: 自称蛐蛐裁判的神秘路人兴致勃勃的邀请你玩据说在璃月广受欢迎的游戏…$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Pontoon Parkour
quests.description: At Cider Lake, a woman explained her troubles to you.
quests.description_chs: 在果酒湖畔，困惑的女性向你表达了她的烦恼。$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Slime Baskets
quests.description: An enthusiastic slime breeder invites you to play with them.
quests.description_chs: 热情的史莱姆饲养师邀请你来跟史莱姆一起玩。$UNRELEASED

quests.title: One Giant Step for Alchemy?
quests.description: In an effort to hone his alchemical skills, Timaeus has designed an all-new alchemical furnace. There's just one problem — he needs some help to get it working...
quests.description_chs: 为了让自己的炼金术水平得以精进，蒂玛乌斯研制出了一座新型的炼金炉。但想要启动这座新型炼金炉，他似乎还需要另外的帮手…
(test)听说大陆上来了一位新的商人，他身上带了很多有趣的奇珍异宝。$HIDDEN

quests.title: Unknown Star
quests.description: Katheryne of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild seems to have something to tell you.
quests.description_chs: 蒙德冒险家协会的凯瑟琳似乎有话要对你说。

quests.title: The Crisis Deepens
quests.description: As your investigation proceeds, you gradually realize that there is some mysterious power hidden within these meteorites. In order to help the victims regain consciousness, you and your comrades begin to dispose of meteorites throughout the land...
quests.description_chs: 随着调查深入，你逐渐发觉，这些陨石背后似乎藏有某种神秘力量。为了让陷入昏迷的大家醒来，你和同伴们不断清理着各地的陨石…

quests.title: What the Skies Conceal, the Water Reveals
quests.description: Apart from the spate of unconsciousness caused by the meteorites, the appearance of the Fatui has also aroused your suspicions. Fortunately, the arrival of the astrologist Mona has given your efforts a much-needed boost. With the help of her mystical scrying techniques, you begin to delve into these mysteries...
quests.description_chs: 除了昏睡危机，愚人众的出现也让你心生怀疑。幸好，占星术士莫娜的到来成为了一针强心剂。在奇妙的占星术帮助下，你们逐渐深入谜团…

quests.title: Where Ancient Stars Align
quests.description: The meteorites that have rained down were once, in fact, part of someone's constellation. Why did this ancient array of stars fall from the sky? What goal were their extinguished flames chasing? Armed with the courage to face the answers, you march onward.
quests.description_chs: 这些从天而降的陨石，曾是属于某个人的「命星」。古老的它因何坠落？燃尽的它要去向何方？带着直面答案的勇气，你逐步走向秘密。

quests.title: That Which Fell From the Sky
quests.description: Due to the constant descent of meteorites from the sky, it has become too unsafe to go outside. Sister Grace is very worried about those people who linger out there in the wild...
quests.description_chs: 因为不断有陨石从天而降，野外也变得不太安全了。葛瑞丝修女十分担心那些还在野外逗留的人…

quests.title: Good Hunter Express
quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
quests.description_chs: 蒙德城的猎鹿人餐馆里有一份特别订单正等待着派送…

quests.title: To Each Their Duty
quests.description: Even though rocks are falling from the skies, some Knights of Favonius are still attending to their duties outside the city. Huffman is rather worried about these knights...
quests.description_chs: 即使是在天降陨石的情况下，一部分西风骑士依然在野外执行任务。霍夫曼先生有些担心这些西风骑士…

quests.title: Contingencies
quests.description: Huffman is currently so busy with matters concerning the fallen meteorites, that he barely has time for anything else...
quests.description_chs: 为了处理和陨石相关的诸多事宜，霍夫曼先生正忙得不可开交…

quests.title: "That Guy"'s Scheme
quests.description: The fallen meteorites have turned Mondstadt upside down, inside and out. But it seems that the mysterious Vile is looking for people to help her out with a little something...
quests.description_chs: 坠落的陨石让蒙德城内外都乱成了一团。但是在这个时候，神秘的薇尔小姐却似乎有什么事想要找人帮忙…

quests.title: Meteorites and Adventure
quests.description: Jack from the Adventurers' Guild seems to have some ideas on what to do about those fallen meteorites...
quests.description_chs: 对于那些从天而降的陨石，蒙德城冒险家协会的杰克似乎又有了一些新主意…

quests.title: Trouble With Letters
quests.description: Due to the meteor shower, Jiayi's plans to return home to see his family have been canceled yet again. He is looking for someone to send a letter to Qingce Village...
quests.description_chs: 因为陨石突降，千岩军嘉义回家探亲的计划又被迫取消了，他想要找个人帮自己带一封家书回轻策庄…

quests.title: A Mysterious Loss
quests.description: Many meteorites have landed outside the city of Mondstadt, wreaking havoc everywhere. Viktor appears to have lost something important, and is talking to himself, flummoxed...
quests.description_chs: 大量陨石降落在了蒙德的野外，引起了一片混乱。蒙德城的维克多似乎丢了某件重要的东西，正在焦躁地自言自语…

quests.title: The Siege of Qingce
quests.description: The Millelith soldier Jinglun is fretting about how to defeat the monsters around Qingce Village...
quests.description_chs: 千岩军经纶正在为如何清理周围的魔物而烦恼…

quests.title: Unlimited Opportunity
quests.description: Ivanovich is getting ideas about what business might be done regarding those fallen meteorites...
quests.description_chs: 对于那些从天而降的陨石，伊凡诺维奇似乎有了些新的生意点子…

quests.title: Thoughts Carried On the Wind
quests.description: The meteor shower out in the wild seems to have left Godwin all in a fluster...
quests.description_chs: 陨石在野外频繁坠落，西风骑士古德温似乎有些焦虑不安…

quests.title: Fly High
quests.description: The adventurer Hughes is a wind glider fanatic. To that end, he travels the world, constantly polishing his gliding skills. Recently, he seems to have discovered several prime gliding spots...
quests.description_chs: 冒险家修斯是风之翼的狂热爱好者，他在全世界旅行，不断磨练着自己的风之翼使用技巧。而最近，他似乎又找到了几处十分适合使用风之翼飞行的地点…

quests.title: Festering Desire
quests.description: After your journey up Dragonspine, you and Paimon prepare to head back to the adventurer camp in the foothills to have a look.
quests.description_chs: 经历了雪山之旅以后，你与派蒙准备再去山脚下的冒险家营地见识一番。

quests.title: Archon's Rival
quests.description: As Albedo suspected, this sword can absorb power to display a facsimile of "growth." This rare ability has caused it to catch the eye of certain parties with ulterior motives.
quests.description_chs: 如阿贝多所想，这把剑通过吸收力量来进行疑似「成长」的行为。如此罕见的特性，让一些别有用心的人盯上了它。

quests.title: Raiders Amidst Snow Mist
quests.description: All proceeds smoothly. You plan to search for Albedo to discuss the changes the sword has undergone further.
quests.description_chs: 一切似乎都很顺利。你打算找阿贝多聊聊这把剑的变化。

quests.title: Uninvited Guests
quests.description: Many unexpected things have happened on this mountain. A mysterious hidden camp, suddenly-appearing thieves, uninvited enemies... This sword seems to have brought you into the thick of all this weirdness. So long as it remains in your hands, trouble will always follow in its wake — with such troubles including those who have come to take the sword, and new monsters heretofore unseen.
quests.description_chs: 雪山上有太多意料之外的事：神秘隐蔽的营地、突然出现的小偷、不请自来的敌人。这把剑似乎将你们带入了怪圈，只要它还在你手中，麻烦就会源源不断地到来。你的麻烦，甚至包括蛮横夺剑之人与闻所未闻的新怪物。

quests.title: Afterword
quests.description: After a long battle, the sword that has, at last, completed its growth has a new place to be.
quests.description_chs: 经过漫长战斗，最终完成「成长」的剑有了新去处。
