quests.title: The Origin of the Lanterns
quests.description: On the day of the first full moon each year, the people of Liyue celebrate Lantern Rite. At nighttime, everyone in Liyue releases Xiao Lanterns and the Mingxiao Lantern into the bright night sky. Each Xiao Lantern contains a piece of Plaustrite that makes it float, and people hang wish sticks from them, which carry their hearts' desires in written or painted form. The lanterns slowly fly away, carrying the hope that the light they emit might guide the souls of Liyue's faithful protectors home, that they might return and be reunited with their people once more. You and Paimon arrive in Liyue as the festival is in full swing, preparing to enjoy yourselves...
quests.description_chs: 每年第一个月圆之夜，就是璃月的「海灯节」。  在夜里，人们会放出「霄灯」和「明霄灯」，升上夜空。 「霄灯」中编入了天然浮空的「浮生石」，挂上书写心愿或绘制图画的愿签放飞，祈愿历史上曾护佑璃月的英雄魂魄寻灯归来，一聚团圆。 你与派蒙来到了节日期间的璃月，准备在海灯节游玩一番…

quests.title: Currents Deep Beneath the Lanterns
quests.description: The highlight of Lantern Rite is the release of the giant Mingxiao Lantern into the sky, and this year's Mingxiao Lantern is supposed to be a sight well worth the wait. The Plaustrite that will lift the lantern into the air is the largest in twenty years! For this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have set up the Xiao Market to help gather the materials needed to build the lantern. When you arrive at the Xiao Market, one of the event organizers, Wang'ya, seems to have something to say to you...
quests.description_chs: 在海灯节，最重要的一项活动，就是放飞巨型花灯「明霄灯」。 今年的「明霄灯」壮景可期。用来让巨灯浮空的那块「浮生石」，是二十年来最大的一块。 为此，璃月的商人们开设了「霄市」，筹集建灯所用的材料。 今天你来到「霄市」时，望雅似乎有事想要和你说…

quests.title: Light Upon the Sea
quests.description: Lantern Rite is still ongoing. With the help of Xiao, Kaeya, and the Millelith, you have foiled a "plot" that has left you not knowing whether to laugh or cry and have succeeded in bringing the foolish criminal behind it to justice and handing them over to the Millelith. Today, you prepare to go to Wangshu Inn to report the results of the matter to Xiao, as you agreed...
quests.description_chs: 海灯节仍在继续，而你在魈、凯亚和千岩军的帮助下，挫败了一场让人啼笑皆非的「阴谋」，也将策划了这场「阴谋」的笨贼抓获，交给了千岩军处置。 今天，你准备按照约定去望舒客栈向魈回报这件事的情况…

quests.title: Qingce's Lanterns
quests.description: Something seems to be bothering Granny Ruoxin from Qingce Village...
quests.description_chs: 轻策庄的若心奶奶似乎正在因为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Keeping Wanmin's Patrons Fed
quests.description: Once again, it's the Lantern Rite — and once again, Wanmin Restaurant's Chef Mao is busier than ever...
quests.description_chs: 正逢一年一度的海灯节，「万民堂」的卯师傅又忙活开了…

quests.title: Iron Ingot Meets Ziwei
quests.description: Iron Ingot from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled about something...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的铁块儿似乎正在为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Lantern Rite, Big Business?
quests.description: Mr. Zhu seems to want to use the Lantern Rite to pick his business up a little...
quests.description_chs: 朱老板似乎想要借着这次海灯节让自己的生意再红火一些…

quests.title: Verses and Vistas of Lantern Rite (Part I)
quests.description: The artist Vermeer is puzzling over how to capture the Lantern Rite in a painting...
quests.description_chs: 画家梵米尔似乎正在为了如何描绘海灯节而发愁…

quests.title: Outspoken Linling
quests.description: Linling from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled by something...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的霖铃似乎正在因为什么事而烦恼…

quests.title: Yesteryear's Lanterns and the Guhua of Today
quests.description: Sun Yu and Little Que'er seem to want to release a Xiao Lantern...
quests.description_chs: 孙宇和小雀儿似乎想要放飞霄灯…

quests.title: A Festive First Adventure
quests.description: Tiantian of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild seems to have been working on something...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的甜甜似乎正在筹备什么事…

quests.title: A Very Festive Problem
quests.description: Bubu Pharmacy's Herbalist Gui is racking his brains about something...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港不卜庐的阿桂似乎正在为了某些事发愁…

quests.title: Little Lantern, Little Wish
quests.description: Mengmeng seems to be troubled by something...
quests.description_chs: 蒙蒙似乎正在因为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Hammer and Wrench
quests.description: Wrench Wang from Liyue Harbor seems to be looking for help with some matters...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的王扳子，似乎有些事想要找人帮忙…

quests.title: Mondstadters in Liyue
quests.description: Freki and Geri are getting a little homesick...
quests.description_chs: 在海灯节期间，弗莱琪和杰里似乎也有些想家了…

quests.title: The Illumiscreen: I
quests.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is inviting people to play a certain game...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的小千似乎正在招揽人过去玩一个游戏…

quests.title: The Illumiscreen: II
quests.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的小千似乎还在招揽人过去试玩「玲珑霄灯图」…

quests.title: The Illumiscreen: III
quests.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的小千似乎还在招揽人过去试玩「玲珑霄灯图」…

quests.title: Kurious Kamera
quests.description: A certain special Kamera is currently causing Ji Tong some grief...
quests.description_chs: 季同正为了一架特别的「留影机」而苦恼着…

quests.title: Perfect Shot
quests.description: Ji Tong from Liyue Harbor seems to have found a way to fix that Kamera of his...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的季同似乎找到了维修他那台「留影机」的方法…

quests.title: Ode to Flower and Cloud
quests.description: When you've got some leisure time, how about taking a stroll through Mondstadt's streets and seeing if there's anything to do?
quests.description_chs: 闲暇的时候，去蒙德街头找找有什么事可做吧！

quests.title: Missive of Cloud and Fog
quests.description: As Venti's all-important assistant, you are to go out with him to collect the love poetry written by the people of Mondstadt. However, the citizenry has various troubles of their own, even during such a festive time as this.
quests.description_chs: 身为温迪重要的助手，你将和他一起回收蒙德人的情诗作业。然而，即便是节日期间，蒙德人也有着各式各样的烦恼。

quests.title: Realm of Fog and Wind
quests.description: You and Venti keep pushing on for the sake of some good wine. Cold corners, perilous places, strange sites... who knows what incidents await the two of you? Even more interestingly, you begin to realize that there is no common understanding of what a "Windblume" is.
quests.description_chs: 看在美酒的份上，你和温迪不断为作业奔波。寒冷的地方、危险的地方、奇怪的地方…真不知道前面还有什么事件在等待着你们。更有趣的是，你逐渐发觉，人们对「风之花」的认知大不相同。

quests.title: Dream of Wind and Flowers
quests.description: On account of your contributions to Mondstadt, you have been chosen as this year's Windblume Star. As such, you will be making a Windblume offering to the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, on behalf of the whole of Mondstadt. That said, what on earth is a Windblume?
quests.description_chs: 因对蒙德城的贡献，你被选为本届「风花节之星」，将代表蒙德人民向风神巴巴托斯献上你所认定的「风之花」。不过，「风之花」究竟是什么呢？
(test)酒馆残留$HIDDEN
(test)风龙废墟残留$HIDDEN

quests.title: Life Flows On (I)
quests.description: The water source near the winery has become bitter for no apparent reason. The Adventurers' Guild hopes for your cooperation in resolving this matter.
quests.description_chs: 最近酒庄附近的水源无征兆的变苦了。冒险家协会希望你能协助解决这件事。

quests.title: Life Flows On (II)
quests.description: After having helped Endora for this period of time, you are finally ready to cut to the heart of this problem.
quests.description_chs: 在帮助嫣朵拉这么久之后，你们终于做好准备直面问题的根源了。

quests.title: Break the Sword Cemetery Seal
quests.description: According to Dr. Livingstone, there are three hilichurl tribes surrounding the Sword Cemetery in <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>. To the north, the Meaty tribe; to the south, the Sleeper tribe; and in the valley to the east, the Eclipse tribe. The key to breaking the seals on the Sword Cemetery may lie within their encampments...
quests.description_chs: 据利文斯通博士说，<color=#00E1FFFF>达达乌帕谷</color>的剑冢周围一共有三个丘丘人部落，分别是北方的「好肉族」、南方的「好睡族」和东边谷地中的「黑日族」。解开剑冢封印的线索，也许就在这些丘丘人部落里…

quests.title: Break the Eclipse Tribe's Seal
quests.description: The Eclipse tribe's Elemental Monument stands at the center of their dilapidated altar. It is being defended by samachurls, mitachurls and Abyss Mages, so it might be best to find a way to pick them off.
quests.description_chs: 黑日族的元素机关位于中心破败祭坛的中心，由暴徒、萨满、法师守护着，想办法分头击破可能是个好办法。

quests.title: Break the Sleeper Seal
quests.description: The Sleeper tribe's power lies beneath a large tree, defended by mitachurls and a heap of hilichurls. Defeating mitachurls will break the seal on the Elemental Monument. It is said that mitachurls sleep early, so surprising them at night might be a good idea.
quests.description_chs: 好睡族的元素机关位于中心的大树下，由暴徒和一众丘丘人守护着，击败暴徒便可解除元素机关封印，据说他们晚上睡得特别早，到时候动手偷偷击杀暴徒是个好办法哦。

quests.title: Break the Meaty Seal
quests.description: The Meaty tribe worships power. Challenge them in the arena to break the seal.
quests.description_chs: 好肉族崇尚力量，只要去完成他们大擂台上的好肉族封印挑战即可解锁他们的屏障了。

quests.title: Find the Missing Fairy
quests.description: The fairies were kidnapped by nearby hilichurls, devastating the Tree of Life. If we manage to save the fairies, perhaps the Tree of Life will respond to our prayers.
quests.description_chs: 小精灵被附近的丘丘人抓走了，生命树非常伤心。如果能把他们找回来，也许生命树会响应我们的祈祷呢。

quests.title: Mondstadt Glider
quests.description: As it turned out, the book Amber gave you wasn't a manual, but a fairy tale... After completing the first test out in the wild, you learn that the second test is to take place within the city of Mondstadt itself. Amber is waiting for you there.
quests.description_chs: 原来那本书不是指南，而是童话…这之后你在蒙德野外接受了第一场考试，第二场考试则是在蒙德城。为此，安柏正在城内等你。

quests.title: Amber Abyss
quests.description: Set the Fallen Afloat
quests.description_chs: 掉下去，吹起来$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Wolves' Territory
quests.description: You and Paimon decide to pay a visit to Wolvendom, a place in Mondstadt that few people pass through, without any knowledge of the dangers that may await you within this primordial territory.
quests.description_chs: 你与派蒙决定探访蒙德的人烟稀少之地，奔狼领，全然不知这片生态原始的领域中潜藏着怎样的危险。

quests.title: Another Day as an Outrider!
quests.description: On your last legs from being attacked by an enormous slime, you were rescued by a young man named Razor. Razor, who calls a wolf pack family, mentioned a "red one, burny girl." You have your guesses as to who that is...
quests.description_chs: 奔狼领中的巨大史莱姆袭击了你们，在你力气快要耗尽的时候，名叫雷泽的少年帮助了你们。以狼群为家人的雷泽提到了一个「红色、很烫的女孩子」，关于这个女孩的身份，你们似乎有了猜想。

quests.title: Ravaged by Wolves
quests.description: It seems that the "red, burny girl" was not Amber, as you had thought. But you receive news from Amber about wolf pack attacks in Drunkard Gorge. The wolf pack, the boy, the attacks... things are getting more complicated. This calls for a thorough investigation.
quests.description_chs: 那个「红色、很烫的女孩子」好像并不是你们以为的安柏，但从安柏口中，你们听说了「醉汉峡」的狼群袭击事件。狼群、少年、袭击…事情变得复杂了起来，你们决定仔细调查一番。

quests.title: Fate's Chosen Lupical
quests.title_chs: 卢皮卡，即是命运的选择
quests.description: You are yet again led to Wolvendom. Are these Wolfhook seeds solid evidence? Are Razor and his wolf pack really behind the attack? Or are the Wolfhooks indicative of something else?
quests.description_chs: 再次被线索领到了奔狼领。这枚钩钩果种子是否真的就是铁证，雷泽和他的狼群是否就是袭击的罪魁祸首？  然而，钩钩果其实还有另外的意义…

quests.title: Kaeya's Troubles
quests.description: You bump into Kaeya, whom you first met during Stormterror's attack, at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.
quests.description_chs: 在骑士团总部，你们遇到了龙灾时结识的骑士，凯亚。

quests.title: Mystery of the Arcadian Ruins
quests.description: According to Kaeya, his pirate grandfather left behind a treasured sword that has been buried in the Lost Arcadian Ruins. To prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, you search high and low for intelligence regarding the ruins.
quests.description_chs: 据凯亚说，他的海盗爷爷留下一处「剑」之宝藏，埋藏于「失落的阿卡狄亚遗迹」。为了抢在窃贼之前将宝藏保护起来，你们四处打听，努力收集有关「失落的阿卡狄亚遗迹」的情报。

quests.title: Kaeya's Gain
quests.description: After much thinking, you finally solve the riddles contained within the intel you were given. The Lost Arcadian Ruins are now within reach!
quests.description_chs: 你们绞尽脑汁，终于解开了情报中的谜题。「失落的阿卡狄亚遗迹」近在眼前！

quests.title: Legend of the Darknight Hero
quests.description: Recently, rumors about a certain Darknight Hero have been circulating around Mondstadt...
quests.description_chs: 最近的蒙德城中，似乎流传着有关「暗夜英雄」的传闻…

quests.title: Darknight Hero's Crisis
quests.description: Your inquiries were slowly bringing the Darknight Hero's identity to light, but just then, you met the man himself. His true identity is Diluc, owner of the Dawn Winery — and his actions have long since attracted the attention of the Knights of Favonius...
quests.description_chs: 经过多方打听，「暗夜英雄」的身份似乎正要浮出水面。但就在此时，你们竟恰好遇到了「暗夜英雄」。而他的真实身份即是——「晨曦酒庄」的老板迪卢克。并且，这位暗中守护蒙德的英雄似乎早已引起了骑士团的注意…

quests.title: Darknight Hero's Alibi
quests.title_chs: 暗夜英雄的不在场证明
quests.description: Knight Huffman has informed you that the Abyss Order is plotting against the Darknight Hero. As a precaution, the Knights have decided to monitor the Darknight Hero's actions. You shared this information with Diluc and discussed countermeasures. Having made your preparations, you now lie in wait for both the Knights and the Abyss Order to act.
quests.description_chs: 骑士团的霍夫曼告诉你们，深渊教团正欲对「暗夜英雄」不利，为防变故，骑士团决定对「暗夜英雄」进行监视。得知消息的你们，与迪卢克商量出了破解之法，你们做足了准备，只待深渊教团与骑士团双双动手。

quests.title: The Art of Cooking
quests.description: On the outskirts of the city of Mondstadt, the adventurer Lynn is currently preparing to make a meal...
quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城外，冒险家琳小姐似乎正在准备进行烹饪…

quests.title: The Boars are Attacking!
quests.description: Boars keep attacking the vineyards, and Tunner is getting anxious...
quests.description_chs: 野猪们不断袭击着葡萄园，特纳先生正在犯愁…

quests.title: The Blessings of The Seven
quests.description: Paimon suggests you go to a Statue of The Seven.
quests.description_chs: 派蒙提议你去七天神像那里看看。

quests.title: Scent on the Wind
quests.description: As you walk through Mondstadt, Paimon is attracted by the aroma of food...
quests.description_chs: 在蒙德城中漫步时，派蒙被一股食物的香气所吸引…

quests.title: License to Glide
quests.description: Amber has specially prepared a gliding exam for you. She has also provided a gliding manual, which she has asked you to read before taking the exam.
quests.description_chs: 安柏专门为你准备了一场考试，在那之前，她还给了你一本「飞行指南」，要你考试前通读一遍。

quests.title: Glide With the Wind
quests.description: Amber wishes to discuss the matter of how you've been using your wind glider...
quests.description_chs: 安柏想要与你讨论关于使用风之翼的问题…

quests.title: Gliding Training at Windrise
quests.description: Gliding Bombardment Minigame
quests.description_chs: 飞行轰炸玩法$UNRELEASED

quests.title: They Call Him Raptor
quests.description: During the exam, you were mistaken for the thief Raptor by Otto, a Knight of Favonius, and were stopped. After clearing the misunderstanding, you volunteer to help arrest Raptor — and so begins the chase.
quests.description_chs: 考试途中骑士奥特错将你当成文物盗贼「怪鸟」的同伙拦下。你们向他澄清误会后，自告奋勇帮忙缉捕「怪鸟」。一场追踪开始了。

quests.title: Outrider Style
quests.description: During your pursuit, you track Raptor to his hideout. You plunge into its depths without hesitation. Time to bring this criminal to justice.
quests.description_chs: 循着踪迹，你们一路追至「怪鸟藏身地」。为了将他抓捕归案，你们毫不犹豫向深处挺进。

quests.title: When the West Wind Arises
quests.description: Sara from the Good Hunter restaurant appears to have a request for the Knights of Favonius...
quests.description_chs: 「猎鹿人」餐馆的莎拉小姐，似乎有事要拜托骑士团…

quests.title: Margaret's Longing
quests.title_chs: 委托人玛格丽特的思念
quests.description: While Jean is ill from overwork, you've been tasked with handling some citizens' commissions on her behalf. Where has Margaret's pet cat Prince run off to this time?
quests.description_chs: 琴因为过劳而病倒，你们被拜托分担琴的工作，协助处理城内居民的委托。玛格丽特走丢的猫「小王子」究竟跑到哪里去了呢？

quests.title: Charles' Troubles
quests.description: Has Charles managed to get hold of the tax forms he needs?
quests.description_chs: 不知查尔斯拿到他要的税收报表了吗？

quests.title: Sara's Worries
quests.description: Sara's delivery of ingredients still hasn't arrived, and she's growing more anxious by the minute...
quests.description_chs: 莎拉小姐还在因为食材未送到的事而焦急…

quests.title: Master's Day Off
quests.description: Today's commissions are done and dusted. Time to check up on Jean at the Cathedral.
quests.description_chs: 解决了城内居民的委托后，你们决定再到教堂探望琴的情况…
离开酒馆酒保出现$HIDDEN

quests.title: Natlan! A New Adventure
quests.description: You've made many unforgettable memories in Fontaine. Now, a new journey lies before you — first, time to say goodbye to your fine Fontainian friends.
quests.description_chs: 在枫丹留下了许多难以忘却的回忆。如今新的旅程就在眼前，先和枫丹的朋友们道别吧。

quests.title: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
quests.description: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, the most important competition in Natlan, is about to begin. Meet up with Kachina and the gang before things start.
quests.description_chs: 「归火圣夜巡礼」作为纳塔最重要的比赛，即将在今天开幕。比赛之前，先和卡齐娜等人会合吧。

quests.title: Home of the Hot Springs
quests.description: As the Pilgrimage draws to a close, Kachina emerges triumphant, and she joins the Night Warden Wars alongside some seasoned veterans. After the tournament, Mualani moots the idea of visiting the People of the Springs...
quests.description_chs: 随着归火圣夜巡礼落下帷幕，卡齐娜顺利胜出，并跟随着几位前辈一同参加巡夜者战争。赛后，玛拉妮提议到「流泉之众」部族看看…

quests.title: A Decision
quests.description: You make new friends amongst the People of the Springs and leave memories behind. It's good to take a break before embarking on a new journey.
quests.description_chs: 在「流泉之众」认识了新的朋友，留下了一段回忆。在新的旅程开始前，好好放松一下吧。

quests.title: To Reclaim an Ancient Name
quests.description: To rescue Kachina, who has been trapped in the Night Kingdom, you must first seek out her Ancient Name. Kinich says that he has given the ritual implements needed to do so to the Chief of the Scions of the Canopy. Head there and ask around.
quests.description_chs: 为了救回受困于夜神之国的卡齐娜，眼下必须先找到卡齐娜的「古名」。基尼奇说他将能够找回古名的仪式用具交给了「悬木人」部族的族长，到「悬木人」部族打听一下吧。

quests.title: Echoes of Life
quests.description: You've successfully obtained Kachina's Ancient Name. Now, hand it to Mavuika.
quests.description_chs: 顺利取得了卡齐娜的古名，将它交给玛薇卡吧。

quests.title: Into Eternal Night
quests.description: After passing through the dragon ruins, you reach the Night Kingdom at last. Time to search for Kachina.
quests.description_chs: 在穿过龙的遗迹后，终于抵达了夜神之国。是时候寻找卡齐娜的下落了。

quests.title: Past and Future
quests.description: Mavuika's spirit enters the Night Kingdom at a critical moment to extract everyone. She seems to still be at the Speaker's Chamber. Time to go visit her.
quests.description_chs: 千钧一发之际，玛薇卡的精神进入夜神之国，带着众人离开。她本人似乎还在「话事处」，去见一见她吧。
(test)隐藏父任务用来发奖励$HIDDEN

quests.title: Beneath the Secret Source
quests.description: After several twists and turns, you finally understand The Captain's plan and goal — to "reconstruct the Ley Lines." This seems to you a risky endeavor. One for which countermeasures must be discussed with Mavuika post-haste...
quests.description_chs: 几经波折，你们终于了解「队长」的计划与目的——「重构地脉」。这件事听上去风险颇高，你们决定尽快和玛薇卡商讨对策…

quests.title: As One We Watch the Setting Sun
quests.description: You witness the emergence of the fifth hero within the Remnants of the Secret Source, and temporary cooperation with The Captain is established. It seems this matter has drawn to a close, and yet the Abyss presses in. It's not time to relax just yet...
quests.description_chs: 你们在秘源遗迹中见证了第五位英雄的出现，也暂时和「队长」达成了合作的约定，这件事看起来终于告一段落。然而深渊依然不断迫近，现在并不是能松口气的时候…

quests.title: The Surging Darkness
quests.description: Abyssal monsters invade Natlan, and the curtain rises on a massive war...
quests.description_chs: 深渊魔物侵入纳塔，一场规模巨大的战争已然拉开了帷幕…

quests.title: Despair Engulfs the Heavens
quests.description: The true master of the Abyssal power has emerged at last. The earth's corrosion intensifies and monsters are driven mad, the apocalyptic scene becoming a festering seedbed of impotent despair.
quests.description_chs: 深渊之力的真主终于出现，大地侵蚀加剧，魔物愈发狂躁，这宛如末日般的场景，令人陷入不知所措的绝望之中…

quests.title: No One Fights Alone
quests.description: The six heroes have gathered, and Mavuika awakens the power of the divine throne. The horn is sounded for all Natlan to hear — the Night War is underway! A reckoning has come for the Abyss!
quests.description_chs: 六位英雄齐聚，玛薇卡唤醒了神座中的力量，为纳塔众人吹响了「狩夜者战争」的号角。是时候清算深渊了！

quests.title: A Fuel Named "Fate"
quests.description: The threat to Natlan remains unresolved, for the Abyssal tide you shattered was but a reflection emerging from the Night Kingdom. Still more crises await — sorrow, solitude, and death...
quests.description_chs: 被击碎的深渊只是来自夜神之国的倒影，纳塔的威胁仍未完全解决。我们还需要面对很多难题：悲伤，孤独，以及死亡…

quests.title: All Names Are Noble
quests.description: Your adventures in Natlan continue. After some time has passed...
quests.description_chs: 纳塔的冒险仍在继续，过了一段时间之后…

quests.title: To Whence the Smoke Drifts
quests.description: Citlali comes as promised, but she also makes a request: she wants you to help her find her missing grandson, Ororon. You take this commission and set out alongside her.
quests.description_chs: 茜特菈莉如约前来，不过，她也提出了一个要求：希望你们帮她找回失踪的孙子欧洛伦。你们接下委托，与茜特菈莉一同踏上寻人之路。

quests.title: The Flickering Light Splits in Twain
quests.description: The Abyss is invading, and the situation grows dire. Everyone has their mission, and here and now, you decide to first speak to Mavuika about the key information you've obtained...
quests.description_chs: 深渊入侵，情况变得相当紧急。众人各有任务，此时此刻，你们决定先找玛薇卡谈谈先前取得的重要信息…
(test)隐藏判断玛拉妮状态$HIDDEN
(test)用来配阿加亚隐藏对话$HIDDEN
(test)主线结束后阿米娜闲置$HIDDEN

quests.title: Subterranean Ruins
quests.description: The crucial moment is fast approaching. You should get some rest today...
quests.description_chs: 关键的时刻即将来临，今天就好好休息吧…

quests.title: As the Sun Rises and Sets
quests.description: The time for the meeting has finally come. Head over to the Speaker's Chamber.
quests.description_chs: 终于到了会面的时间，现在前往「话事处」吧。

quests.title: Journey of Stars and Flames
quests.description: The final battle with the Abyss is at hand. You have the support of all in Natlan, and they will do so in various ways. Once you are ready, journey forth to the last battleground.
quests.description_chs: 接下来就是和深渊决战的时刻，纳塔所有人都会以各种方式支持你，做好准备后，就向着最终的战场出发吧。
(test)废弃$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: For the Same Land
quests.description: After the routing of the black sun that had hung high in the sky, Natlan finally had a precious moment of respite. You decide to go help the Flower-Feather Clan, which had been hit hardest by the calamity, with their reconstruction efforts...
quests.description_chs: 盘踞在天空的黑色太阳被击退，纳塔也迎来了宝贵的喘息机会。为了帮助受创最重的花羽会完成重建工作，你们决定过去帮忙…
(test)父任务描述$HIDDEN

quests.title: Where All Hopes Lie
quests.description: With the aid of your companions, you and Mavuika finally get the chance to face off against Gosoythoth. Give your all to claim victory, and by doing so, end the war in Natlan.
quests.description_chs: 在伙伴的帮助下，你和玛薇卡终于有机会面对「古斯托特」。为了终结纳塔的战争，竭尽所能夺取胜利吧。

quests.title: When All Becomes a Monument
quests.description: Side by side with Mavuika, you defeat Gosoythoth and emerge as a hero revered by all in Natlan. Take this moment to enjoy the glory that is rightfully yours.
quests.description_chs: 你和玛薇卡击败了「古斯托特」，你成为了纳塔万众敬仰的英雄，好好享受属于你的时刻吧。

quests.title: After the Peace
quests.description: Tonight, you hear a familiar voice in your dreams...
quests.description_chs: 这天晚上，你在睡梦中听见一个熟悉的声音…

quests.title: A New Pilgrimage
quests.description: At Iansan's request, you and Mavuika help test the competition process...
quests.description_chs: 应伊安珊要求，玛薇卡和你们一起帮忙测试大赛流程…

quests.title: Hearken, Ye Who Have Returned
quests.description: Natlan's very first leader, the mighty first Pyro Archon Xbalanque, has appeared before all in a form and manner beyond imagination...
quests.description_chs: 纳塔最初的领袖，伟大的初代火神希巴拉克，他竟然以超乎想象的方式和形态出现在众人面前…
(test)父任务描述$HIDDEN
(test)父任务描述$HIDDEN

quests.title: Crimes One and Two
quests.description: The Windblume Festival should be a joyous affair, but not all is as it seems in Mondstadt...
quests.description_chs: 风花节期间，本该轻松快乐的蒙德城却有些反常…

quests.title: Where the Moon Rises
quests.description: Moonlight paves your way, guiding you to Nod-Krai, an "elysium" for adventurers and wanderers alike...
quests.description_chs: 月光铺就前路，指引你来到了挪德卡莱，这个冒险家与流浪客的「乐园」…

quests.title: Reunion Beneath the Moonlight
quests.description: The secrets of this land are like an ancient song that lingers in your heart and cannot be easily dismissed... What song shall Nod-Krai play for you this night...?
quests.description_chs: 这片土地的秘密，仿佛古老的歌谣一般萦绕在你心头，挥之不去…夜晚的挪德卡莱，又会为你呈现出怎样的曲调呢…

quests.title: In the Shadows of Night
quests.description: Ever do ominous mists rise at night, and ever will perilous schemes brew in the darkness...
quests.description_chs: 总有不祥的迷雾于夜晚倏然升起，总有危险的阴谋于黑夜悄然酝酿…

quests.title: Moonless Night
quests.description: A battle for the fate of your companions and Nod-Krai has already begun...
quests.description_chs: 一场关乎同伴与挪德卡莱未来的战斗，已然揭幕…

quests.title: Flamelets
quests.description: Natlan seems to have welcomed some unexpected guests...
quests.description_chs: 纳塔似乎迎来了一些意料之外的客人…

quests.title: Smoldering
quests.description: In order to cure Ineffa's amnesia, everyone searches Natlan for answers...
quests.description_chs: 为了修好伊涅芙的失忆，众人在纳塔各处奔波…

quests.title: Searing
quests.description: It seems this ancient place has been waiting for your arrival...
quests.description_chs: 这片古老的领地，仿佛在等待你们的到来…

quests.title: Fulminations and Undercurrents
quests.description: The Wild Hunt has left many secrets behind, and the shadows hidden within the Abyss begin to churn. After chaos strikes, unease spreads amongst people, making them desperate for solutions...
quests.description_chs: 「狂猎」留下了许多秘密，隐藏于深渊背后的诡影蠢蠢欲动。混乱之后，不安情绪在人群中逐渐扩散，他们迫切地想要找到解决办法…

quests.title: The Dark Side of Memory
quests.description: After repairing the giant cannon and successfully dispersing the Wild Hunt, you make for Hiisi Island to attempt to get some clarity regarding the memories of your spaceship.
quests.description_chs: 修复大炮并成功驱散「狂猎」之后，你们动身前往希汐岛，试图知晓更清晰的关于飞船的记忆。

quests.title: One There Was, Who Hunted the Moon
quests.description: With The Damselette, you not only uncover surprising truths from your memories but also learn the true identity of the phantom masquerading as your sibling. He may well be one of the Five Sinners Dainsleif once mentioned — Rerir, the Rächer of Solnari.
quests.description_chs: 在「少女」这里你不但从记忆中挖掘出了出人意料的真相，还得知了那个伪装成血亲的诡影的真实身份，他很可能就是戴因斯雷布曾提起的五大罪人之一——「猎月人」雷利尔。

quests.title: The Hunger of Many
quests.description: Everything comes to an end, all too abruptly. Without a shred of hesitation, you throw yourself into the fray along with everyone else...
quests.description_chs: 一切结束得过于突然，你来不及犹豫就与众人一同投身到战斗中…

quests.title: The Ashen-White Order Burns
quests.description: You and Flins discover that the cannon's firing is Rerir's doing, but his motives remain a mystery. Either way, you are running out of time...
quests.description_chs: 你和菲林斯查出了大炮发射这件事是「猎月人」在自导自演，但他的动机与目的仍然成谜，显然，留给你们的时间已经不多了…

quests.title: Rest Beyond Reach
quests.description: Rerir used the cannon in Nasha Town to obtain a complete body. The chaos caused by the Wild Hunt is far from over...
quests.description_chs: 「猎月人」借用那夏镇的大炮获取了完整的身躯，「狂猎」招来的混乱还远未结束…

quests.title: Hidden in the Shadows
quests.description: The "Rächer of Solnari" has been revived with the aid of a kuuvahki beam. Now a new crisis looms over Nod-Krai...
quests.description_chs: 「猎月人」借助月矩力光束顺利复活，新的危机正笼罩挪德卡莱…

quests.title: Special Operation
quests.description: Grand Master Varka has returned from Amsvartnir and helped to devise a battle plan. To face the "Rächer of Solnari," the people of Nod-Krai must unite as never before...
quests.description_chs: 「大团长」法尔伽从安瓦蒂尼尔湖归来，帮助众人制定了作战方案。为了对抗「猎月人」，此时的挪德卡莱正空前团结…

quests.title: Everlasting As the Moon
quests.description: After negotiating with Sandrone, the "Marionette," you leave the Fatui's Experimental Design Bureau. Everywhere you look, the Wild Hunt is prowling. Make your way back to base — and be sure not to get caught along the way!
quests.description_chs: 在与「木偶」桑多涅交涉后，离开了愚人众的试验设计局。到处都是游荡的狂猎，在不被发现的情况下回到秘密基地吧。

quests.title: The First Sliver of Moonlight
quests.description: The bright moon hangs high, casting down its gentle light. Yet, your stories begin to flow down different paths...
quests.description_chs: 明月高悬，洒下温柔的月光。而你们的故事，正向着不同的方向流淌…

quests.title: Descending Moon
quests.description: Through the endless, long night, The Doctor's schemes press closer, step by relentless step...
quests.description_chs: 长夜漫漫，「博士」的阴谋步步紧逼…

quests.title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
quests.description: The moon has returned to its homeland. Under its silver glow, Nod-Krai will set forth toward a bright, new tomorrow...
quests.description_chs: 月亮回到了它的故乡。挪德卡莱也将在月光的照拂下，驶向全新的明天…

quests.title: All Is Foretold
quests.description: Back at base, everyone is discussing what to do next. Then, an unexpected figure enters the conversation.
quests.description_chs: 返回基地后，众人就接下来的行动展开讨论。这时，一个意想不到的人加入了…

quests.title: Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion
quests.description: By means of a special ceremony, you finally learn about the "Rächer of Solnari" Rerir's past.\nNow all that's left is to leave this place.
quests.description_chs: 通过特殊的仪式，你们终于了解到「猎月人」雷利尔的过去。\n接下来只需要离开这里。

quests.title: The Gardener
quests.description: Following the principles of "truth," people gain knowledge, learn of boundaries, and nurture reverence. This mindset provides a safe borderline — while also shackling the mad.
quests.description_chs: 遵循「理」的准则，人们学得知识，懂得界限，习得敬畏。这一思维是安全的边界，也是疯狂者的束缚。

quests.title: Echoes of Fate
quests.description: To stop the Rächer of Solnari from causing further harm to Nod-Krai, you must gather all your strength and prepare for the most important battle.
quests.description_chs: 为了阻止猎月人对挪德卡莱造成进一步损害，你们不得不汇聚所有力量，筹备那至关重要的一战。
(test)已废弃$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Where Our Space and Time Intersect
quests.description: In this unfamiliar world, with companions beyond reach... What path is there to take that leads back to their side?
quests.description_chs: 陌生的世界、无法触及的同伴…要如何才能回到大家身边？

quests.title: Tracing the Footsteps of the Past
quests.description: Beneath the moon's watchful light, everyone is marching to the conclusions of their own stories...
quests.description_chs: 在月光的注视下，所有人都在朝着自己的终点前行…

quests.title: Where Does Her Name Rest?
quests.description: Seek her name within the boundless sea called "the past"...
quests.description_chs: 在名为「过去」的茫茫大海中寻找她的名字…

quests.title: In the Shifting Light of the Moon
quests.description: The journey so far has reached a brief pause. Take a moment to rest and check in on your companions.
quests.description_chs: 近日的冒险告一段落，先去休整一番，关照下同伴们吧。

quests.title: Ripples That Will Never Reach
quests.description: After reaching an understanding, you decide to head back to the Silvermoon Hall to ask around about what kind of gifts Columbina likes.
quests.description_chs: 达成共识之后，你决定返回「银月之庭」，打听一下哥伦比娅对礼物的喜好。

quests.title: The Night the Moon Returns Home
quests.description: The Moon-Prayer Night has come. On this final night, what memories will she leave behind?
quests.description_chs: 「祈月之夜」到了。在这最后的夜晚，她将留下怎样的回忆呢？

quests.title: Return to the Moon
quests.description: It's time to begin the journey home...
quests.description_chs: 是时候踏上归途了…

quests.title: Darkness Looming
quests.description: The situation in Sumeru is even more dire than first thought, and people have come together to come up with plans for various contingencies.
quests.description_chs: 须弥的情况比想象中更危急，为了应对可能发生的各种状况，人们聚集起来，群策群力。

quests.title: A Tower Unto Wisdom and Folly
quests.description: The current crisis is now beyond the capacity of ordinary men, and an unprecedented war is about to begin in the nation of wisdom. But even so, no one is abandoning their post.
quests.description_chs: 眼下已非常人能应对的紧急事态，即便如此，没有人离开自己应处的位置。被封闭的智慧之国内，一场空前的战争即将打响…

quests.title: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
quests.description: "The girl dreamed a very, very long dream. In it, people were holding hands, dancing in a circle, be they sages or fools, dancers or warriors, puppets or statues of gods... It did not matter who they were, or how old, and in that joyous dancing circle was the sum of all wisdom."
quests.description_chs: 「女孩做了一个很长很长的梦。她梦中，人们手握着手转圈，贤者与愚者，舞女与勇士，人偶与神像…无论种族，无论年龄，无论性别。大家的欢舞里蕴藏着有关智慧的一切。」

quests.title: Your Past Is Like a Garden
quests.description: The life of sentient beings seems destined to be a treacherous road. Yet, the warm and gentle sunshine still illuminates us who look upon one another. Yet deep and enduring love exists that can help us find ourselves again. And after the crisis passes, the flowers will be there to embrace you.
quests.description_chs: 智慧生命的一生似乎注定要是坎坷之途。好在还有温暖而柔和的阳光，照亮你我望见彼此，好在还有厚重又绵长的爱，帮助人们寻回自己。苦难后，总有鲜花环抱而来。

quests.title: Windblume Research Report
quests.description: The ever-studious researcher, Sayid from Sumeru, has become intrigued by the Windblume Festival.
quests.description_chs: 潜心研究的须弥学者萨义德似乎对风花节产生了兴趣…

quests.title: The Sound of Discord
quests.description: Vile has caught wind of some concerning news and would like you to go and investigate.
quests.description_chs: 薇尔小姐好像听到了一些令人在意的消息，想要请你前去调查…

quests.title: Those Hard-to-Reach Places
quests.description: Knight of Favonius Aramis is worried about the flower petals blowing all over the place...
quests.description_chs: 骑士阿拉米似乎在为到处乱飞的花瓣而烦恼…
(test)盗宝团的笔记上，似乎写着什么……$UNRELEASED$HIDDEN

quests.title: Mutual Exchange
quests.description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship...?
quests.description_chs: 与艾拉·马斯克一同前去与丘丘人交流，或许是一段新友谊的开始…？

quests.title: "Quiet, please, this is a library!"
quests.description: Ella Musk is trying to study in the library, but it seems something is disrupting her...
quests.description_chs: 在图书馆进行研究的艾拉·马斯克好像遇到了很让人困扰的事…

quests.title: Windbrew
quests.description: Margaret from The Cat's Tail seems to be planning something...
quests.description_chs: 「猫尾酒馆」的玛格丽特小姐似乎正在筹划着什么事情…

quests.title: Windblumes and Snowflakes
quests.description: Viktor seems to have run into a small issue during the Windblume Festival.
quests.description_chs: 在风花节中，维克多先生似乎遇见了一个小小的麻烦…

quests.title: Adventurers in Windblume
quests.description: Iris, who has set up shop at the Dragonspine base camp, seems to want some help...
quests.description_chs: 待在龙脊雪山山脚下营地中的玉霞，似乎有些事想找人帮忙…

quests.title: Hilichurl Justice
quests.description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues...
quests.description_chs: 与艾拉·马斯克一同前去为被欺负的丘丘人打抱不平，或许能够借此得到新的线索？

quests.title: Mimi Tomo
quests.description: The Adventurers' Guild has issued a new commission, and it seems to be related to a certain "Unusual Hilichurl"...?
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会挂出了一份新委托，似乎与某个「奇怪的丘丘人」相关…？

quests.title: The Lost Hilichurl
quests.description: The unusual fellow may have gotten away in the end, but at least the merchant route is safe again.
quests.description_chs: 尽管最后还是让那个奇怪的家伙跑掉了，但至少商路重又恢复了安全。

quests.title: Journey to Tsurumi
quests.description: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild is currently puzzling over a certain commission...
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的凯瑟琳小姐正在为一项委托犯愁…

quests.title: Autonomous Mechanical Energy Source: Preface
quests.title_chs: 自律机关能源研究·绪论

quests.title: Solid Ice, Soluble in Wine
quests.description: "Tsk, why is a Lawrence drinking here too... What bad luck..." "Ahem... Better watch your mouth. She is one of the Knights, after all..."
quests.description_chs: 「啧，怎么劳伦斯家的人也在这里喝酒…真是…」 「咳咳，你还是少说两句吧。好歹人家也是骑士团的人…」

quests.title: When They Take Off Their Armor
quests.description: "Has anyone seen Captain Kaeya?" "Kaeya? you'll find him in the tavern. Hehe... You must be new here, no? Well, good luck!"
quests.description_chs: 「请问，有人见过凯亚队长吗？」 「凯亚先生啊，你要往酒馆里去找。呵呵…新来的吧？加油哦。」

quests.title: Fine Wine From Yesterday
quests.description: "Just now, I saw Master Diluc enter the tavern in a rush." "Oh? Is Master Diluc going to mix drinks personally today? Can't miss out on this one... Come on, help me up."
quests.description_chs: 「刚才，我看迪卢克老爷行色匆匆地走进了酒馆。」 「哦？今天是老爷亲自调酒吗？那我可得去捧个场…来，扶我一把。」

quests.title: Dandelion, Rose, and Windwheel Aster
quests.description: "What on earth happened that Acting Grand Master Jean is going to the tavern?" "Calm down, it's the Acting Grand Master we're talking about. Besides, she wouldn't be there if something bad were really going on."
quests.description_chs: 「就连那位琴团长都去酒馆了？到底发生了什么事？」 「慌什么，那可是琴团长。再说，真要有大事就不会去酒馆了。」

quests.title: Surrounded by the Aroma of Tea
quests.description: "There seems to be a very unusual customer in the tavern..." "Well, it isn't every day that someone piques your interest. How about we go check this person out together?" "Forget it... I wouldn't dare to utter a word in front of him even if I went."
quests.description_chs: 「酒馆里好像有一位很不同寻常的客人…」 「能让你感兴趣的人物不多见啊。陪你凑个热闹？」 「算了算了…去了也不敢搭话的。」

quests.title: Docked on a Moonlit Night
quests.description: "Do you know that I met a very nice client today? She moved and talked with grace — a very generous buyer, too." "What did you sell her?" "Trade secret."
quests.description_chs: 「跟你说，今天我遇到了位好客人。仪态优雅，谈吐得当，出手还阔绰。」 「你卖出去了什么？」 「商业机密。」

quests.title: Untainted Autumn Frost
quests.description: "Is the white-haired lady passing by an adeptus from Liyue?" "I can't tell. Can you?" "Me, neither..."
quests.description_chs: 「你说，那位路过的那位白头发女人，是不是璃月那边的仙人啊。」 「我不懂，你懂吗？」 「我也不懂…」

quests.title: Crisis Relieved! A Happy Memento!

quests.title: A "Battlefield" Feast After Work
quests.description: After several days of intense and well-organized surveying drills, the time to part ways quietly arrives...

quests.title: Mine Craft
quests.description: Mining is not an easy task... But perhaps Mondstadt's blacksmith, Wagner, might have some tips for you...
quests.description_chs: 在野外采集矿石不是一件容易的事…也许，蒙德城的铁匠瓦格纳先生会知道一些关于采集矿石的诀窍…

quests.description: You meet a "treasure-seeker" named Ulman out in the wild. He says that he's looking for a capable "partner" to help him out...
quests.description_chs: 在野外遇见了一位名叫乌尔曼的「寻宝者」，他说自己正在寻找一位有足够实力的「合作伙伴」…

quests.title: Vishaps and Where to Find Them
quests.description: Recently, a lot of unusual phenomena have been occurring all over Liyue. According to some, they may be related to a monster depicted in ancient texts, the Geovishap. Katheryne of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild posted an urgent commission, calling adventurers to investigate the irregularities.
quests.description_chs: 近日，璃月大地上出现了很多异常现象，据说它们都和古书中记载的魔物「岩龙蜥」有关。璃月冒险家协会的凯瑟琳正在向冒险家发布紧急委托，对这些异状展开深入调查。

quests.title: Floral Freefall
quests.description: During the Windblume Festival, the area around Mondstadt will play host to all sorts of interesting activities. The Knights of Favonius' Lizzie would like to introduce you to one of the highlights of this event — "Floral Freefall."
quests.description_chs: 风花节期间，蒙德城周围举办了各种各样的趣味活动。西风骑士团的莉兹想要隆重为你介绍其中之一，「风中万花」。

quests.title: Mountainous Summons
quests.description: The hilichurls of Dadaupa Gorge have grown unusually active. The Adventurers' Guild's scholar-adventurer, Dr. Livingstone, is currently investigating the Gorge. Perhaps you can lend her some help.
quests.description_chs: 达达乌帕谷的丘丘人们一反常态，活跃非凡。而冒险家协会的学者型冒险家利文斯通，正着手于调查达达乌帕谷。或许你能带去一些帮助。

quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的卜劳恩想要为你介绍位于蒙德野外的一处神秘的秘境。

quests.title: Will of Stone
quests.description: Millelith soldier Jiayi wants to send a gift to his daughter, Little Liu, but he has no time to return to Qingce Village, and as such is looking for someone to help him out...
quests.description_chs: 千岩军嘉义想要送一份礼物给自己的女儿小六，但他实在抽不出空回轻策庄，正在找人帮忙…

quests.title: Solo Venture
quests.description: While investigating the movements of monsters at the Thousand Winds Temple, Jack was discovered due to his recklessness and attacked. Jack somehow made it back to Mondstadt, but he seems to have left something important behind at the Temple...
quests.description_chs: 在千风神殿监视魔物动向时，杰克因为太过鲁莽而被魔物发现并围攻。虽然杰克勉强逃回了蒙德城，但他身上的一些东西却遗失在了千风神殿里…

quests.description: Nervous An, busy at the harbor, is looking for someone to help to ease the nerves of guests from other nations...
quests.description_chs: 在港口忙碌的小安，正在找人帮自己安抚一些城里的外国客人…

quests.title: Blackcliff Woes

quests.title: Cleanup At Dawn
quests.description: After the storm, head housemaid Adelinde is preparing to render the Dawn Winery spick and span on the inside and out, but things aren't going so smoothly...
quests.description_chs: 暴风之后，女仆长爱德琳正准备将晨曦酒庄里里外外都打扫一遍，但打扫的过程似乎不太顺利…

quests.title: In the Aftermath
quests.description: Huffman has his hands full with the cleanup work that followed the storm...
quests.description_chs: 风暴之后，西风骑士霍夫曼正在为善后工作而头疼着…

quests.description: Something bad appears to be brewing at Jueyunjian, find its source with the help of the ballad as a clue...

quests.description: There's an urban legend circulating in Jueyunjian. If you wish to learn the truth about the adepti, you need to explore and leave no stones unturned.

quests.description: Nine stone pillars stand stoic near Cuijue Slope. They seem to hide a certain secret...
quests.description_chs: 在翠玦坡附近，有九根巨大的石柱巍然耸立，似乎隐藏着什么秘密…

quests.title: Luhua Landscape
quests.description: Vermeer, an artist who is looking for inspirational material near Luhua Pool, seems to have hit a snag, and is looking for help...
quests.description_chs: 正在渌华池旁取材的画家梵米尔似乎遇见了一些麻烦，需要找人帮忙…

quests.title: Trails in Tianqiu
quests.description: There is a strange tablet in Tianqiu Valley that seems to relate some of the valley's history...
quests.description_chs: 在天遒谷中有一块奇怪的石碑，上面似乎记录着一些与天遒谷有关的往事…

quests.title: Time and Wind
quests.description: You reach an uninhabited island across the sea, which is home to an enigmatic sundial. Who knows what secret it holds?
quests.description_chs: 你到达了一座海上的孤岛，上面有一座神秘的日晷，不知道其中是否隐藏着什么秘密…
奥藏山有仙人，自然也有修炼的师兄$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Ocean Pearl
quests.description: A mysterious ship has dropped anchor outside Liyue Harbor. The ship appears to be quite luxurious, all the more reason to hop right on board...
quests.description_chs: 在璃月港的海边停着一艘神秘的船，看起来十分华贵。而你却冒冒失失地直接闯了进去…

quests.title: A Lone Ship In Guyun
quests.description: A heavily armed ship of unknown origins has stopped outside Guyun Stone Forest. You hop right on board to investigate...
quests.description_chs: 在孤云阁旁，停着一艘不知来历的庞大武装舰船，而你却冒冒失失地闯了进去…
望舒客栈主题玩法$HIDDEN

quests.title: Pressing Deadlines
quests.description: Clerk Zhao is so swamped with work that she can't even get a moment to herself. It seems she could use some assistance...
quests.description_chs: 因为越来越多的工作，小昭忙得抽不开身，她正在寻找一位帮手…

quests.title: No Restoring This Past Land of Beauty
quests.description: Zhiping of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be investigating the earthquakes and strange monster movements in Tianqiu Valley...
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会的治平似乎在调查近期在天遒谷发生的地震与魔物的异动…

quests.title: Verses and Vistas of Lantern Rite (Part II)
quests.description: Painter Vermeer seems to be looking for Qingzhou...
quests.description_chs: 画家梵米尔似乎找清昼有什么事…

quests.title: Hereafter: The Trail of Pervases
quests.description: When you smell the aroma of Grilled Tiger Fish, you are suddenly reminded of someone who once helped you...
quests.description_chs: 当你们闻到「烤吃虎鱼」的香气时，不禁想起了一位曾经帮助过你们的人…

quests.title: Valor's Afterglow
quests.description: Although the incident in The Chasm has come to a close, Zhiqiong is still involved in other exploration work. Best you go check in on her...
quests.description_chs: 虽然层岩之下的事件已经暂时平息，但是志琼似乎还在进行其他的勘测工作，去问问她的情况吧…

quests.title: Chasm Spelunkers
quests.description: Now that you have destroyed the Bedrock Keys, the seal on The Chasm has now come undone. It is time to venture into the depths below.
quests.description_chs: 破坏了「磐键」后，层岩巨渊的封印就此解除，现在就出发前往层岩巨渊之下吧…

quests.title: Valor's Afterglow: Return by Sundown
quests.description: Jinwu has an urgent task for you. It seems to involve Zhiqiong...
quests.description_chs: 瑾武似乎有什么紧急之事要委托，好像是和志琼相关的…

quests.title: Valor's Afterglow: The Faint Light Remembered
quests.description: Zhiqiong seems to have left the exploration team to explore on her own. Still, it's too dangerous to go alone into The Chasm, so she must be found...
quests.description_chs: 志琼似乎要离开勘探队独自探险，独自进入层岩巨渊还是太危险了，还是尽快找到她吧…

quests.title: First Miasmic Contact
quests.description: Investigate the mysterious environs beneath the stone and take pictures related to the black mud.
quests.description_chs: 与志琼一起，调查层岩下变异的奇特环境，拍摄有关黑泥的照片。

quests.title: Meeting New People... and Foiling Some Bandits
quests.description: As you explore the lower levels of The Chasm, you discover Treasure Hoarders. If they think you'll let them do things as they please down here, then they've got another think coming!
quests.description_chs: 在打探层岩巨渊下层的过程中，居然还发现了盗宝团，岂能放任他们在层岩巨渊中肆意施为…

quests.title: The Heavenly Stone's Debris
quests.description: To get to ever-deeper levels of The Chasm, you must open the path that was blocked by large stones back when the mine was sealed. Looks like you'll have to borrow the power of the Mountainator this time...
quests.description_chs: 如果要进入层岩巨渊的更深处，就不得不打开在封矿之时被巨石填塞的道路，看来，这次不得不借助「开山炮」的力量了…

quests.title: Perils in the Dark
quests.description: The strange crystal plummeted toward the ground and shattered it, revealing an entrance to even greater depths. Who knows what's down there... But either way, it would be best to proceed with caution.
quests.description_chs: 奇怪的晶石向下掉落，砸碎地面，出现了前往更深处区域的入口，不知更深处究竟有什么，还是保持警惕继续往前吧…

quests.title: Surreptitious Seven-Star Seal Sundering
quests.description: You have accepted a commission that requires you to pay The Chasm a visit. Who knows what the situation in the long-sealed mines might be like...
quests.description_chs: 接到了需要前往层岩巨渊进行的委托，不知封锁已久的层岩巨渊会是什么情况…

quests.title: Wherefore Did the Spiritstone Descend?
quests.description: Having taken out the Abyss Lectors lurking here, you discover that Zhiqiong has seen the symbols on the key-like object the Lectors left behind somewhere else...
quests.description_chs: 解决出现在此处的深渊咏者之后，遗留下了类似钥匙的事物，志琼曾看过与钥匙上的花纹类似的纹路？

quests.title_chs: (test)(隐藏)层岩巨渊驻军控制任务$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Chasm Charters
quests.description: Lan of the Adventurers' Guild has offered you a commission to explore The Chasm, which you have accepted. First, you'll need to find the representative of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, Muning, who has been stationed there.
quests.description_chs: 在冒险家协会的「岚姐」处接受了探索「层岩巨渊」的委托。首先，得去找到总务司派驻层岩巨渊的专员「沐宁」才行。

quests.title: The Chasm Charters
quests.description: You accept Xu's commission to deliver the Mora Xingqiu has lent out to the Ministry of Civil Affairs' specialist, Muning, at The Chasm.
quests.description_chs: 接受了阿旭的委托，要将行秋借出的钱交给在「层岩巨渊」的总务司专员「沐宁」。

quests.title: Mycological Investigation in The Chasm
quests.description: The Chasm has a complex ecological and geological system. One of the most curious things here is the glowing mushrooms. Help the Sumeru scholar Khedive to investigate the mushrooms that grow in The Chasm...
quests.description_chs: 层岩巨渊有许多奇异的生态环境和地质环境，其中尤为特殊的就是生长在层岩的荧光蘑菇，帮助须弥学者海迪夫调查一下此处的蘑菇吧…

quests.title: Hydrological Investigation in The Chasm
quests.description: You fish up something strange in The Chasm. What in the world could it be? According to the Sumeru scholar Khedive, just place it by the water and you will discover its secret...
quests.description_chs: 从层岩巨渊中钓出了奇怪的物件，究竟是什么呢，交由须弥学者海迪夫调查后，说要放到水边激活才可知道其真相…

quests.title: Paleontological Investigation in The Chasm
quests.description: You notice some rocks with peculiar markings on them. It's better to take a few pictures. Perhaps someone might know what these are...
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊看到了纹路奇怪的岩石，不如先拍下来，不知道有没有人知道这是什么…
隐藏任务对话海迪夫$HIDDEN

quests.title: Undetected Infiltration
quests.description: The Treasure Hoarders who were behaving oddly turned out to be Millelith in disguise. In response to the resultant situation, their leader asks for your aid in taking out the Treasure Hoarder camps...
quests.description_chs: 行迹奇怪的盗宝团原来是千岩军所假扮，千岩军顺势委托你们，不如一同前去盗宝团的营地剿匪…

quests.title: The Chasm's Bounty
quests.description: A Liyue miner named Qi Ding has somehow gone missing. Seeing as how The Chasm is a perilous place, you decide to help look for him.
quests.description_chs: 璃月的矿工戚定，不知道为什么神秘失踪了，层岩巨渊危险，以防万一，还是帮忙找到矿工戚定的踪迹吧。
隐藏判断地脉树reminder$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Missing Miner
quests.description: Uncle He, a veteran miner at The Chasm, went missing when the mine was previously evacuated. But due to a series of coincidences, you unearth evidence that he may still be alive...
quests.description_chs: 老何是层岩巨渊的资深矿工，在上一次封矿的时候未能撤离，就此失踪。但在机缘巧合之下，似乎发现了他还活着的证据…

quests.title: Lost in a Foreign Land
quests.description: You run into a less-hostile Fatui mage in The Chasm. What is she doing here?
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊之下，遇到了敌意并没有那么强的愚人众术士，她到底为什么会出现在此处呢？

quests.title: Lost in a Foreign Land: Seeking
quests.description: You run into a Fatui mage named Katarina who is wandering alone in The Chasm. What is she doing here? Ask her what's going on.
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊之下，遇到了独自游荡的愚人众术士卡塔琳娜，她似乎是为了什么目的而在层岩巨渊徘徊，去问问她究竟是为了什么事吧。
隐藏卡了琳娜失踪$HIDDEN

quests.title: Dimming Mushroom's Call for Help
quests.description: You hear strange sounds — voices, almost — coming from a giant mushroom in The Chasm. Could it be... a giant talking mushroom?
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊的巨大蘑菇旁边，居然听到了奇异的声音发出的对话，说话的…难道是巨大的蘑菇？

quests.title: A Company Vanishing Into the Deep
quests.description: You encounter a group of Fatui who have lost contact with their troops on the ground. But they don't seem combat able at all and even ask for your help...
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊竟然发现了一队与地面失联已久的愚人众，可这队愚人众似乎已经没有什么战斗能力，甚至还向你求助…

quests.title: A Cliff-Side Hero's Past
quests.description: A Treasure Hoarder at the top of The Chasm claims to be from the Guhua Clan. Is he crazy, or is he just lost? Or is there some other secret that lies behind this situation?
quests.description_chs: 一位站在层岩巨渊最高处的前盗宝团成员，竟自称古华派传人，是精神的失常还是人心的沦丧，难道其中还藏有什么隐情…

quests.title: The Millennial Mountains
quests.description: According to a local legend at The Chasm, one may be able to obtain the "treasure of the Millelith" by offering six items before a memorial.
quests.description_chs: 根据层岩巨渊本地流传的故事，找到六样供物在纪念石前进行供奉，说不定就能获得「千岩军的宝藏」…

quests.description: The bard Taliesin seeks your help. As it turns out, the ring that he stole from the Weasel Thieves has been stolen once again by another bunch of Weasel Thieves...
quests.description_chs: 吟游诗人塔列辛向你求助，原来是他从盗宝鼬窝里取得的戒指又被盗宝鼬偷走了…

quests.title: Floating Spirits — The Investigation Begins
quests.description: Recently, more and more adventurers have encountered a floating elemental being. Inazuma City's Katheryne is releasing a series of commissions to minimize needless risks and lay the groundwork for further investigation.
quests.description_chs: 最近，越来越多的冒险家在野外遭遇了一种飘浮在空中的元素生物。为了防范风险和进行深入研究，稻妻城的凯瑟琳正在发布一系列的委托。

quests.title: Floating Spirits — The Investigation Ends
quests.description: After a period of investigation, the Adventurers' Guild has eliminated the possible threats that the Specter incident may have caused, and they have also collected a lot of related information. This information has already been handed over to professional researchers, and it seems likely that they will soon make some further progress.
quests.description_chs: 经过一段时间的调查，冒险家协会已经排除了「飘浮灵」事件可能存在的风险，也收集到了很多相关情报。这些情报已经转交给专业的学者，相信他们在不久以后就会有新的研究进展吧。

quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的凯瑟琳似乎有什么事找你…

quests.title: A Visitor From Westward Realms
quests.description: A person from Sumeru has arrived at the wharfs of Liyue Harbor. She seems to be in a bit of a fix...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的码头上来了位须弥人，她似乎遇到了一些困难…

quests.title: Vibro-Crystal Projections
quests.description: A certain researcher from Fontaine is currently performing some esoteric research in The Chasm.
quests.description_chs: 某位枫丹的科研专家似乎正在层岩巨渊进行着深奥的研究…

quests.title: Search Chronicle: Burning Up!
quests.description: You receive a very strange commission. Go to the area around the Pyro Regisvine to learn more from the client.
quests.description_chs: 接到了一件奇怪的委托，到爆炎树附近找到委托人了解详情吧。

quests.title: Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp!
quests.title_chs: 荒泷甲光烈烈斗虫大修行！
quests.description: Your diet has been quite plain recently, and Paimon's been missing the spice of life in food...\nAs such, you head over to Wanmin Restaurant, only to meet two old friends...
quests.description_chs: 最近你们的饮食较为清淡，派蒙开始想念香辣的料理…\n因此，你们前往了万民堂，却意外遇见了两位老朋友…

quests.title: Search Chronicle: Cold, Round Belly!
quests.description: After the Pyro Regisvine, Ranjit's next target is a Primo Geovishap...
quests.description_chs: 在爆炎树之后，兰吉特的下一个挑战目标是古岩龙蜥…

quests.title: Our Animal Friends
quests.description: The Feiyun Guild is on the move, taking on social responsibilities and promoting harmonious symbiosis between humanity and nature!
quests.description_chs: 承担社会责任，促进人与自然和谐共生，「飞云商会」在行动！

quests.title: Our Animal Friends: Epilogue
quests.description: The Claw Convoy animal rescue society's gift-swapping event has ended. Zhenchen is sorting through the gifts that the society has received...
quests.description_chs: 「伴爪同行」动物救助会的礼物交换活动已经结束了，振尘正在整理救助会收到的礼物…

quests.title: Tumult Subduer
quests.description: The Adventurers' Guild has reported strange activity in Liyue's Sal Terrae, and the Millelith have sealed the area off. Sensing danger, you and Paimon decide to head over to investigate...
quests.description_chs: 冒险家协会捎来情报，璃月的地中之盐一带似乎发生了某种异动，千岩军已将现场封锁，你与派蒙打算前往现场一探究竟…

quests.title: A Defensive Strategy
quests.description: Having successfully ventured into the Ley Line disturbance's hidden Domain and emerged victorious from its trials, it's time to report back to Keqing and Yelan...
quests.description_chs: 成功造访了地脉紊乱点通向的秘境，并在其中经历了一番战斗，是时候向刻晴和夜兰回报情况了…

quests.title: The Moonlit Adeptus's Trail
quests.description: You run into someone who loves listening to stories in Liyue Harbor...
quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里，你遇见了一个很爱听书的人…

quests.title: Vigorous Brushstrokes

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里，你遇见了一个帮人作画的人…

quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里，你看见了一个奇特的游艺摊位…

quests.description: Atop Mt. Aocang, you find traces of an adeptus...
quests.description_chs: 奥藏山上，仙迹缥缈…

quests.title: The Adventurers' Guild's Affairs
quests.title_chs: 冒险家协会的诸多事宜
quests.description: Lan seems to be fretting over some of the commissions that the Adventurers' Guild has undertaken...
quests.description_chs: 岚姐似乎正因为冒险家协会承接的一些委托而发愁…

quests.title: Necessary Procedures
quests.description: The storm in Liyue Harbor has passed, and all aspects of life within the city are slowly undergoing changes... For Ivanovich, this means working hard to adapt to said changes...
quests.description_chs: 在璃月港的风波过去后，城里的一切事情似乎都在慢慢发生变化…而伊凡诺维奇先生，正在努力让自己适应这种变化…

quests.title: Words Worth Their Weight in Mora
quests.description: The recent crisis that beset Liyue Harbor has reinvigorated interest in history. Wanwen Bookhouse has seen a resurgence in business as a result, and its owner Jifang is on the verge of being overwhelmed...
quests.description_chs: 在璃月港的那场风波过去后，璃月人对历史的兴趣突然浓厚了起来。「万文集舍」的生意十分红火，纪芳都有些应付不过来了…

quests.title: Changchang's Little Friend
quests.description: Changchang from Liyue Harbor is looking for someone to get some food for a little puppy...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的小女孩畅畅想找个人帮忙给一只小狗喂点吃的…

quests.title: The Secret of Nantianmen
quests.description: Jiayi from Liyue Harbor has gotten himself tangled up in more troublesome affairs, and is looking for some help...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的嘉义似乎又陷入了麻烦之中，正想找人帮忙…

quests.title: An Ode to Yonder City
quests.description: Liyue's crisis has settled down, but it has brought a wave of change to the city. The poet Qingzhou would like to capture these shifts in verse...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港的那场风波虽然平息了，但那场风波也让璃月港开始了变化。诗人清昼正试图用自己的诗来捕捉这种变化…

quests.title: Endless Research
quests.description: You meet Alrani, whom you once saved from a cage, in Liyue Harbor. She still seems to want to investigate something...
quests.description_chs: 在璃月港里再次和那位曾经被关在笼子里的学者爱拉尼相遇了，她似乎还想研究什么东西…

quests.title: Snapshots
quests.description: Xu of the Feiyun Commerce Guild is currently puzzling over a device known as a Kamera...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港飞云商会的阿旭正在为了一架名叫「留影机」的机器而苦恼…

quests.title: Tianqiu Treasure Trail
quests.description: Lan of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers' Guild seems to be troubled by something...
quests.description_chs: 璃月港冒险家协会的岚姐似乎正在为了什么事而烦恼着…

quests.title: Return of the Jade Chamber?
quests.description: You learn from a Millelith named Kun that there are plans to rebuild the previously destroyed Jade Chamber and that some small preparations to that end are already taking place...
quests.description_chs: 从千岩军大坤那边意外听说，之前毁掉的群玉阁似乎有重建的计划，一些小物件已经开始了筹备…

quests.title: Fishing For Jade
quests.description: In the aftermath of the collision between the Jade Chamber and That Which Lies in the Deep, the sea remains dotted with floating fragments of the Jade Chamber. The Millelith soldier Kun is currently looking for help with the cleanup work...
quests.description_chs: 在群玉阁撞击了那个海里的东西后，海上还零星地飘着群玉阁的碎片，千岩军大坤正在找人来清理这些碎片…

quests.title: Guests in Qingce
quests.description: Wang'ya has something to say to you at Wangshu Inn...
quests.description_chs: 在望舒客栈的望雅小姐似乎有话想对你说…

quests.title: Lantern of the Wayfarer
quests.description: While most people from Liyue are enjoying the Lantern Rite, guard-for-hire Huangshan is currently in a bit of a fix...
quests.description_chs: 大多数璃月人都在享受海灯节，镖师黄衫却正在发愁…

quests.title: Yanxiao's Crazy Kitchen
quests.description: Smiley Yanxiao from Wangshu Inn seems to be struggling with his workload during the Lantern Rite...
quests.description_chs: 海灯节期间，望舒客栈里的工作让言笑有些不堪重负…

quests.description_chs: 璃月港的望雅似乎正在因为某事而烦恼着…

quests.description_chs: 望舒客栈的菲尔戈黛特似乎正因为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Where the Light Wanes

quests.description_chs: 在大家抬头仰望霄灯漫天的美丽景象时，千岩军宏宇却在头疼…

quests.title: When Scholar and Legends Meet

quests.description_chs: 学者索拉雅似乎正在天衡山中调查什么事…

quests.description_chs: 佳节已至，轻策庄的阿芷却在为药材的问题而烦恼…

quests.title: Promises Remembered as Lanterns Rise
quests.description: Wangshu Inn's chef, Smiley Yanxiao, seems to have a lot on his plate right now...
quests.description_chs: 望舒客栈的言笑似乎正忙得不可开交…

quests.title: Cleansing Defilement
quests.description: Hanachirusato says that in order to complete the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual, one must break the barrier in 5 places and destroy the "defilement incarnate" that will then come forth. Besides Konda Village and the abandoned shrine, there are three other places where the barrier surrounds the Thunder Sakura roots: Chinju Forest, Araumi, and below the tidal flats outside the Kamisato Estate. She says that she will await you at the Thunder Sakura root below the well in Konda Village.
quests.description_chs: 依照花散里的说法，要完成「神樱大祓」，就必须破解结界五处，并清除被逼出来的「污秽的化身」。除了绀田村与那间荒废神社，另外三处结界与雷樱树根分别位于：镇守之森、荒海、以及神里屋敷之外的滩涂地下。在这期间，她似乎会在绀田村井下的树根处待命。

quests.title_chs: 神社占卜假扮巫女常驻（test）$HIDDEN

quests.title: Yougou Cleansing
quests.description: The five barriers have been broken and the evil within has been purged. Time to report back to Hanachirusato at the Thunder Sakura root beneath the well in Konda Village.
quests.description_chs: 五处结界已经破除，其中的妖物也被肃清。是时候前往绀田村井下的雷樱树根处，向花散里复命了。

quests.title: A Strange Story in Konda
quests.description: A mysterious, masked shrine maiden is by the strange fox statue, seemingly with something to request of you...
quests.description_chs: 在奇异的狐狸雕像前，戴着面具的神秘巫女似乎有事相求…

quests.title: Sacrificial Offering
quests.description: According to Hanachirusato, these barriers must be broken to cleanse the Thunder Sakura's roots. The next barrier seems to be located in the abandoned shrine to the northeast of Konda Village. Although the place sounds quite unsettling indeed, this is Hanachirusato's request, so it is best that you see it done.
quests.description_chs: 根据花散里的说法，破除这些结界是「净化」雷樱树根所必需的。下一处结界似乎就在绀田村东北方的荒废神社中。虽然听起来是令人颇为不安的地方，但既然是花散里拜托的事情，那就去看看好了。

quests.title: Tanuki-Bayashi in the Forest
quests.description: You learn that an old friend of Hanachirusato's can be found in Chinju Forest. Perhaps they might be able to help out with the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. But while in the forest, you hear a strange shout.
quests.description_chs: 在镇守之森，似乎有一位花散里的「老朋友」，应当能为「神樱大祓」提供帮助。但在其中，听到了奇异的呼叫声。

quests.title: Tatara Tales
quests.description: Something ominous seems to have occurred at Inazuma's Tatarasuna...
quests.description_chs: 在稻妻的踏鞴砂上，似乎发生了一件不太妙的事…

quests.description: The shrine maiden Miyuki is currently having a massive headache over the abnormal state of the Thunder Sakura in Kannazuka...
quests.description_chs: 巫女阿幸正在为神无冢上雷樱树的异状而头痛…

quests.title: Dreams of Sword Art
quests.description: A nameless samurai stands atop the windy sea cliffs, seemingly searching for something...
quests.description_chs: 海风吹拂的山崖之上矗立着一位无名的武士，似乎在寻找着什么…

quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part I
quests.description: A rock pillar stands sentinel at Musoujin Gorge, waiting silently for someone to come to repair it...
quests.description_chs: 一座磐柱静静伫立在无想刃狭间旁，默默等待着修补者的出现…

quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part II
quests.description: A rock pillar stands sentinel at the Serpent's Head, waiting silently for someone to come to repair it...
quests.description_chs: 一座磐柱静静伫立在蛇神之首，默默等待着修补者的出现…

quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part III
quests.description: The ward at the Jakotsu Mine has been damaged. It awaits your urgent repair.
quests.description_chs: 蛇骨矿洞的镇物亦遭破坏，亟需旅行者前去修复。

quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part V
quests.description: The ancient ruins of what is now called Fort Mumei rises slowly from beneath the waves. Amidst the cries of whales and waves, you can hear a hidden, ancient grudge...
quests.description_chs: 被称为「无明砦」的古城遗迹缓缓升出海面，鲸声浪迹之中隐藏着古老幽深的怨念…

quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Prologue
quests.description: Yashiori Island is deep in the throes of the Tatarigami's effects. Still, a miner named Kaji remains on the island, seemingly searching for a way to inhibit the corruption's proliferation...
quests.description_chs: 八酝岛深为「祟神」所困，仍然留在岛上的矿工梶先生似乎正在寻找抑制其增生的方法…

quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part IV
quests.description: Head to the agreed-upon location and report back to Kaji.
quests.description_chs: 前往约好的地点，向梶回报情况吧。

quests.title: Treatment on the Island
quests.description: The traveling doctor Yasumoto is currently wandering Yashiori Island, urgently seeking outside help...
quests.description_chs: 游医保本正在八酝岛上彷徨，似乎急需外界的帮助…
已经过去了许多天，不知保本的疗法研究是否有了效果…？$HIDDEN

quests.title: Gazing Three Thousand Miles Away
quests.description: Chouji, a young land selling ore on Yashiori Island, seems to be hiding an unfathomable secret...
quests.description_chs: 在八酝岛上叫卖矿物的小男孩长次，似乎怀着某些深沉难言的秘密…

quests.title: Hiromi's Watch
quests.description: Commission Officer Hiromi seems to be vexed about something. Perhaps he could use some help...
quests.description_chs: 役人广海似乎在烦恼着什么，或许正需要人去帮忙…

quests.title: Divine Plant of the Depths
quests.description: Does ancient plant life from the ocean's depths really have the wondrous power to indicate one's destiny?
quests.description_chs: 海渊的孑遗花草，竟拥有预示命运的奇妙功效？

quests.title: Solitary Sea-Beast
quests.description: Lost friends, extinct sea creatures... Is this a sad reminiscence, or the beginning of a new life?
quests.description_chs: 逝去的好友，绝迹的海兽…是悲伤的回顾，或是新生的开始？

quests.title: In Another Land
quests.description: The researcher from Sumeru, Alrani, seems to have come up with a new idea for her thesis...
quests.description_chs: 来自须弥的学者爱拉尼小姐似乎又想到了一个全新的论文主题…

quests.title: "The Seventh Samurai"
quests.description: Xavier seems to be bothered by a certain matter...
quests.description_chs: 泽维尔似乎正在为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Seirai Stormchasers: Part I
quests.description: You learn from Inazuma's Katheryne that the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild has been gathering adventurers to explore Seirai Island recently...
quests.description_chs: 从稻妻冒险家协会的凯瑟琳小姐那里，你得知稻妻冒险家协会最近正在招募冒险家前往清籁岛进行探索…

quests.title: Seirai Stormchasers: Part II
quests.description: After arriving on Seirai island, you meet two adventurers who are currently investigating something known as a Warding Stone. But following the footprints of a cat, you arrive at a dilapidated shrine, in which sits a cat named "Neko," who proclaims itself to be the "provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine." After you help "Neko" repair the shrine's Offering Box, it reveals the method of sealing the Warding Stones to you. Additionally, you learn that should you be able to seal all four Warding Stones throughout Seirai Island, you can calm the thunderstorm that enshrouds it.
quests.description_chs: 来到清籁岛后，你遇见了两位冒险家，他们似乎正在研究一种叫做「镇石」的东西。但跟随着猫的足迹，你来到了一座破败的神社，里面有一只自称「浅濑神社代宫司」，名叫「寝子」的猫。在帮助「寝子」修好了神社中的「塞钱箱」以后，它将封印「镇石」的方法告诉了你。而且，如果能将这座清籁岛上的四座「镇石」全部封印的话，说不定就能平息清籁岛上的雷暴…

quests.description_chs: 名椎滩的破船上躲藏着一位沉默的伤兵，似乎已与战事稍歇的八酝岛及其上百千悲剧融于一体…

quests.description_chs: 鸣神岛的梢需要十份铁块。

quests.title: Matsumoto's Fried Egg Fracas
quests.description: Narukami Island's Matsumoto would like to have 5 servings of Teyvat Fried Egg.
quests.description_chs: 鸣神岛的松本想要五份提瓦特煎蛋。

quests.title: Yata Kouki's Order of Ore
quests.title_chs: 矢田幸喜的白铁块需求
quests.description: Narukami Island's Yata Kouki requests 5 White Iron Chunks.
quests.description_chs: 鸣神岛上的矢田幸喜想要五份白铁块。

quests.title: Versus Mishima Michitoshi
quests.description: Here he comes — the samurai whose thoughts no one can really fathom, Mishima Michitoshi!
quests.description_chs: 摸不清他在想什么的奇怪武士，三岛道世，他…他直接攻过来了！

quests.title: Versus Taroumaru
quests.description: The one who comes now is your most formidable opponent — and he is none other than Taroumaru, boss of Komore Teahouse!
quests.description_chs: 来者乃是最终亦是最强的对手，木漏茶室老板——太郎丸是也！

quests.description: It's been a while since the last Hyakunin Ikki. Kayabuki shows up again in Inazuma...
quests.description_chs: 距离上次的「百人一揆」结束已经有一段时间了，而茅葺再次出现在了稻妻城里…

quests.title: Akitsu Yuugei
quests.description: Both Ei and Heizou mentioned this mysterious game. Go to the beach and check it out.
quests.description_chs: 影和平藏都提到了这种神秘的游戏，去海滩上看看吧。

quests.title: Dreamlike
quests.description: After experiencing the Akitsu Yuugei, a mysterious doorway suddenly appeared nearby...
quests.description_chs: 体验过秋津游艺之后，附近突然出现了一道神秘的门…

quests.title: Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl!
quests.title_chs: 荒泷极意堂堂斗虫大试合！
quests.description: You and Paimon have been feeling pretty good recently, so you're thinking about taking on some more commissions from the Adventurers' Guild! Little did you expect, however, to run into some Arataki Gang members openly scheming nearby...
quests.description_chs: 最近你和派蒙的状态特别不错，打算多多接取冒险家协会的委托！可在冒险家协会附近，你们却遇到了正在大声密谋的荒泷派…

quests.title: The Beetle Battles Will Never End!
quests.description: The Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl appears to have been a great success, and it's now time to return to the brawl grounds to check on Arataki Itto and Grandmaster Hanakado...
quests.description_chs: 「荒泷极意堂堂斗虫大试合」举办得似乎相当成功，是时候回到场地，看看荒泷一斗和「花角玉将」切磋得怎么样了…

quests.title: Travelers' Tales: Destiny Drawn
quests.description: Something new seems to be happening at the Grand Narukami Shrine...
quests.description_chs: 稻妻鸣神大社，似乎发生了一些新鲜事…

quests.title: The Gourmet Supremos: On the Road
quests.description: Xudong, the self-proclaimed leader of the Gourmet Supremos, seems to have something he'd like some help with...
quests.description_chs: 自称「全能美食队」领队的旭东似乎有事想找人帮忙…

quests.title: International Travel Log
quests.description: Midori from Inazuma City seems to be troubled by something...
quests.description_chs: 稻妻城里的小绿似乎正为什么事而烦恼…

quests.title: Home Lies Over the Ocean
quests.description: Atsuko, who is living in Liyue, seems to have something on her mind...
quests.description_chs: 在璃月的竺子似乎正在为了什么事情而烦恼…

quests.title: O Archon, Have I Done Right?
quests.description: The shrine that Shouta has been giving sincere offerings to has stopped giving him replies. He seeks you out for help...
quests.description_chs: 翔太诚心供奉的神龛突然不再给他回应，他正寻求着旅行者帮助…

quests.title: Battle of Revenge
quests.description: Asukara has discovered the Kairagi's whereabouts. The time has come for a rematch to reclaim his weapon...
quests.description_chs: 朝仓追查到了海乱鬼的行踪，讨伐海乱鬼，夺回武器的时机到了…

quests.title: Yae Publishing House's Invitation
quests.description: Aratani, an editor at the Yae Publishing House, seems to have something she'd like a little help with...
quests.description_chs: 「八重堂」的编辑荒谷似乎有什么事想要找人帮忙…

quests.title: Chisato's Letter
quests.description: Chisato, lady of the Hiiragi Clan, which leads the Kanjou Commission, requests that you help her bring a letter to her sweetheart, Kujou Kamaji...
quests.description_chs: 勘定奉行柊家的大小姐柊千里想拜托你把一封信送给她的心上人九条镰治…

quests.title: Katheryne in Inazuma
quests.description: According to Katheryne in Liyue Harbor, you will be able to find her on Narukami Island as well...
quests.description_chs: 据璃月港的凯瑟琳小姐说，在稻妻的鸣神岛上，你们似乎还能见到她…

quests.title: The Ritou Road
quests.description: You happen upon a hidden passageway in Ritou...
quests.description_chs: 在离岛中，你偶然发现了一条隐秘的通道…

quests.title: Storytelling Method
quests.description: Junkichi seems to be struggling with his writing again...
quests.description_chs: 顺吉似乎又在因为创作的事而苦恼…

quests.title: Fertilizer... Salesperson?
quests.description: Iwata of Watatsumi Island appears to be having some troubles...
quests.description_chs: 海祇岛的岩田似乎正在因为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Vimana Agama: First Chapter
quests.description: You heard from Araja that the Aranara were investigating a suspicious Nara near Devantaka Mountain. You wonder if it has anything to do with the missing kids at Vimara Village...
quests.description_chs: 从兰拉迦那里听说有兰那罗在降诸魔山附近调查可疑的「那菈」，不知道会不会和维摩庄孩子失踪的事情有关…

quests.title: The Children of Vimara Village
quests.description: The woman who goes by the name of Rana seems to be a Forest Watcher of Sumeru. Accept her invitation and travel to Vimara Village.
quests.description_chs: 名叫拉娜的女性似乎是须弥的巡林官。应她的邀请，去「维摩庄」看看吧。

quests.title: Into the Woods
quests.description: You and Paimon put in a good amount of hard work to sort your stories into a version that the children might find interesting. Thankfully, they like your stories. Although they don't seem to have told the truth about the mysterious creatures, this isn't the time to go into detail. Now, go with Rana to clear out some Withering Zones. You're doing this so the children of Vimara Village can play safely, after all.
quests.description_chs: 为了将想到的事情整理成能让孩子们也觉得有趣的版本，和派蒙一起费了不少功夫。孩子们对故事满意，真是太好了。虽然孩子们对「神秘生物」的态度十分可疑，不过目前也无法太过深究。接下来，就随拉娜一同去清理一些死域吧。再怎么说，也是为了让维摩庄的孩子们能安全地玩耍。

quests.title: The Lost Child
quests.description: You have taken care of the Withering Zones marked by Rana as well as the Spinocrocodiles. The children at Vimara Village should be safe now. Head back with Rana.
quests.description_chs: 拉娜标记的死域也清理了，棘冠鳄的问题也处理了。这下应该不用担心维摩庄的孩子们了。与拉娜一同回去吧。
