quests.title: A Delicacy for Nara
quests.description: According to Arapacati, the rising pillars of smoke will lead to her brothers who are doing "cooking training." We need to find them and bring them back before the festival starts...
quests.description_chs: 根据兰帕卡提所说，看到袅袅升起的烟柱，就能找到她在外进行「烹饪修行」的哥哥们，得在无忧节开始前，把他们找回来才行…

quests.title: Varuna Gatha
quests.description: A few Aranara in Apam Woods could use some help...
quests.description_chs: 水天丛林有兰那罗需要帮助…

quests.title: Memory of Stone
quests.description: Aranakula, who is said to be rather timid, has gone to the Yasna Monument, which is flooded with dangerous Fungi. Aranakula has seldom been left alone without the company of soil and seeds, so the poor little thing must need help now...
quests.description_chs: 据说有些胆小的兰那库拉去了谒颂幽境，那里有危险的蕈兽四处游荡，习惯了和泥土、种子为伴的兰那库拉一定需要帮助…

quests.title: Irate Iron Chunk
quests.description: Inarticulate Arabalika is exploring the Ruins of Dahri, where "Big Iron Chunks" abound, alone. Though he is a master of Ararakalari, it may be better to check in on him...
quests.description_chs: 荼诃之座有许多「大铁块」，寡言的兰百梨迦孤身深入此地，虽说他精通「兰迦拉梨」，不过还是去看看他的情况吧…

quests.title: Slumbering Roots
quests.description: Arakunti has headed to the Grove of Dreams, where a way to enter dreams is said to reside. However, the twisting roots of the great tree make finding Aranara — or anything else there really — a taxing task and then some...
quests.description_chs: 兰贡迪去了梦景林莽，据说那里有梦的入口，大树的根系层叠盘曲，这样的地方无论找兰那罗还是找东西可都不容易…

quests.title: A Prayer for Rain on the Fecund Land
quests.title_chs: 膏腴土地下的唤雨之曲
quests.description: The "branches and leaves" of the Varuna Contraption that were scattered in Vana were all healed. In Arapandu's words, it's time to get rid of the bad bugs gnawing on the roots of the Varuna Contraption...
quests.description_chs: 四散在桓那的法留纳神机的「枝」与「叶」都已治好，按兰般度的说法，终于可以去清除啃噬法留纳神机的根系的坏虫了…

quests.title: Cooking, a Pleasant Memory
quests.description: According to Arachatora, his brother Arasaka is doing "cooking training" near Gandharva Ville. Look for a pillar of smoke near Gandharva Ville!
quests.description_chs: 根据兰茶荼的说法，他的兄弟兰萨卡在化城郭附近进行「烹饪修行」，在化城郭附近寻找烟柱袅袅升起之处吧！

quests.title: Cooking, the Flavor of Nature
quests.description: You received a commission from Arapacati in Vanarana to help look for her brothers who are practicing cooking. Do as Arapacati says and look for the rising pillars of smoke.
quests.description_chs: 在桓那兰那接到了兰帕卡提的委托，帮忙寻找进行料理修行的哥哥们，就按兰帕卡提所说，寻找袅袅升起的烟柱吧。

quests.title: Cooking, the Aroma of Homecoming
quests.description: According to Arachatora, his brother Arapas is doing "cooking training" close to Apam Woods. Look for a pillar of smoke near Apam Woods!
quests.description_chs: 根据兰茶荼的说法，他的兄弟兰阿帕斯在水天丛林附近进行「烹饪修行」，在水天丛林附近寻找烟柱袅袅升起之处吧！

quests.title: Cooking, the Beauty of Sharing
quests.description: According to Arachatora, his brother Araphala is doing "cooking training" close by Devantaka Mountain. Look for a pillar of smoke near Devantaka Mountain!
quests.description_chs: 根据兰茶荼的说法，他的兄弟兰非拉在降诸魔山附近进行「烹饪修行」，在降诸魔山附近寻找烟柱袅袅升起之处吧！

quests.title: A Short Encounter with a Rare Bird
quests.title_chs: 与珍稀之鸟的短暂邂逅
quests.description: You bumped into a Forest Ranger, Shefket, who's carrying out ecological research in Sumeru's forests, and he told you about his Dusk Bird research. Can he really capture a Dusk Bird?
quests.description_chs: 在须弥的森林里碰到了调查生态的巡林员谢夫凯特，之后据说会进行「暝彩鸟」的调查，他真的能成功抓到暝彩鸟吗？

quests.title: Woodland Encounter
quests.description: Someone is being attacked by Fungi in the woods. You hurry to help them.
quests.description_chs: 在林间道路上，见到了一位被蕈兽攻击的人。无论如何，不能放着遇到困难的人不管。

quests.title: The World of Aranara
quests.description: Finally, you meet the mysterious Aranara again. According to Arana, you need to visit Vanarana and find Bija to help Rana. Moreover, you have to play the Rhythm of the Great Dream before getting to the world of Aranara. Head back to Vimara Village, and ask Amadhiah if he has any instrument that you can borrow.
quests.description_chs: 终于再次见到了神秘的「兰那罗」。按照兰拉娜的说法，要帮助拉娜，需要前往「桓那兰那」，取得惟耶之实。而进入兰那罗的世界，需要奏响「大梦的曲调」。回维摩庄，看看阿玛兹亚爷爷有没有可以出借的乐器吧。

quests.title: Vimana Agama: Jazari's Chapter
quests.description: You were finally able to get inside the Ruin Golem. If it can be activated, gaining access to the underground ruins should be a simple matter...
quests.description_chs: 终于可以进入「遗迹巨像」中一探究竟了。如果能够启动这台「遗迹巨像」的话，一定可以轻而易举地打开通往地下遗迹的入口…

quests.title: Vimana Agama: Dev Delver Chapter
quests.description: Somehow, you managed to open the entrance to the underground ruins. Once you find the core in the Dev's Cavern, the truth about the forest's "disease" will be unveiled...
quests.description_chs: 误打误撞总算是打开了通往地下遗迹的入口。只要找到迪弗旧窟中的核心，就能弄清森林之「病」的真相…

quests.title: Royinjan's Chapter: Linga
quests.description: You've located the fragments with the help of Amadhiah and Royinjan. One of them lies in a submerged cavern...
quests.description_chs: 在罗因贾和阿玛兹亚的帮助下，获知了机关碎片的所在地。其中之一就藏在被水淹没的洞窟之下…

quests.title: Royinjan's Chapter: Yoni
quests.description: You have located the fragments with the help of Amadhiah and Royinjan. One of them lies in a cavern deep within Devantaka Mountain...
quests.description_chs: 在罗因贾和阿玛兹亚的帮助下，获知了机关碎片的所在地。其中之一就藏在降诸魔山深处的洞穴中…
(test)神秘的羊皮卷$HIDDEN

quests.title: For A Better Reunion
quests.description: After all the adventures with the Aranara in the forest, we are getting closer to Bija... Right? Anyway, let's check on Rana first.
quests.description_chs: 与森林中的兰那罗们经历了诸多冒险之后，离取得惟耶之实也越来越近了…？无论如何，去看看拉娜的情况吧。

quests.title: Festival Utsava
quests.description: You returned to Vanarana with Arama after parting with Arana and Rana. It's finally time for Festival Utsava.
quests.description_chs: 与兰拉娜、拉娜告别后，随兰罗摩一同回到了桓那兰那。无忧节终于开始了。

quests.title: Children of the Forest
quests.description: To acquire Bija and help Rana, you have to find and help Aranara, and prepare for Festival Utsava. As for the Aranyaka from Arama, it could be used to document the stories about Aranara, and clues for the adventure.
quests.description_chs: 为了结出惟耶之实、帮助拉娜，需要找到、帮助兰那罗们，为「无忧节」做准备。从兰罗摩手中得到的「森林书」，就用来记录与兰那罗的故事，以及冒险的线索吧。
在柯莱的小屋里，你发现了一盆花。但这盆花的状态似乎有些不太好…$HIDDEN

quests.title: For Fruits, Seeds, and Trees
quests.description: When you wake up, Festival Utsava is no more, and Arama is nowhere to be found. Only the faint fragrance from the garland tells you that this was not a dream.
quests.description_chs: 醒来之后，无忧节的景象已经从眼前消失，兰罗摩也不在身边。只有花环传来的细微香气提醒着这一切并不是梦。

quests.title: For the Children of the Past
quests.description: The Ashvattha Tree has been corroded. But from its fruit, Arama seems to have gained new knowledge, memories, and... manners of speech. According to Arama, you should eliminate Marana's Avatar next so that the new Ashvattha Tree may be born. Only then can the Bija be formed.
quests.description_chs: 「觉王树」已经被侵蚀了。但兰罗摩似乎通过结出的果实，获得了新的知识、记忆与…说话方式。接下来，依他的说法，应当要消灭「无留陀的化身」，让新的「觉王树」长出来。如此，才能结出惟耶之实。

quests.title: For All Children Who Long for Life
quests.title_chs: 为了一切向往生命的孩子们
quests.description: Now, only the final enemy awaits vanquishing. Continue forward. Never, ever, stop moving forward.
quests.description_chs: 接下来，只剩下最后应当消灭的敌人了。继续前进吧。要一直、一直前进下去。

quests.title: "Hello," "Thank You," and the Final "Goodbye"
quests.description: Finally, you claimed the Bija. It's time to return to Rana.
quests.description_chs: 终于得到了惟耶之实。是时候回去找拉娜了。

quests.title: Taste of Happiness
quests.description: Time to witness the results of the "cooking training" of Arapacati's brothers.
quests.description_chs: 到了验证兰帕卡提的「哥哥们」「烹饪修行」成果的时候了。

quests.title: Delicious Riddle
quests.description: The resourceful Araesha has prepared "delicious" riddles for Festival Utsava.
quests.description_chs: 知识渊博的兰伊舍为无忧节准备了「好吃」的谜语。

quests.title: Garden Fairies
quests.description: At Festival Utsava, Aralila and Aranishat seem to be fighting over something...
quests.description_chs: 无忧节上，兰梨娄和兰难世似乎在争论什么…

quests.title: Rishboland Tiger, Roaaar
quests.description: Seems that Arakanta wants to play Rishboland Tiger and Aranara.
quests.description_chs: 兰犍多似乎想要玩「长鬓虎」与「兰那罗」的游戏。
(test)隐藏对话仅做演示用$HIDDEN

quests.title: Rescue the Aranara
quests.description: Rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters
quests.description_chs: 解救被魔物包围的兰那罗

quests.title: Look for and rescue the Aranara
quests.description: Look for and rescue the Aranara surrounded by monsters
quests.description_chs: 寻找并解救被魔物包围的兰那罗

quests.title: The Foolish Fatuus
quests.description: There are several strange camps in the Sumeru forest, and each camp has a strange machine installed within. The Fatui seem to be using these machines to do something weird. It's best to investigate this matter...
quests.description_chs: 在须弥的森林里有诸多奇怪的营地，每个营地都安装着一个奇怪的机器，愚人众似乎在利用这些机器做什么奇怪的事，还是调查一下吧……
(test)死域观测站失落1$HIDDEN

quests.title: Lost in the Sands
quests.description: In Aaru Village, there is a merchant from Mondstadt who needs help from adventurers.
quests.description_chs: 在阿如村，有一个蒙德商人需要冒险家的帮助。

quests.title: An Introduction to Indoor Archaeology
quests.description: You have left the pit with the archaeological team. Now it is time to head over to the oasis Jebrael mentioned and get ready to camp there.
quests.description_chs: 和考古小队一行离开了陷坑，接下来该前往哲伯莱勒所说的绿洲，做露营的准备了。

quests.title: The Secret of Al-Ahmar
quests.description: Tirzad accidentally opened the hidden passage behind the mural. No one knows where it may lead...
quests.description_chs: 提尔扎德意外地打开了壁画之后隐藏的通路，不知道这条通路将会把我们带去哪里…

quests.title: Dreams Beneath the Searing Sand
quests.description: The merchants and their Sumpter Beasts waiting in the oasis might be in danger. Hurry back to the camp in the oasis to secure Nachtigal's safety.
quests.description_chs: 在绿洲留守的商人与驮兽可能遭遇危险，得赶快返回绿洲的营地确认纳赫蒂加尔的安危。

quests.title: Aranaga's Memory
quests.description: You meet an old man named Khayyam in the forest. He seems to share a past with Aranara. It should do no harm to respond to his request for help...
quests.description_chs: 你们在森林中遇到了一位名叫海亚姆的老人，他似乎曾与兰那罗们有着一段过往。不如回应他的求助…

quests.title: Aranakin's Old Friend
quests.description: After that last adventure, Aranakin really forgot a lot of things. No matter what, how could the new and old friends he made be forgotten so easily?
quests.description_chs: 在上次冒险结束后，兰纳真忘记了许多事情。但不管怎样，曾结识的新朋与旧友何尝那么容易忘怀呢？

quests.title: Aragaru's Drawing
quests.description: You helped Aragaru defeat the Eremites in Chatrakam Cave. Their goal, however, seems to be related to a friendship that Aragaru has forgotten...
quests.description_chs: 帮助兰迦鲁击败了盘踞在茸蕈窟中的镀金旅团，但镀金旅团的目的，似乎与兰迦鲁忘却的一段友情有关…

quests.title: Memory's Final Chapter
quests.description: Though lost memories flow by like water, friendships may be reborn with time...
quests.description_chs: 尽管失却的回忆如同流水般逝去不返，但友谊却随着时间得以新生…

quests.title: Until Vana is Healed
quests.description: You wonder how Ararycan is doing. Go find him when you have the time.
quests.description_chs: 不知道兰利遮现在怎么样了…有空的话去找找他吧。

quests.title: Courage Is in the Heart
quests.description: You found a journal by the Aranara named Arashakun in an Aranara house. Despite losing "courage," Arashakun still decided to venture into such a dangerous place. Go check the situation out...
quests.description_chs: 在兰那罗居住的房子里发现了名为兰沙恭的兰那罗写的笔记，但是那个兰沙恭不仅失去了「勇气」，还打算去危险的地方，还是去看看吧…
法留纳神机已经被治好，这下兰那库拉可以回去照料一直惦念着的苗圃了。喜欢与泥土和种子作伴的兰那库拉不仅会培育普通的植物，还在桓那兰那照料着一块特别的苗圃…$HIDDEN

quests.title: The Rhythm that Leads to the Gloomy Path
The Rhythm that Nurtures the Sprout
Giving Flowers
quests.description: There are so many Sweet Flowers in Vanarana's garden now. Varsha would be ecstatic to see it for herself for sure.
quests.description_chs: 桓那兰那的苗圃现在开满了甜甜花，如果法莎也能亲眼见到这一切，她也一定会很开心吧！

quests.title: Vimana Agama: Royinjan's Chapter
quests.description: To find the Amiti Device to open the Ruin Golem, you decided to follow Royinjan to a secret base in Vimara Village.
quests.description_chs: 为了寻找能打开「遗迹巨像」的「阿麦塔机关」，你决定跟随罗因贾前往维摩庄的「秘密基地」…

quests.title: The Rhythm that Reveals the Beastly Trail

quests.description_chs: (test)用来计数的任务,完成12个苗圃种植, 并且完成无忧节后可以和兰纳罗对话获取奖励$HIDDEN
根据枫丹的猎人「桑顿」所说，过度生长而又有领地意识的「凶猛动物」在居民区附近，对于居民和这些动物来说都是很危险的事。这些家伙分别是「长鬓虎罗阇」，「鳄鱼大王」和「驮兽大王」，找到他们的踪迹，并驱逐他们吧！$HIDDEN

quests.title: Legends of the Stone Lock
quests.description: After unlocking the stone lock in Sumeru, and defeating the monsters trapped in the seal, you will be entrusted by Aranara to defeat other sealed monsters.
quests.description_chs: 在须弥解开石头锁，解决封印中的怪物后，受出现的兰那罗委托，解决其他被锁住的怪物…

quests.title: Encounter in the Woods
quests.description: Talk to Arakavi in Vanarana, which might help the groundwork for Festival Utsava.
quests.description_chs: 与桓那兰那的兰加惟谈谈，或许对无忧节的准备有帮助。

quests.title: Dual Evidence
quests.description: While in Aaru Village, you meet another Vahumana researcher named Kalantari. He has been fretting over his paper lately and is seeking help...
quests.description_chs: 在阿如村遇见了与提尔扎德同属因论派的学者卡兰塔里…他似乎也在因为论文而苦恼万分，并试图向我们寻求帮助…

quests.title: Afratu's Dilemma
quests.description: Somewhere in the desert in front of a giant ruin machine, Mahamata Afratu seems to be troubled by something...
quests.description_chs: 在沙漠某处的巨大遗迹机关前，教令官阿弗拉图似乎在苦恼些什么…

quests.description: Paimon found a painting in Vanarana that could be a treasure map...
quests.description_chs: 在桓那兰那，派蒙找到了「说不定是藏宝图」的画像…

quests.title: Static Views, Part 2
quests.description: As more treasure was found through the "mailbox," the "seed" collected long ago in The Chasm begins to vibrate...
quests.description_chs: 通过「邮箱」的图画找到了更多的宝藏后，很久以前在层岩巨渊拾获的「种子」开始发出震颤…

quests.description_chs: 距离「永恒绿洲」只剩下了最后一段路途，希望不会有意外发生…

quests.description: Kayvan the angler seems to be having some trouble...
quests.description_chs: 渔师凯万似乎遇到了某些麻烦…

quests.title: Even Beasts Stumble
quests.description: You find someone in danger in the outskirts of Sumeru...
quests.description_chs: 在须弥的郊外，你注意到似乎有人遇见了危险…

quests.title: Dune-Entombed Fecundity: Part I
quests.description: With the help of the Tanit, you prepare to enter Mt. Damavand in search of the secrets that lie buried within the Eternal Oasis...
quests.description_chs: 在塔尼特部族的帮助下，你们将进入达马山，探寻「永恒绿洲」之底埋藏的秘密…

quests.title: Dune-Entombed Fecundity: Part II
quests.description: You run into Azariq in the desert and find yourself invited to accept his help in making your way to the next location...
quests.description_chs: 在沙漠中偶遇阿萨里格，受邀在他的帮助下前往下一处地点…

quests.title: Invisible Barrier
quests.description: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.
quests.description_chs: 年轻的索赫尔在考古笔记中记录了在沙漠中的探险经历，其中提及的一些遗迹也许隐藏着宝藏与旧时的记录。再次进入沙漠深处探索吧。

quests.description: Soheil's archaeological notes record his desert adventures in his youth. Some of the ruins mentioned may contain treasures and old records. Head into the depths of the desert again to look for them.

quests.title: The Exile: Sprouting
quests.description: The Sumeru Roses planted by Sabbah never grow. Try to help her.
quests.description_chs: 赛芭种植的须弥蔷薇始终无法生长，试着帮助她吧。

quests.title: The Exile: Blooming
quests.description: A rose that once bloomed in Sumeru City may be able to bloom elsewhere, too.
quests.description_chs: 曾在须弥城里绽放的蔷薇，离开了须弥城未必就不能绽放。

quests.title: A Gifted Rose: Prickly as Thorns
quests.title_chs: 献给某人的蔷薇·如荆棘一般多刺
quests.description: The old man who lives alone on the outskirts of the village may be the flower grower mentioned by Sabbah. Help him clean up his nursery.
quests.description_chs: 独居在村边的老人，或许就是赛芭提到过的种花人，帮他清理苗圃吧。

quests.title: A Gifted Rose: Long Day Ahead
quests.title_chs: 献给某人的蔷薇·度过长日的方式
quests.description: The flowers planted by Affan haven't sprouted yet. Water them for him.
quests.description_chs: 阿凡种下的花暂时还没发芽，帮他浇水看看吧…

quests.title: A Gifted Rose: Can Stones Bloom
quests.title_chs: 献给某人的蔷薇·石头能不能开花
quests.description: Affan's flowers still haven't sprouted. Try to help the disappointed fellow.
quests.description_chs: 阿凡的花种依然没有发芽，试着帮助失落的他吧。

quests.title: A Gifted Rose: Ballad of Days Gone By
quests.title_chs: 献给某人的蔷薇·来自往日的歌谣
quests.description: Follow Sabbah's advice and try to "Awaken" the seeds
quests.description_chs: 采取赛芭的建议，试着「唤醒」种子吧。

quests.title: A Gifted Rose: Some People Never Fade Away
quests.title_chs: 献给某人的蔷薇·曾有人战胜消逝
quests.description: Join others to witness the Golden Rose in full bloom.
quests.description_chs: 和众人一起见证金蔷薇盛开吧。

quests.description_chs: 要协助婕德一同前往「永恒绿洲」，首先应寻找通晓古事的镇灵。据说那镇灵就隐藏在这古老神殿的残垣断壁之中…

quests.title: The Eternal Dream, Ever Lush
quests.description: Finally, you have arrived at the unchanging, eternal oasis, and thus is a great weight lifted off Jeht's shoulders...

quests.description_chs: 阿德菲虽然作为塔尼特的叛徒被婕德解决，但是，之前托付给阿德菲的奔奔现在又怎么样了呢…

quests.title: An Unwavering Culinary Dream
quests.description: Something is bothering Arapacati lately...
quests.description_chs: 兰帕卡提最近好像在为什么事情发愁…

quests.description_chs: 在与两位学者约定的地点附近，你远远地听见了争吵的声音…

quests.title: The Culling of the Worms: Testing
quests.description: You were unexpectedly attacked by a Wenut...
quests.description_chs: 你们意外地遭遇了沙虫的袭击…

quests.description: After three days of busywork, the Wenutslayer Cannon will finally showcase its power...
quests.description_chs: 经过三天的奔波，「对沙虫用杀虫炮」终于将展示它的威力…

quests.title: The Recollector's Path
quests.description: After bringing Mihir and Rashnu back to the Vourukasha Oasis, Sorush finally earned the approval of the Khvarena, gaining the Twin-Horned Chaplet and becoming the Bloomguard. But with regard to the responsibilities of such a position, Zurvan seems to have a few things to say...\n
quests.description_chs: 将米希尔、拉沙鲁带回甘露花海后，斯露莎终于获得了灵光的认可，得到了「双角的花冠」，成为了花灵之「勇者」。但何谓勇者的职责，祖尔宛似乎有话要说…\n

quests.title: The Recollector's Path
quests.description: After completing some of the training assignments recommended by Zurvan, Sorush grows closer to assuming the responsibilities of a Bloomguard...\n
quests.description_chs: 按照祖尔宛的吩咐完成了一部分训练内容，斯露莎距离成为独当一面的花灵勇者又近了一步…\n

quests.title: The Recollector's Path
quests.description: Sorush's training continues. Even a Wenut crystallized across countless eras has a date of expiry. Could there possibly be an ode or poem that could outlast even such a being?\n
quests.description_chs: 斯露莎的训练仍在继续，已存续数百年的沙虫结晶尚且有销蚀的一日，比它更为耐久的颂诗真的存在吗…\n

quests.title: The Recollector's Path
quests.description: After speaking of Mihir and the Oceanids, Sorush seemed to be at a loss. Zurvan's training has now progressed beyond its midpoint...\n
quests.description_chs: 谈及米希尔及纯水精灵的话题后，斯露莎似乎有些迷惘。祖尔宛交代的训练已经来到后半…\n

quests.title: The Recollector's Path
quests.description: Sorush has finally realized that, at some point, she walked down a path of meaninglessness and absurdity. The training is approaching its conclusion...\n
quests.description_chs: 斯露莎也意识到，原来不知何时踏上了谋虚逐妄的错路。训练内容已所剩无多…\n

quests.title: The Recollector's Path
quests.description: The training is approaching its conclusion. Zurvan's approval is but a step away...\n
quests.description_chs: 训练已经到了尾声阶段，离真正获得祖尔宛的认可只差最后一步…\n

quests.title: Crisis Management Unit, Fully Operational!

quests.description_chs: 在众人的协力下，「稳健知行」机构已趋于完善，走上了正轨，这段时间的忙碌总算告一段落…

quests.title: A Not-So-Distant Farewell
quests.description: "Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta"'s debut ends here. Haniyyah and Souka will keep improving the game, and make preparations for an official tournament in the future. That said, they won't be going off to some distant place this time...
quests.description_chs: 「小小灵蕈大幻戏」的初次游玩到此为止了，海妮耶和左右加还会继续改进这种桌上游戏，并为将来的正式大赛做准备。这次，她们不会再远离你们的视野了…

quests.description_chs: 枫丹科学院的研究员玛卡德尔似乎正在为什么而发愁…

quests.title: The Long-Failed "Graph Adversarial Technology"...
quests.title_chs: 早早失败的「图形对抗学」…
quests.description: After putting in some work, you have collected enough samples. Looks like it's time to follow up with Lepine-Pauline...
quests.description_chs: 经过一段时间的工作，你们收集到了足够的样本，看样子，是时候和乐平波琳开展后续的讨论了…

quests.title: Treasures Under the Sea
quests.description: You run into Ulman again in the Court of Fontaine...
quests.description_chs: 在枫丹廷，你又遇见了乌尔曼…

quests.title: Treasures Under the Sea: Epilogue
quests.description: Ulman is planning the future of his business enterprise...
quests.description_chs: 乌尔曼正在为自己的生意做下一步打算…

quests.title: The Arrival of a...!
quests.description: Mr. Petit Lumiere seems to have a unique understanding of films...
quests.description_chs: 小露米埃尔先生似乎对映影有着独到的见解…

quests.title: Imaginary Maze of True Heroes
quests.description: Next to a mysterious Domain in Mondstadt, you and Paimon run into an old friend. She seems to be preparing some kind of special event...
quests.description_chs: 在蒙德某地的奇妙秘境旁，你与派蒙遇见了一位老朋友，她似乎正在准备某种特别的活动…

quests.title: The Art of the Elegant Blade Dance?
quests.description: In a nondescript corner of Belleau Region, you and Paimon discover the entrance to a Domain. A Blade Dancer in high spirits extends a special invitation to you...
quests.description_chs: 在白露区某个不起眼的角落，你与派蒙发现了一座秘境的入口，某位兴致高昂的「剑客」向你们发出了特别的邀请…

quests.title: Blade Dance's Unexpected End!
quests.description: After experiencing a unique battle on the Blade Dancer's stage, you and Paimon plan to give Costentin some feedback, but discover something has changed...
quests.description_chs: 在「轻剑舞者」构筑舞台上体验了一番独特的战斗后，你和派蒙打算给科斯唐坦一些反馈，却发现事态有变…

quests.title: Spread Out Less Than an Arcminute!
quests.description: During the Fontinalia Film Festival, you and Paimon encounter a special member of the Gardes, she seems to be looking for guests to partake in an event test...
quests.description_chs: 「千灵映影节」期间，你与派蒙遇见了一位特别的警备队员，她似乎正在寻找试玩活动的客人…

quests.title: Rescue the Poor Contract Employee!
quests.description: During the joyous festival, some involved with the filmmaking industry are wearing frowns. You and Paimon encounter an unfortunate contracted employee...
quests.description_chs: 欢快的节庆之时，也有映影行业的相关人士愁眉不展，你与派蒙就在会场附近找到了一位倒霉的乙方员工…

quests.title: Special Lighting and the Stars of Tomorrow!
quests.description: On the site of the Fontinalia Film Festival, an "experimental" film director dressed quite ostentatiously extends a sincere invitation...
quests.description_chs: 在「千灵映影节」的会场，某位衣着华丽的「实验映影」导演向你们发出了真诚的邀请…

quests.title: Search Chronicle: Audience with the Solitary King!
quests.description: Although his plan to make new buddies is not going well, Ranjit seems unconcerned. Indeed, he is already preparing for the next challenge...
quests.description_chs: 尽管结识新伙伴的计划进展并不顺利，但兰吉特并不在意，并且已经准备开始新的挑战…

quests.title: Filmmaking Notes
quests.description: Reunite with an old friend at Café Lutece...
quests.description_chs: 和一位老朋友再次相会在露泽咖啡厅…

quests.title: Search Chronicle: Afterword
quests.description: Ranjit was unable to forge a bond with any of his candidates, but he seems to still have something to say...
quests.description_chs: 兰吉特最终也没能和候选中的任何一个变成伙伴，不过他似乎还有些话想说…

quests.title: We Meet Again, Cannon...
quests.description: After hearing the sound of "cro-cro~~KOOM" by chance, you and Paimon discover an engineer who seems to be tinkering with a very unusual device...
quests.description_chs: 偶然听见「鳄鳄~砰！」的声音后，你和派蒙发现了一位工程师，她似乎正在捣鼓着某种特别的装置…

quests.title: A Time-Tested Friendship
quests.description: Aside from filming, there are other things we can do together, like meeting for a meal. Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Lambad's Tavern, Hotel Debord, and the like... Coffee at Café Lutece might not be a bad idea either.
quests.description_chs: 除了拍映影，还有别的事可以一起做，有空记得找我吃饭。猎鹿人、万民堂、兰巴德酒馆、德波大饭店之类的…去露泽咖啡厅喝咖啡也是好主意。

quests.title: The Cannon Has Ears
quests.description: The Gardes are facing an emergency in the south of Fontaine. It appears they need assistance...
quests.description_chs: 枫丹南部的某地似乎出现了紧急事态，警备队员们需要支援…

quests.title: Pre-Packaged Solution
quests.description: After a brief battle, you manage to suppress the monsters in the ruins, collecting a large amount of data on Frejus's cannon in the process...
quests.description_chs: 一段时间的战斗后，你们成功压制了遗迹中的魔物，还为弗雷瑞斯的重炮收集到了充足的数据…

quests.title: Hot in a Flash, or Cold Just as Fast?
quests.description: It is said that Lepine-Pauline has developed a groundbreaking new lens. But why does her apprentice Ninette look on the verge of tears?
quests.description_chs: 据说，乐平波琳又研发出了划时代的新镜头。可为什么她的徒弟妮内特，看起来快要哭出来了？

quests.title: A Robust Theoretical Discussion
quests.description: Near the Fountain of Lucine, you and Paimon seem to hear someone arguing...
quests.description_chs: 在露景泉附近，你与派蒙似乎隐约听到了一阵激烈的争吵声…

quests.description_chs: 前往「回声之子」部族，寻找「火山信物」的线索吧。

quests.description_chs: 去找找失踪了的看守提佐科吧…

quests.title: To Wish Upon a Star
quests.description: You encounter a child looking for star shards out in the wild...
quests.description_chs: 在野外遇到了寻找星星碎片的小孩…

quests.title: Lies and Promises
quests.description: You discover a Yumkasaurus standing in the way of some treasure. Can you find a way to make it leave...?
quests.description_chs: 发现了将宝藏堵在身后的匿叶龙，能想办法让它离开吗…

quests.title: Lights, Kamera, Action!

quests.description_chs: 和龙伙伴一起拍映影吧！

quests.title: A Saurian Lover's Ordinary Days

quests.description_chs: 在野外遇到被三只龙团团围住的人...

quests.description_chs: 在路上遇到了许多的嵴锋龙，你的龙伙伴与它们玩耍，却没有回来…

quests.title: Weighty Wings
quests.description: You find an injured Saurian out in the wild...
quests.description_chs: 在野外发现了受伤的龙…

quests.title: Charge Forward! Go, Go, Go!
quests.description: "Dad, heroes are so tall and strong. I wish I could be one some day."\n"It's true that many heroes are tall and strong by nature, but there are others who — though they may be lacking in height and strength — are just as capable as any of the taller ones I've trained."
quests.description_chs: 「爸爸，勇士们都很高大，又有力气，真羡慕他们。」\n「确实很多勇士天生拥有强健的肉体，不过也有那种个子小、力气也不是很大的勇士，他们一点不比我训练出的那些高个子勇士差。」

quests.title: Molting Season
quests.description: "Dad, the heroes you've trained are all perfect, right?"\n"It's not like that. Perfection always feels like it's just beyond reach, so the desire to achieve it gnaws at the very fiber of their being — but they'll never do it. Just like us, they'll get tired and want to give up."
quests.description_chs: 「爸爸，你训练出的勇士们都很完美对吧？」\n「不能这么说，完美永远在下一秒，而追求完美的欲望会啃咬他们的心，他们永远也不会是完美的。他们也会厌倦，也会想放弃，和你我一样。」

quests.title: A Saurian Returns to the Nest
quests.description: "Dad, if you've touched the stars, would you still want to return to the ground?"\n"Every creature that flies is born on the ground or in a nest, and they must all return whence they came."
quests.description_chs: 「爸爸，如果你已经触摸过星星，那你还会愿意回到地面上吗？」\n「所有会飞的生灵都是在土地上或者巢穴中出生的，总要回到它们出生的地方去。」

quests.title: Every Aspect of a Warrior
quests.description: "What we trainers pursue, myself included, isn't success..."
quests.description_chs: 「包括我在内，所有训练师追求的并不是成功…」

quests.title: Why Did a Member of a "Secret Organization" Come Here?
quests.title_chs: 「秘密组织」的成员为什么来到这里
quests.description: You've received a mysterious commission from an "organization whose details may not be disclosed" at the Adventurers' Guild. Specifically, you are to assist the client in completing data collection work on a series of giant monsters, including the Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device, Legatus Golem, Hydro Tulpa, and Emperor of Fire and Iron. It seems that this might just be a toughie...

quests.title: The Haunted Pirate Shipwreck
quests.description: Treasure hunters attempting to scavenge riches from the wreckage of a pirate ship claim to have been attacked by a ghost. While the Eye of Kratti is no stranger to rumors of haunted sightings, there has never been a documented case of ghosts assaulting the living. Perhaps questioning Ilmari, who often fishes nearby, might reveal more information.
quests.description_chs: 试图在海盗船的残骸中搜刮宝物的宝藏猎人声称自己受到了鬼魂的袭击，刻拉蒂之眼的确素来有幽灵出没的传言，但从未有过鬼魂袭击活人的记录。询问在附近钓鱼的伊尔玛里，或许能获得更多信息。

quests.title: The Disturbance Caused by Theft
quests.description: There had been a major commotion in Nasha Town due to a stolen goods case during the Peripatetic Circle caravan's stay — one that even led to death. The caravan has since left Nasha Town, but asking the well-informed messengers Hiram and Kurierka may yield more detailed information.
quests.description_chs: 「流浪之环」商队在那夏镇停留时，因货物失窃的案子而闹出不小的骚动，甚至有人在这次的骚动中丧生。现在，商队已经离开了那夏镇，但若是向消息灵通的「信使」海勒姆和库莉艾卡打听，或许会得到更详细的信息。

quests.title: The Vanishing Bounty Target
quests.description: On the bounty board at The Flagship, there's a target known for vanishing without a trace after committing numerous heinous crimes. Yet justice demands retribution, and sins must be atoned for. Asking Leszek, an employee at The Flagship, may yield further information.
quests.description_chs: 「旗舰」的悬赏榜单上有一个目标在犯下许多骇人罪行后便销声匿迹，仿佛人间蒸发。而罪咎终须追索，罪责终须清偿。询问「旗舰」员工勒塞克，或许能得到更多信息。

quests.title: The Suspicious Hermit
quests.description: In the northern Lempo Isle, east of the Nothing Passage, lived a hermit called Derwent who regularly visited friends in Nasha Town. Recently, however, not only has he stopped going to Nasha Town, he's also refusing all visiting guests. The recluse appears to have undergone significant changes in both appearance and habits... There is, however, another notable detail: a traveling merchant claims that their associate, who regularly delivered goods to the hermit, has gone missing after their last visit... To uncover the truth, a direct visit may be the best approach.
quests.description_chs: 在伦波岛北部，空寂走廊东侧蛰居的隐者德文特，过去会定期来那夏镇拜访友人，但最近不必说到访那夏镇，就连登门拜访的客人也不接待，深居简出的他似乎在装扮和生活习惯上也有了不小的变化…另有一件值得在意的事，一名游商声称，会定期拜访隐者的游商伙伴，自最后一次拜访后便下落不明…要想探明真相，直接登门拜访或许是最好的选择。

quests.title: Final Match Concludes, Champion Decided

quests.title: Blessings of the Frost Moon

quests.description_chs: 在已成型的「大书库」里，你遇见了正在思索某事的菈乌玛…

quests.title: The Sun Rises Once More

quests.title: New Idea

quests.title: The Last Step of Testing

quests.description: While on the road, you witness members of a Snezhnayan gang oppressing members of its citizenry. You step in and resolve the problem, but a far more complex situation lies behind this seemingly tiny conflict.

quests.description: The cabin on the ice seems but a hair's breadth from sinking into the sea. What happened while you were gone? Is the owner of the house, who refused to get ashore, still in there? Approach the cabin to check it out.
quests.description_chs: 冰上的木屋似乎马上就要沉向海底。这段时间究竟发生了什么？那位不愿上岸的屋主是否还在木屋中？靠近木屋看看吧。

quests.title: An Agreement to Share Tips...
quests.description: After a period of relaxed cooperation with the children of the "Mutual Aid Advancement Network," the exploration plan has essentially been completed, and Chichikova seems to have gained some new insights...
quests.description_chs: 与「强化互助会」的小朋友们经历了一段时间的轻松合作后，探索计划基本完成了，琪琪科娃似乎也有了新收获…

quests.title: Paimon's "Driyosh Problem-Solving Method"
quests.title_chs: 派蒙的「帝利耶悉」解题法

quests.description_chs: 首届「冒险家竞技大赛」决出了胜者——你和派蒙，除了来自至冬总部的奖励，你们还将面对一系列特殊的问题…

quests.description: Talalikhin, an adventurer devoted to researching dangerous phenomena, is conducting some form of simulation training near the Adventurers' Guild headquarters...
quests.description_chs: 在冒险家协会总部旁，专注于研究危险现象的冒险家塔拉利欣正在进行某种模拟训练…

quests.title: They Who Hear the Sea
quests.description: You discover a strange conch shell on Twinning Isle in the Golden Apple Archipelago. The sounds that come from within seem to hint at something...
quests.description_chs: 在金苹果群岛中的「双双岛」中，你发现了一枚奇怪的海螺。而海螺里的那些声音，似乎还在暗示着什么…

quests.title: The Winding Homeward Way
quests.description: You meet a strange Seelie on Minacious Isle...
quests.description_chs: 在危危岛上，你们遇见了一个奇怪的仙灵…

quests.title: Who Wields the Wild Wind?
quests.description: No one knows why, but this island seems to be forever affected by strange weather conditions...
quests.description_chs: 不知道究竟是因为什么原因，这座岛似乎始终处于一种奇怪的天气中…

quests.title: From Outer Lands
quests.description: You discover a strange wrecked ship on a nameless island. But the question is, where did this ship come from?
quests.description_chs: 在一座无名岛屿上，你们发现了一截奇怪的断船，但是，这艘船究竟是从哪里来的呢…

quests.title: The Other Side of Isle and Sea
quests.description: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...
quests.description_chs: 在金苹果群岛中，你发现了一幅奇怪的壁画…

quests.title: A Trip Through Fog and Wind
quests.description: You discover a strange mural in the Golden Apple Archipelago...
quests.description_chs: 在金苹果群岛中，你发现了一幅奇怪的壁画…

quests.title: Big Badaboom Battle
quests.description: Paimon is very curious about Albedo...
quests.description_chs: 派蒙对阿贝多的情况很好奇…

quests.title: Summer Gift
quests.description: A mysterious, joyous gift lies somewhere, waiting to be discovered...
quests.description_chs: 带来快乐的神秘礼物正在某处静候…

quests.title: Thus Was the Work Done in Vain
quests.description: By chance, you discover notes left by an adventurer who was left stranded by Minacious Isle's traps. However, all that seems to have happened well in the now-unchangeable past. Might there be some way to help him, even if only in a Mirage?
quests.description_chs: 在危危岛上偶然发现了受困于岛上陷阱的冒险家留下的笔记，但已经是很久以前发生的不可更改的事。不过，既然此刻群岛在幻境的影响之下…会不会有，仅在幻境之中的稍稍帮助他的办法？

quests.title: Where the Treasure Dwells
quests.description: It seems that pirates have hidden treasure in the Golden Apple Archipelago and divided the clues up into four parts. Recover all the clues and find that treasure!
quests.description_chs: 似乎有海盗在金苹果群岛的海域上藏起了宝藏，并且将线索一分为四，找到所有的线索，寻得宝藏吧！

quests.title: Treasure Voyage
quests.description: Miitoboru, a waverider who claims to be a mighty pirate ship, seems to have something to discuss with you...
quests.description_chs: 自称大海盗船的浪船「大肉丸」似乎有什么事想要进行商谈…

quests.title: The Misplaced Photo
quests.description: You meet a Fatui Mirror Maiden on Broken Isle who keeps going on about losing a photo. It seems that you won't be able to communicate with her normally... But if you find some way to bring her back to her senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why she is here.
quests.description_chs: 在破破岛上，有一位一直叨念着丢失照片的愚人众藏镜仕女，看样子似乎无法正常沟通…找到让她恢复理智的办法，说不定能得知她在此行动的目的。

quests.title: The Discarded Insignia
quests.description: You meet a Fatui Electrohammer Vanguard on Minacious Isle who keeps going on about an insignia. It seems that you won't be able to get through to him... But if you find some way to bring him back to his senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why he is here.
quests.description_chs: 在危危岛上，有一位一直叨念着什么徽记的愚人众雷锤前锋军，看样子似乎无法正常沟通…找到让他恢复理智的办法，说不定能得知他在此行动的目的。

quests.title: A Misplaced Conch
quests.description: The Fatui team members you've brought back to their senses have all returned to the camp on the central island. You wonder if the Geochanter Bracer named Yakov has regained his wits or not...
quests.description_chs: 之前唤醒的愚人众小队成员都回到了中央岛屿的营地里，真不知道名为雅科夫的岩使游击兵最后恢复理智了没有…

quests.title: Bake-Danuki Wanderlust
quests.description: A bake-danuki seems to be looking for help on Pudding Isle...
quests.description_chs: 布丁岛上似乎有妖狸在寻求帮助…

quests.title: Drama Phantasmagoria: Tale of the Sword-Wielding Princess!
quests.title_chs: 极夜幻想剧·王女执剑记！
quests.description: The great Prinzessin's loyal subjects are pleased to perform for you, our guests, a performance most special: a tale of love and valor...
quests.description_chs: 伟大皇女的忠诚子民，在此为所有来客献上特别的演出，一个关于爱与勇气的故事…

quests.title: The Final Treasure
quests.description: Miitoboru seems to have some request. Time to ask him about the details...
quests.description_chs: 「大肉丸」似乎有什么事想要拜托我们，具体的详情，就去问问他吧…

quests.title: Treasure Clue: Broken Isle
quests.description: Go near to the reef of Broken Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.
quests.description_chs: 前往破破岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…

quests.title: Treasure Clue: Twinning Isle
quests.description: Go near to the reef of Twinning Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.
quests.description_chs: 前往双双岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…

quests.title: Treasure Clue: Minacious Isle
quests.description: Go near to the reef of Minacious Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.
quests.description_chs: 前往危危岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…

quests.description: Go near to the reef of Pudding Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.
quests.description_chs: 前往布丁岛的礁石附近，看看有没有海盗们留下的，关于宝藏的线索…

quests.description: Mondstadt's Katheryne has a gift to pass on to you. It seems to have come from dancing bake-danuki...?
quests.description_chs: 蒙德的凯瑟琳有礼物要转交给你，这赠礼竟然来自跳舞的妖狸…？

quests.title: Returning Curios
quests.description: Following Paimon's sage advice: "Chests of hidden Mora — gotta find 'em all!," you and Paimon decide to visit Idyia again, just to make sure you didn't miss any points of interest within Veluriyam Mirage. This turns out to be perfect timing, as Idyia has prepared something unique...
quests.description_chs: 遵循着派蒙的建议——「藏着摩拉的宝箱，一个都不能错过！」，你与派蒙打算再次造访伊迪娅，确认你们是否错过了「琉形蜃境」中某些有趣的地点。正巧，伊迪娅也筹备了一个独特的游乐项目…
在水域中潜行并且找到宝藏$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Daiya's Three-Day Reverie
quests.description: In a corner of the Veluriyam Mirage, you and Paimon discover a strange announcement speaker, and following the instructions, it seems you can participate in a very unique attraction...
quests.description_chs: 在「琉形蜃境」的一角，你和派蒙发现了一座奇特的告示喇叭，循着旁白的指引，似乎就能参与一项别具乐趣的游乐项目…

quests.title: The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken
quests.description: "An ancient legend resurfaces, and new clues to a priceless treasure are found. A band of chivalrous pirates hones their weapons and hoists the sails..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken...
quests.description_chs: 「古老的传说重现天日，丰饶无比的宝藏有了新的线索，一队侠义的海盗擦亮了武器，升起了船帆…」\n循着这样的简介，你与派蒙来到了「黑水晶号与吞金海怪」的演出地…

quests.title: Petrifying Gaze
quests.description: "To save their fallen friends, the now-alone Hydro Eidolon must break into the haunted fortress, and find a way to lift the curse..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of "Petrifying Gaze"...
quests.description_chs: 「为了拯救不幸罹难的伙伴，落单的水形幻灵即将闯入幽魂盘踞的古堡，寻找破除『魔咒』的希望…」\n循着这样的简介，你与派蒙来到了「瞳孔里的固形魔咒」的演出地…

quests.title: Skycastle Saviors
quests.description: "A town floating in the sky encounters an unprecedented crisis, and a miracle-working architect must act quickly to prevent the soaring city from crashing to the ground..."\nIntrigued, you and Paimon arrive at the set of Skycastle Saviors...
quests.description_chs: 「飘浮在天空之中的小镇遭遇了空前的危机，创造奇迹的建筑师要及时挽救这座正在坠落的高城…」\n循着这样的简介，你与派蒙来到了「天空高城救守记」的演出地…

quests.title: Capturing Light and Shadow
quests.description: Following the tracks of a Choo-Choo Cart line, you and Paimon run into an enormous space in the cave with a mysterious mural in a very conspicuous spot, which seems to be illustrating someone's story in the "Veluriyam Mirage"...
quests.description_chs: 循着一台「呼呼飞车」的航迹，你与派蒙意外发现了洞窟中的巨大空间，一幅神秘的壁画伫立在醒目的位置，似乎述说着某人在「琉形蜃境」中的故事…

quests.title: A Starry Night, as Remembered
quests.description: Jeroney wishes to be able to see the starry sky whenever he wants, so why not take a photo of it for him? Even if it's only the reflection inside the bottle and not the real thing, it will be beautiful enough.
quests.description_chs: 杰洛尼想要随时能够看到星空，不如用留影机为他拍摄一张星空的画片吧。虽然只是瓶中折射，不是真正的星空，但也是足以让人想念的美景。

quests.title: Domain Adventures
quests.description: Long ago, this mysterious domain appeared in Teyvat. To probe its arcane secrets, one must enter stone walls, ride carts, and raise the lamp in the tent. But, what is it all for?
quests.description_chs: 不知何时出现在了提瓦特大陆上的神奇秘境，为了探寻其中的奥秘，需要钻入石壁，乘坐轨道车，并且进入帐篷升起彩灯。不过，这到底都是为了什么呢…

quests.title: Towards the Lighthouse, or Far Away
quests.description: Something seems to be troubling someone in the collapsed lighthouse outside Brickstacks...
quests.description_chs: 在叠架村外倒塌的灯塔里，似乎有人正在为某事而烦恼…

quests.title: Narration Footnotes
quests.description: Kirara says there are a few things she must investigate alone. As you're not a cat, curiosity won't kill you, so why not go with her...
quests.description_chs: 绮良良说有些想要独自调查的东西。有点好奇，和她一起去看看吧…

quests.title: The Lotus Leaf and the Champion
quests.description: There seems to be a grand contest taking place at Rainsong Pond...
quests.description_chs: 雨歌塘里，似乎正在举办一场盛大的比赛…

quests.title: The Forest and the Princess
quests.description: In the forest, a princess is preparing to go solve a certain problem herself...
quests.description_chs: 在森林里，有一位正准备亲自去解决某个问题的公主…

quests.title: The Answer of the Lotus Leaves and Forest
quests.description: The champion paper frog Faurobert and Princess Cimest of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells seem to be in a... slightly odd predicament.
quests.description_chs: 纸蛙的冠军福罗贝尔，与铃风王国的公主西梅似乎遇见了一个…略微有些怪异的问题。

quests.title_chs: (test)折纸系列WQ完成后的闲置对话$HIDDEN

quests.title: "Owl Musician"
quests.description: You encounter a serious guard in Constellation Metropole...
quests.description_chs: 在星轨王城里，你遇见了一个严肃的守卫…

quests.title: "Flying Hatter"
quests.description: There is someone in Constellation Metropole who is most enamored with hats...
quests.description_chs: 在星轨王城中，有一位对帽子格外有兴趣的人…

quests.title: "Good Shelf"
quests.description: In the Forest of Blessings dwells a paper frog who has made something interesting.
quests.description_chs: 在赐福森林里，有一位纸蛙似乎制造了一件有趣的事物。

quests.title: "Brave Northerly Wind"
quests.description: In the Forest of Blessings lives a particularly passionate flying squirrel...
quests.description_chs: 在赐福森林里，有一位情绪格外亢奋的飞鼠…

quests.title: Text's Coda
quests.description: After everything has come to an end, it's time to spare a thought for how to deal with the great clockwork key. It's not like you can just hold onto it...
quests.description_chs: 一切结束之后，该想想怎么处理伟大发条了。一直拿着也不是办法…
(test)摄影呀哈哈$HIDDEN

quests.title: Explore This World
quests.description: You've somehow ended up in a strange land. Time to explore!
quests.description_chs: 不知怎么来到了一个神奇的地方，开始冒险吧！
测试任务底层功能$UNRELEASED

quests.title: Involuntary Sacrifice
quests.description: You hear from Ganyu and Lan that the Treasure Hoarders of Mondstadt and Liyue have banded together and plan to get involved in some ruins associated with the Abyss Order. Fearing the chaos that the Treasure Hoarders might cause through their involvement, you take up the commission and investigate...
quests.description_chs: 你从甘雨和岚姐处得知，蒙德璃月一带的盗宝团最近正准备联合起来，意图染指一座与「深渊教团」有关的遗迹。因为担忧盗宝团可能引起的混乱，你接下了调查此事的委托…

quests.title: A Herald Without Adherents
quests.description: After fleeing from those creepy ruins, you meet Dainsleif by chance. You follow him and begin your pursuit of the Abyss Herald through those ruins once more...
quests.description_chs: 在逃离了那座诡异的遗迹后，你意外地遇见了戴因斯雷布。跟随着他，你们再次对在遗迹中出现的「深渊使徒」展开了追迹…

quests.title: Dishonorable Trial
quests.description: To investigate the plan that the Abyss Order's talisman speaks of, you decide to head to the Cathedral in Mondstadt to consult the members of the Church.
quests.description_chs: 为了调查「深渊教团」的「信」中所提到的计划，你们决定先前往蒙德城的西风大教堂，向教会的人请教一下…

quests.title: A Soul Set Apart
quests.description: You continue searching for "the first Field Tiller," following the information you've obtained from Barbara and the Great Wolf King of the North...
quests.description_chs: 根据从芭芭拉与「北风的王狼」那里得到的线索，你们继续寻找着那台「世上第一座耕地机」…

quests.title: In the Depths, an Unexpected Reunion
quests.description: Katheryne seems to have a new commission for you. Go check it out.
quests.description_chs: 凯瑟琳小姐似乎有新的委托，去看看委托的内容吧。

quests.title: The Grave of the Guarded
quests.description: You have an unexpected reunion with Dainsleif within The Chasm. After getting wind of the situation, you believe that this place must be intimately linked to the Abyss Order, and thus begin investigating...
quests.description_chs: 在层岩巨渊内，你居然意外地与戴因斯雷布再会了。在了解情况后，你们认为这里与深渊教团恐怕有千丝万缕的联系，于是展开了调查…

quests.title: Memories of Inteyvat
quests.description: The Black Serpent Knights present here do not, in truth, mean you ill. They are simply driven by their remaining instincts to defend those hilichurls. After you discover some of the secrets of this strange city, the Black Serpent Knight Halfdan seems to have something to show you...
quests.description_chs: 此地的黑蛇骑士其实对你们并无恶意，只是残留的意志驱使它们保护那些丘丘人而已。在发现了这座诡异城市中的一些秘密后，黑蛇骑士哈夫丹似乎有什么东西想要给你们看…

quests.title: The Black Serpent Knights' Glory
quests.description: Dainsleif figures out the Abyss Order's plan from the twin's memories left within the Inteyvat flower. Now to see if you can stop them or not...
quests.description_chs: 根据因提瓦特花朵上留下的双子的回忆，戴因斯雷布判断出了深渊教团的计划，只是还不知道是否来得及阻止…

quests.title: Destined Encounter
quests.description: Masrur at Port Ormos is currently worrying himself sick over a letter with an unclear address...
quests.description_chs: 奥摩斯港的马斯鲁尔先生正在为一封收信地址模糊的信而犯愁…

quests.title: Fortune-Mocking Pedigree
quests.description: As night passes and you awaken next to the bonfire, you realize that Paimon is missing. As you search for her, you come upon a wandering father by chance...
quests.description_chs: 篝火旁的一夜过去，你发现派蒙并不在身边。在找寻的时候，你邂逅了一位父亲…

quests.title: A Lamenter at Fate's End
quests.description: The medicine meant to restore Caribert didn't work quite as expected. During the process of remaking the medicine, you seem to find yourself beset upon by strange phenomena...
quests.description_chs: 拯救卡利贝尔的药并没有如预想的那样发挥效果，在重新制药的过程中，你们似乎见到了某种诡异的现象…

quests.title: Portended Fate
quests.description: The previous events might have been mysterious, but miraculous. Caribert's consciousness has returned, and his mind is whole again. However, might this achievement bear a price yet unknown...
quests.description_chs: 之前发生的事情虽然诡异，但又的确引发了奇迹，卡利贝尔真的恢复了神智。可这之中是否存在着不为人知的「代价」呢…

quests.title: The Key That Unlocks Fate
quests.description: Near the Collective of Plenty, you agree to help Iansan conduct a patrol. However, you stumble upon something completely unexpected...
quests.description_chs: 「沃陆之邦」附近，你答应伊安珊帮忙巡逻。在此期间，你找到了一样完全出乎你意料的东西…

quests.title: "Savior"
quests.description: Facing the Abyss Order's assault on Natlan, you decide to return to the cave where the key was lost, seeking a chance to end the conflict...
quests.description_chs: 面对深渊教团对纳塔的进攻，你决定再去那个遗落了钥匙的山洞附近，寻找停止争斗的契机…

quests.title: A Space and Time Without You
quests.description: Many strange events have unfolded between you and the girl named Direidyth, all while the conflict between the Abyss Order and Natlan rages on. Amidst this turmoil, the one who will shift the tides of war is preparing to take the stage...
quests.description_chs: 你与名为蒂莱尔的少女之间发生了诸多奇怪的事，深渊教团与纳塔之间的争斗也尚未休止。在这样的情况下，改变战局的人正在准备登场…

quests.title: Cold Case Commission
quests.description: You arrive at the Adventurers' Guild in Sumeru. Katheryne seems to have a very tricky commission for your docket...
quests.description_chs: 你们来到须弥的冒险家协会，凯瑟琳小姐似乎有一份非常棘手的委托要交给你们…

quests.title: Memories That Should Not Exist
quests.description: You have heretofore been unable to track down the missing man, but you encounter a familiar figure after the creatures of the Abyss Order emerge...
quests.description_chs: 至今你们依然捕捉不到那位失踪男子的踪迹，但在深渊教团的魔物出现以后，你们见到了另一个熟悉的身影…

quests.title: World-Order Narration
quests.description: As Dainsleif guessed, the "false memories" are a trap laid by the Abyss Order. The Ley Lines are disturbed again. Something is probably underway once more...
quests.description_chs: 如戴因所猜测的，「虚假的记忆」是深渊教团的陷阱。此时地脉再次开始扰动，大概已经有事情在发生了…
